m200588.――おや、わらわの国の話か？: ――Oh, are we talking about my country?
m200588.――そこを調査してもらうのも、\n王国随一の発明家を集めた\n研究チームの仕事だ:
――Investigating that is exactly what the research team
we assembled, made up of the kingdom's finest inventors, is for.
So, how are things progressing?
m200588.――アンウェン様、どうして宣戦布告など……。\nあんなに無益な戦いは嫌だとおっし:
???: ――Your Highness Anwen, why declare war……?
You said you disliked such futile battles.
m200588.――天眼ノ国にて: ――In the Nation of the Eye of Heaven
m200588.――閣下！ 王子殿下！\n来ました、敵襲です！:
――My Lord! Your Highness!
The enemy has arrived!
m200588.…………王国の、王子だ。: …………I am the Prince of the Kingdom.
m200588.……あれがドラゴンの国の最高戦力がひとり、か。: ……So that is one of the Dragon Capital's supreme combat powers.
m200588.……あれは、平常心っていうより、\n知識欲が先走ってるんじゃ――: ...That's less about keeping a level head and more about her curiosity getting the better of her—
m200588.……あれは威圧では折れんのだ、サフレア。\nわらわはよーく知っておる。\n我が親:
……Intimidation won't break them, Saflea.
I know that well.
It is the same as my troublesome father, the Governor.
m200588.……うむ。\nそなたらには、伝えねばなるまい。:
……Yes.
I suppose I must tell you.
m200588.……ええ、貴方は正しい。その判断を尊重します。\n僕としても自ら真相を遠ざけるよ:
……Yes, you are right. I respect your judgment.
I would not want to be the one to turn a blind eye to the truth.
m200588.……このまま押せば、わらわの勝ちだ。: ……If I push my advantage, this is my victory.
m200588.……なるほど。\n噂以上だな、王国とやら。:
……I see.
The so-called Kingdom is more than the rumors suggested.
m200588.……ヴィマーナ級の存在が、\n空を飛んでいて、背中に国家を乗せている、か。: ...An entity on the scale of a Vimana, flying through the sky with a nation on its back, huh.
m200588.……主の言う事、全然聞かないメイドめ。: ……A maid who doesn't listen to her master at all.
m200588.……了解した、議会にも報告しておく。\n王国との連携も強化する必要があるだろうな:
……Understood. I will report this to the Council.
We will need to strengthen our coordination with the Kingdom as well.
m200588.……人を救うためなら、退けぬ。\n異界の王子は、そういう方なのであろう？:
……If it is to save a life, I will not retreat.
Is that not the nature of the Prince from the other world?
m200588.……戦に挑まんとする太守を、\nやはり、わらわは止めねばならぬのだ。: ……I still must stop the governor who is trying to start a war.
m200588.……王女殿下が、\n事実をお話しになることも、お見通しで？:
……You anticipated that Her Highness the Princess
would reveal the truth?
m200588.……王女殿下の部隊は、退きました。\n天眼核を持ち帰ることは、かなわなかったよう:
Dragon General? ……The Princess's unit has withdrawn.
It seems they failed to retrieve the Heavenly Eye Core.
Also, the Princess appears to have been captured.
m200588.……王子殿下、あなたにおまかせします。: ……Your Highness, I leave it to you.
m200588.……異世界の王子よ、なぜこの地へ来た。\nそなたには何の縁もない世界の戦に、\n: ……Prince of another world, why have you come to this land? Why are you meddling in a war that has nothing to do with you?
m200588.……誰が竜のお姫様に料理を振る舞うかで、\nちょっとしたバトルがあったことは伏せ: ……Let's just leave it out that there was a small battle over who would serve the dragon princess.
m200588.……進軍の準備は、整っております。\nご命令を。:
……The advance is ready.
Awaiting your command.
m200588.……都市が、飛行？\nふふっ、ふふふ、どんな機構なんだろう……。\nドーンブリン:
...A city, flying?
Heh, hehehe... I wonder what kind of mechanism that is...
The technical connection to the Dawnbringer is...
m200588.あ、アナーニャさまー？\n無駄な抵抗はやめて、\nおとなしく負けを認めてください:
Oh, Lady Ananya?
Stop your futile resistance
and just accept your defeat, would you?
m200588.あぁ？ さっきはこっちに殴りかかって――\nああ、なるほど……スパイってことか。:
Huh? She was attacking us just a moment ago—
Ah, I see… so she's a spy.
m200588.あぁ？ そこは王国式だろ？: Hm? That's the Kingdom way, isn't it?
m200588.ああもう！ なんと不便な！\n王子よ、王位継承者同士、\n次で正々堂々決着をつけ:
Oh, for heaven's sake! How inconvenient!
Prince, since we are both heirs to a throne,
let us settle this fairly in our next fight!
--- scene: A Battle for Pride ---
m200588.あの議員が言っていた、\nかの国の王女殿下っていうのが、それか。: So the princess of that country the senator was talking about is the one in question.
m200588.あるいは、話せばお人好しを発揮するタイプとか。\n王子、もしかしたら、呪いさえと:
Or perhaps she's the type who becomes a pushover once she starts talking.
Prince, perhaps if we break the curse, we can talk to her.
m200588.あれは……精神支配……いえ、\n何らかの服従の呪いがかかっているように見えますわ:
That is… mental domination… No,
it appears she is under some kind of obedience curse!
m200588.あれは、伝えた以上のことは知らぬ。\n天竜核という名を知ったところで、\nその力:
She knows nothing beyond what was told to her.
Knowing the name "Heavenly Dragon Core"
does not mean she understands its power.
m200588.いいえ、鋼の都を思ってのお言葉でしょう。\n名探偵からの助言はいつでも受け付けて:
No, I know you spoke out of concern for the Steel City.
I am always open to advice from a renowned detective.
m200588.いいえ？\nさて、それじゃあ今や少数派の貴族院勢力、\nここで蹴散らしてやりまし:
No?
Well then, let's crush the Noble Council's forces,
who are now a minority, right here.
--- scene: The Mercenary Merchant and the Mercenary Corps (battle, end) ---
m200588.いえ、それが……。\nあちらには、商人率いる傭兵団もついている模様で。:
No, it's……
It seems they have a mercenary group led by a merchant with them.
m200588.うむ、竜都の進路を天眼ノ国へ。\n娘の帰還を待って、手を止める必要はない。\n我:
Yes. March the Dragon Capital toward the Land of the Heavenly Eye.
There is no need to hold our hands while we wait for our daughter's return.
We have our own duty to fulfill.
m200588.うわ、こんな遠い目してるユリクセス初めて見た。: Whoa, I've never seen Ulyxes look that stunned before.
m200588.うーん、エネルギーを生み出す機関が、\nそれを使う先もないのに動いてるのは問題か:
Hmm, it's a problem if a power-generating engine keeps running
when there's nowhere to use the energy.
I wonder how they're handling the output.
m200588.えぇ、貴族院残党が、\nドラゴンの国に助力を求めたことが\n内通者により判明しま: Yes. It has come to light, through an informant, that the remnants of the Noble House have sought aid from the Dragon Nation.
m200588.ええ、もちろん僕もそう思います。: Yes, I agree. I think so too.
m200588.えっ、いや、あの、えっ？\nおーいサフレアー？\nなんでわらわを小脇に抱えて……:
Huh? No, wait, what?
Hey, Saflea?
Why are you carrying me off under your arm… Hey?
m200588.えへへ。ではお代の方は期待させていただきますね。: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to my pay, then.
m200588.おぉ、反逆者どもが逃げていくぞ！\n天眼ノ国に栄光あれ……！！:
Oh, the rebels are fleeing!
Glory to the Nation of the Eye of Heaven……!!
m200588.おぉヴァニカ。\n抜けるとは――ああ、おぬしスパイだったな！:
Oh, Vanika.
Withdraw—ah, so you were a spy!
m200588.おぉ怖い。ではあちらで、\n正々堂々お相手しましょう。: Oh, that's scary. Very well, let's settle this fairly on that side.
m200588.おのれ、異世界の王国などに\n歴史ある天眼ノ国を売りおってぇぇぇ！！:
You wretch, selling off the historic Nation of the Eye of Heaven
to some otherworldly kingdom!!
m200588.おや、一応協力関係だと思ったのですが？: Oh, I thought we were cooperating, at least in name.
m200588.お待ちを、あまりにも司法を軽んじた発言だ。: Hold on a moment. That is a reckless disregard for the law.
m200588.くぅぅ……しかし、天眼ノ国すべてが\n貴様らについたと思うな。義憤により\n立ち: Grrr…… Don't think the entire Nation of the Eye of Heaven has turned to your side. Merchants, stirred by righteous indignation, are rallying to our cause!
m200588.くっ……ラージヴィール、アナーニャ！\nクーデターなど許すものか！:
Grr…… Rajvir, Ananya!
We will not allow a coup!
m200588.ここで都市警備隊の誇りを取り戻す！ 総員、抜剣！: Here, we reclaim the pride of the City Guard! All units, draw your swords!
m200588.この背にも、国民の命を背負っておるのだ。\n負けるわけには、いかぬ……！:
He, too, carries the lives of his people on his back.
I cannot afford to lose……!
m200588.これまでの彼女らの手口は実に巧妙だった。\n最悪、少数の微罪にしか問えない可能性:
Her methods have always been deviously clever.
In the worst case, she might only be charged with a few minor offenses.
m200588.さ、はよう行け。\n――そなたの傭兵団とも戦ってみたいと、\n隣で見ていて思って:
Well then, go on.
Watching from the sidelines, I thought I'd like to see how your mercenary company fights.
m200588.さぁヴァニカよ、\n国を売った不敬者どもに、\n愛国者の言葉を投げかけてやるがい:
Now then, Vanica,
fling the words of patriots
at those disloyal traitors who sold out the country.
m200588.さぁ剣を取れ、脆弱なる人型の者たちよ！:
Draw your swords, you fragile humanoids!
--- scene: The Mercenary Merchant and the Mercenary Corps (battle, start) ---
m200588.さて、この仕込みがどう機能するか……。: Now, let's see how this setup of mine plays out…
m200588.すでに大勢は決した。\nそなたのもとまで駆け抜けたはいいが、\n我が配下はすでに: The outcome is already decided. I made it all the way to you, but my forces are clearly on the back foot.
m200588.そうか。\n……あれは、優しすぎる。\nこの役目は、荷が重かったか。:
I see.
……She is too kind.
That role was too heavy a burden for her.
m200588.その最大出力は未知数、ということだな。\n事実、天眼核と同等の力を持つ天竜核は、:
So its maximum output remains a mystery.
In fact, the Heavenly Dragon Core, which possesses power equal to the Eye of Heaven Core,
can make an entire nation float in the sky――
m200588.その身柄が我々の手元にあるというだけで、\n鋼の都は要らぬ火種を懐に抱えることに: Simply having her in our custody is enough to make the Steel City harbor an unnecessary firebrand.
m200588.それでもよいと、わらわの軍を\n天眼ノ国へ招き入れたのはそなたであろう。: And yet, you were the one who welcomed my army into the Land of the Heavenly Eye.
m200588.それでシャルロット、\nアンウェンの解呪はうまくいきました？:
So, Charlotte,
did you manage to break Anwen's curse?
m200588.それなのに……。\n姫様、どうかご無事で……！:
And yet…
Princess, please stay safe…!
m200588.だからそうなる前に、事故に見せかけて……と？: So, you're suggesting we stage an accident before that happens?
m200588.だが……あれらの相手は、苦戦するだろうな。\nサフレア、メイドまで命をかける必要:
But…… those opponents will likely be a tough fight.
Saflea, there is no need for a maid to risk her life.
Stay far away――
m200588.だが、これを話した後、\n不躾な願いとはわかっているが、\nわらわをドラゴンの国:
But after I'm done,
I know it's an impertinent request,
but could you send me back to the Dragon Kingdom?
m200588.だが、そうだな……。\nこんな小さな勝利ひとつを競り合っても、無意味か。:
But, yes…
Competing over such a small victory is meaningless, isn't it?
m200588.ちぐはぐですが、完璧な布陣ですね。: It's a bit of a hodgepodge, but it's a perfect arrangement.
m200588.ちょっと離れた場所で、姫様の勇姿を見ておきます。\n危なくなったら抱えて逃げます:
I'll watch Your Highness's brave deeds from a safe distance.
If things get dangerous, I'll carry you away.
That works, right?
m200588.ですが、姫様みずから戦場に出るなど。\n竜都の悪戯娘は、ずっと悪戯娘のままで良い:
But for the Princess to take the battlefield herself……
The Dragon Capital's mischievous girl can remain a mischievous girl, cannot she?
m200588.ですが、現在の都市議会は少々潔癖が過ぎる。\nそれが間違っているというわけではあ:
However, the current City Council is perhaps a bit too scrupulous.
That is not to say they are wrong, but proving her crimes will take an enormous amount of time.
m200588.では、一つだけ留意しておいてください。\nおそらくこの状況も『教授』の計画の内で:
Then, just one thing to keep in mind.
This situation is likely part of the "Professor's" plan.
m200588.では、一手御指南願おう。\nわらわはアンウェン！ 竜都の次代の王！:
Then, allow me to show you a move.
I am Anwen! The next King of the Dragon Capital!
m200588.では、先程言えなかったこと、\nいま話してくれますか？: Then, could you tell us what you couldn't say earlier?
m200588.ともあれ、あとを追いましょう。\n対話をするつもりなら、\n距離を詰めるしかない:
In any case, let's pursue them.
If we intend to talk,
we have no choice but to close the distance.
m200588.な、な、な、何を！\nヴァニカの裏切りだけでなく、\nアンウェン様まで何を仰せか:
W-What do you mean?!
Not only Vanika's betrayal, but what is Your Highness Anwen saying now?!
m200588.なっ……誰だ！？:
I came because I was called.
...Though it would be rude not to give my name.
m200588.ならば話が早い。\n――王子よ、天眼ノ国と手を切り、我が国につけ。:
Then let's get straight to it.
――Prince, cut ties with the Eye of Heaven and pledge your allegiance to my nation.
m200588.なるほど、それが答えか。\nならば――戦うしかあるまいな。:
I see. That is your answer.
Then there is no choice but to fight.
m200588.はぁ～……「天眼核」かぁ……。\nこれどうなってるんだろうね？\nずーっと動きっ:
Haa~…… The "Eye of Heaven Core"……
I wonder what's going on with it?
It's been running non-stop the whole time, you know?
m200588.はい。ドラゴンの国は、\n天眼のヴィマーナに匹敵する巨竜の背に、\n竜都を乗せた: Yes. The Dragon Nation continuously moves while carrying their capital on the back of a giant dragon comparable to the Eye of Heaven's Vimana.
m200588.はいはい、行きますよ姫様。\n遠くにいたら、姫様が倒れたとき、\n誰が回収しにい:
Yes, yes, I'll go, Your Highness.
If I stay far away, who will come retrieve you
when you fall?
m200588.ひぃ、ふぅ、はぁ……。\nね、寝返ります。こっちにいれてくださいっ！:
Hii, phew, haah…
Okay, I'm switching sides! Please let me in!
m200588.ふぅ……流石は音に聞く名探偵、\n中々心臓に悪い提案をしてくれる。:
Phew… As expected of the famous detective whose name is on everyone's lips.
You certainly make suggestions that give one a heart attack.
m200588.ふっ、ふふふ……。\nやはり王子こそ、長らくくすぶってきた\nこの世界を駆け抜け:
Heh, hehehe…….
As expected, you are the Prince,
the single gale that has long been brewing
to race through this world!
m200588.ふふふ、あたしの前菜とスープに、\nオーガスタのメインディッシュ、\nそのあとに:
Hehe, my appetizer and soup,
Augusta's main course,
and then Azumi's gentle dessert!
m200588.まぁ、王族なんてしがらみだらけだろ。\n捕虜になったときくらい、\n腹いっぱい好:
Well, royalty is all tied up in rules and regulations.
I think it's only fair she can eat whatever she wants while she's a prisoner.
m200588.まぁ、見たら死ぬは言い過ぎだと思うけど……。\nスカベンジャー仲間も、あの国が飛:
Well, "you die if you look" is a bit of an exaggeration, I think...
But my Scavenger buddies said that if that country showed up, the priority would be to run.
m200588.まずはセバスティア大佐を捕まえる、話はそれからだ。: First, we capture Colonel Sebastia. We'll deal with the rest after.
m200588.まったく、しつこい女だな。レストレイン警備局長。: What a persistent woman. Director Restrain.
m200588.もう演技は止めていいですよ。\nヴァニカ、よく貴族院連中を探ってくれました。\n:
You can drop the act now.
Vanika, you did a great job scouting the Noble Council.
Their plot to invite foreign interference is a dead certainty now! Well done!
m200588.やはり警備局長として承服できかねます。\nこの者は必ず、法廷に立たせねばならない:
I cannot accept that as the Director of the Bureau.
This woman must stand before a court of law.
m200588.やめておけ。\n大勢は決した。あとは意地の問題だ。:
Hold back.
The outcome is decided. This is merely a matter of pride.
m200588.やれやれ……。\nさて、せっかく王女サマを捕虜に取ったんだ。\nゆっくりじっくり:
Well, well……
Since we've captured the princess,
let's take our time and squeeze every last secret out of her.
m200588.ゆえに、最強の国家。\n確かに戦闘能力だけなら、あるいは\n得体のしれなさだけな:
And so, the strongest nation.
There may be countries that rival them in combat power, or in sheer unpredictability, but—
m200588.わらわの配下でもなし、\n我が軍を天眼ノ国へ招き入れた貴族院の馬鹿どもが\n慌て:
She is no subject of mine.
If the fools in the Noble Council who invited my army into the Land of the Heavenly Eye are just panicking, I don't care in the least.
m200588.わらわはアンウェン。\nそなたが、異世界の王子だな？:
I am Anwen.
You are the Prince from another world, are you not?
m200588.ん……何を言っているんだ？\n叫んでいるようにも見えるが……。:
Hm… What is she saying?
She looks like she's screaming, but…
m200588.ん……？ おい、商人の姉ちゃんがこっちくるぞ？\n斬っていいのか？:
Hm? Hey, that merchant lady is coming this way.
Can I cut her down?
m200588.アンウェン様、そろそろ抜けてもよろしいですか？: Your Highness Anwen, may I withdraw now?
m200588.クレールは右！ アタシは左！: Krehl, go right! I'll take the left!
m200588.クーデターではありません。\n正式に講和派多数で議決したのですから、\nあなた方:
This is not a coup.
The peace faction holds the majority and voted accordingly.
You simply lost.
m200588.シャルロット、手を貸して。\n頼れそうな人材はどれだけ使ってもいいよ。:
Charlotte, lend me a hand.
Use as many people as you need.
m200588.セバスティア大佐は、今ここで殺すべきだ。: Colonel Sebastia should be killed right here, right now.
m200588.トドメはいいのか？: Is it okay to deliver the finishing blow?
m200588.ドラゴンの国っていうと……。\n近付いたら死ぬ、見たら死ぬ、\n最強の戦闘国家っ:
The Dragon Nation, huh...
The one where you die if you get close, you die if you look, and they're the strongest military power?
m200588.ドラゴンの国の王女よ、\nこの戦いに意義はあるのか！\n天眼核とやら、そちらにと:
Princess of the Dragon Nation,
is there any meaning to this battle!
What benefit does this Eye of Heaven Core bring you!
m200588.メイドは主に似るのです。\nでは、よき戦いを。:
A maid takes after her master.
Well then, fight well.
m200588.一ついいかな、局長。: May I have a word, Director?
m200588.一騎打ちで負けそうになっても、\n命乞いどころか、背後の誰かを守ろうとするかのよ:
Even when on the verge of defeat in single combat,
he does not beg for his life.
Instead, as if to protect someone behind him,
he closes the distance and resists.
m200588.下手したら、爆発したりして！: It could explode if we're not careful!
m200588.事前に伝えたはずだが？\nわらわとそなたは、同じ敵がいるというだけ。\n協力では:
I should have told you beforehand, didn't I?
You and I merely share a common enemy.
This is a rivalry, not a partnership.
m200588.伝説上の話ですが、\nかつて天眼のヴィマーナが、\n大地を割り、海を作ったという:
Legend has it that in the past,
the Eye of Heaven's vimanas
split the earth and created the seas.
m200588.似たような顔をしているだろう。\n平気そうなのはアナベラだけだ。:
You're probably making a similar face.
Anabella is the only one who seems calm.
m200588.何か言おうとしていただろう？\n服従の呪いを解くほうが優先だ。:
You were about to say something, weren't you?
Breaking the curse of submission is the priority.
m200588.何を、どれだけ背負えば、\nそこまで意地を張れるようになるのだろうな。:
What must one carry, and how much,
to become so stubborn?
m200588.剣の腕も、平和な時代に鍛えたような、\nひどく丁寧な基礎の上に、\n実戦で磨いた:
His swordsmanship is built on a foundation
honed in peaceful times,
layered with the rough techniques of actual combat.
m200588.呼ばれたから来たのだがなぁ。\n――とはいえ、名を名乗らぬのも無礼か。:
???: I came because I was called.
――Though it would be rude not to introduce myself.
m200588.喧嘩を売られたんだ、買うしかないだろう。\n王子、避けようのない戦いだ。\n王国:
They've picked a fight, so we have no choice but to take it.
Prince, this is a battle we cannot avoid.

m300130.ですが見たところ、フェネクスは強力な再生能力を\n使っているのか、徐々に弱ってい: However, from what I can see, the Phoenix seems to be using its regeneration, yet it's gradually weakening.
m300130.では、せんえつながら、まずは私から……。\n行かせていただきます……スイカ割り！: Alright, I'll go first… Here we go… watermelon smashing!
m300130.では早速、皆で割って食べましょう。\nここ最近、魔物の討伐が続いてますし、兵達の: Then let's split it right away and eat. We've been hunting monsters nonstop lately, so let's enjoy a vacation together to lift the troops' spirits!
m300130.どうやら魔物を退けることはできたようだな。\nなかなかの指揮だったぞ、王子。: It looks like we managed to drive the monster away. That was some impressive command, Prince.
m300130.な、何とか……すべての敵を倒せたようですね。\nそれにしても、ここ一年で戦ってき: W-we… somehow managed to defeat all of them. Still, after a year of fighting, to have all those foes assault us at once…
m300130.なに、砲弾の一発や二発、どうと言うことはない！\nエルミラさえよければ、私はまだ: What's a one or two shells? No big deal! As long as Elmira's fine, I can keep training.
m300130.なーんだ、夢の話か。\n現実じゃないんだし、そんなに感動しても\n仕方ないでしょ: Oh, it's just a dream. It's not real, so there's no point getting all worked up about it!
m300130.ねえねえ、ちょっと聞いてエレイン。\n今朝ね、王子といっぱい魔物討伐の訓練をして: Hey, hey, listen up, Elaine. This morning I trained a ton with the Prince, and I had this amazing dream where I became super strong!
m300130.ねえバシラ、一つくらい余ってたりしないの？: Hey Bashira, do you have any left over?
m300130.はぁ……せっかくスイカが食べられると思ってたのに、\n魔物になって逃げていっちゃ: Sigh… I was looking forward to eating watermelon, and it turns into a monster and runs away. Unbelievable.
m300130.はい！ \nおかげで、最高の実戦訓練となりました。\nこれでもっともっと強くなれ:
Yes!
Thanks to that, it was the best real-combat training.
I feel like we can become even stronger now!
m300130.ふふ。皆さん元気になったみたいで良かったです。\nさあ、王子も皆と一緒に楽しみま: Hehe, I'm glad everyone's feeling better. Come on, Prince, join us and have fun. The vacation has only just begun!
m300130.ふふふ、この奥にアイギスの神殿があるのですね。\n滅びた女神ごときがこの様な場所: Hehehe, so the Temple of Aegis lies deep within… To think a fallen goddess is worshipped in a place like this… How obnoxious. I'll crush it thoroughly.
m300130.ふふふ。\n力なき神に仕える愚かなる王子とその仲間たちよ。\n貴方たちが人間にし: Hehehe. Foolish Prince and his companions who serve a powerless god. I'll concede that you're unusually strong for humans.
m300130.ふふ～ん♪ \n砲術士の士官学校を首席で卒業した\nあたしの腕前、しっかりと見せ: Hehe~♪ I graduated at the top of the Artillery Academy, so I'll be sure to show off my skill!
m300130.ふむ、さすがは東方の国に伝わる伝統的な遊具だ。\nこれならば訓練にもなるし、親睦: Hmm, as expected of the traditional toys from the Eastern lands. It's good for training and builds camaraderie… Now it's the Prince's turn!
m300130.ほ、報告！\n魔物の傷が瞬時に回復し、\nどれだけ攻撃を行っても倒すことが出来ま:
Re-report!
The monster's wounds heal instantly, no matter how much we attack, we can't bring it down…!
m300130.ほ、本当ですか！？\nこうしてはいられないです！\n王子！ すぐに私との訓練に付: R-really!? I can't just sit around! Prince, please train with me right now!
m300130.ほう、見習い卒業の為の卒業研究というわけですな？\nいいでしょう。\n王国魔術師: Ah, so this is your graduation research for finishing your apprenticeship? Very well. As the kingdom's mage, I'll lend a hand!
m300130.ま、待って下さいメルさん！\nすぐに用意しますから置いていかないで下さい！: Wait, please, Mel! I'll get ready right away, so don't leave me behind!
m300130.ま、魔物っ……！？\n王子、戦いのご準備を！\nせっかくの皆のバカンスが台無しに: W-well, monster…! Prince, prepare for battle! We can't let everyone's vacation be ruined!
m300130.まぁいいでしょう。貴方から力を取り返した\n酒呑童子様は、既に完全な姿に戻られた: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Very well. Having taken back his power, Shuten-doji has already returned to his true form.
m300130.やっと新しい器に慣れてきたスイ。\n早速ビフロンス様のもとに行くでスイ。: Finally getting used to this new vessel, Sui. Heading straight to Lord Bifrons now.
m300130.よ～し、これで一通りの訓練は終わりよ！\n帝国の砲撃技術もすごく参考になったし、: Alright, that wraps up the whole training! The Empire's artillery tech was super useful, and it looks like we both got a lot out of it!
m300130.ウソ、でしょ……！？\nあの巨大な板で砲弾を叩き落とすなんて……！\n特注品……: No way…! Hitting a cannonball with that huge board… Is it a custom piece?
m300130.キャリーさん、すごく嬉しそう……。\n何だか私達も強くなれる気がしてきたよ！\n:
Carrie-san, you look so happy…
I'm getting the feeling we can get stronger too!
—Wait, what's up, Elaine?
m300130.ダニエラさん、見つけましたよ！\nあの緑と黒の果物がそうですよね？\nスイカとい: Daniela, I found it! That green-and-black fruit, right? Is it called a watermelon?
m300130.ダニエラさんもバシラさんも元気を出して下さい！\nせっかく水着になったことですし: Daniela and Bashira, cheer up! Since we're finally in swimsuits, let's shake off the gloom and enjoy our vacation!
m300130.ファルネさん、何か分かったのですか？: Farne-san, did you figure something out?
m300130.フィリスさん、そんなに慌てて一体どうしたのですか！？\nイロハさん達に教わった風: Phyllis, why are you in such a hurry? Weren't you the one most interested in the customs Iroha and the others taught us?
m300130.フェネクス……？\nあの鳥のような魔物はいったい何なのですか？:
Phoenix…? 
What on earth is that bird-like monster?
m300130.フェネクスが自ら滅びるまで耐えるか、\nフェネクスを倒すか、\n指揮をお願いいた: Please give the order—either endure until the Phoenix destroys itself, or strike it down.
m300130.フェネクスは再生する度に強くなるという伝承があるの。\nだからこそ、あえて自ら死: Legend says the Phoenix grows stronger each time it regenerates. So perhaps it deliberately threw itself into a death zone to gain overwhelming power!
m300130.レアンさん……あの、本当に大丈夫ですか？\n途中で何発か被弾していたように\n見: Leon… um, are you really okay? It seemed like you got hit a few times along the way…
m300130.レアンさん、ここ二日ほどは食べては寝てを\n繰り返してたし、きっと体力が有り余っ: Leon, you've been eating and sleeping nonstop for the past two days, so it's no wonder you have energy to spare. Anyway, we should get ready to leave before we leave you behind~?
m300130.一刻も早く『ハツモーデ』というものを、\n止めるように仲間たちに通達するんだ！: Tell everyone to stop whatever this “Hatsumode” thing is, ASAP!
m300130.丁度、魔物が現れたみたいですね。: Looks like a monster just showed up.
m300130.久しいですね、アイギス。\nですが、とうに肉体は滅び、死者同然のあなたと\n話す: It's been a long time, Aegis. But your body has long since perished—you're practically dead, so there's nothing left for us to discuss.
m300130.今まで力試しの相手として刃を交えてきた王子に\nこうして助けを願い求めるのが筋違: I know it's out of line for me, the Prince who's always sparred with me, to be begging for help like this… But I have to save my comrades, no matter what.
m300130.傷だらけとはいえ、あの軍勢を退けるとは……。\nまあいいでしょう。\nこれはほん: Even bruised, you repelled that army… Very well. Consider this just a greeting.
m300130.全ては酒呑童子様の命令ゆえ……くっくっく。\n鬼の一族でありながら、酒呑童子様か: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: It's all on Shuten-doji's orders… heh heh heh. Even though you're a demon clan, you dare to break away from Shuten-doji and gather allies… Stop this childish game.
m300130.分かりました。\nでは、今後も王子の身をお守りください。\nそして、力を合わせて: Understood. Then continue to protect you, Prince, and together we'll end the fight against the monsters.
m300130.分かりました。\n王子、フェネクスの復活に備えて\n準備を進めておきましょう。: Understood. Prince, let's prepare for the Phoenix's return.
m300130.帰還か。個人的にはまだまだ物足りないのだがな。: Heading home, huh? Personally, I'm still not satisfied.
m300130.我が父……酒呑童子の配下の鬼達が\n巡回しているから注意してください。: My father… the demons serving Shuten-doji are patrolling, so be careful.
m300130.早くビフロンス様のもとに行かなければ\nならないのに……。奴らが近づけない様、\: I have to get to Lord Bifrons quickly… I'll fling the seeds as far as possible so they can't get close!
m300130.気にしないでください。鬼刃姫さん。\nさぁ、鬼刃衆を助けに行きましょう。\n王子: Don't worry about it, Kibahime. Let's go rescue the Demon Blade troops. Prince, please be extra careful of those patrolling demons!
m300130.気持ちは分かりますが、このままでは\nゴールドが無くなって王国の軍備を\n整えら: I understand the sentiment, but if we keep doing this we might run out of gold and be unable to equip the kingdom's forces…
m300130.水着……そうね！ せっかく王子と海に来たんだもの。\n楽しまなくちゃ損よね♪\n: Swimsuits… that's right! We finally came to the sea with the Prince. We'd be missing out if we don't have fun♪ Then, Bashira, let's go!
m300130.王子……。\nケラウノス様は、アダマス様の肉体が魔界にある\nと仰っていましたが: Prince… Keraunos said Adamas's body is in the Demon Realm—what does that even mean?
m300130.王子、どうやらここが報告にあった\n魔界アリの巣のようですね。: Prince, it seems this is the demonic ant nest mentioned in the report.
m300130.王子、急いでプリンセスの方々を止めましょう！: Prince, we have to stop the princesses right away!
m300130.王子、数多の魔物が、次々と召喚されています！\nすぐに戦いの準備をお願い致します: Prince, countless monsters are being summoned one after another! Please, prepare for battle at once!
m300130.王子、魔物の再生能力は、\nフェネクスを倒さなければ無効化できないでしょう。: Prince, the monster's regeneration can only be nullified if we defeat the Phoenix.
m300130.王子軍のヘビーアーマーをなめないでよね？\nそれに今日は『ハゴイタ』とかいうのを: Don't underestimate the Prince's heavy armor, alright? Besides, we've got that “Hagoita” thing today, so it'll work out. Fire!!—
m300130.王子！ アンナさん！\nまずいぞ、このままでは大変なことになってしまう！: Prince! Anna! This is bad, if we keep going like this something terrible will happen!
m300130.皆がスムーズに出撃できるよう、\nまずは、私たちワルキューレが先陣を切ります！\: To make sure everyone can deploy smoothly, we'll Valkyries go in first! So everyone else, please wait a moment!
m300130.皆さんが善意から行ったことだと分かってます。\nそれに、本当に加護があるかもしれ: I know you all meant well. And who knows, maybe the blessings are real!
m300130.砲兵の皆さん！\n本日は白の帝国の砲撃兵との合同訓練ですので、\n互いに実りある: Artillerymen! Today's joint training is with the White Empire's bombardiers, so let's cooperate and make it a productive exercise!
m300130.確かに伝え聞いていた魔神フェネクスにしては、\nあまりにも呆気なさ過ぎたわ……。: Indeed, for the demon god Phoenix we'd heard of, it was far too… underwhelming.
m300130.確たる証拠はないけれど、\nフェネクスが自ら傷つきに来たのだとしたら、\n完全な: I have no concrete proof, but if the Phoenix came to wound itself, it's likely aiming for a full resurrection.
m300130.私もそう聞きました。だから神への感謝をここで示し、\nより大きな加護を王子に与え: I heard that too. So we were tossing gold here to demonstrate our thanks and to receive greater blessings for you, Prince…
m300130.貴方が王子と共に在るならば、関わる人間すべてが\n滅されるのも時間の問題でしょう: If you're with the Prince, it's only a matter of time before everyone involved gets wiped out. Well then… until we meet again… heh heh heh.
m300130.貴方たちの頼みのアイギスは既に力を失い、\nその妹アダマスの肉体も魔界に捕らわれ: The Aegis you depend on has already lost its power, and even Adamas's body is trapped in the Demon Realm... That's right, all we can do now is wait for destruction, hehe.
m300130.鬼刃姫さん……。\n私たちも協力します！\n何かあれば、また声をかけてください。: Kibahime… We'll help too! If you need anything, just call on us.
m300130.鬼刃姫さん、\n部下の鬼刃衆が捕まっているというのは、\nこの場所なのですか？: Kibahime, is this the place where our subordinates, the Demon Blade troops, are being held?
m300130.鬼刃衆！ 助けにきたわよ！\n外の鬼達は全員ぶっ倒したんだからねっ！: Demon Blade troops! I'm here to save you! I've already taken down every demon outside!
m300130.魔物の掃滅を確認しました。\n王子、ご協力ありがとうございました！:
Monster sweep confirmed.
Prince, thanks for your cooperation!
m300130.魔物の撤退を確認ッ！\n周囲にはもう敵はいません！: Monster retreat confirmed! No enemies remain around!
m300130.（鬼刃衆……あてが力を奪われたあの時、\nあてを逃がす為に、命をかけてくれた恩は: The Demon Blade troops… when they were stripped of their power, they risked their lives to let me escape. I'll definitely repay that debt…)

m300399.――ありますよ。\n千年戦争時代の建材でできていて、\n英雄王が関わり、当時その: —There is. Made from the war's building material, the Hero King was involved, and it's been resurrected just as it was.
m300399.――これより、俺たちは歴史改変の仕上げにかかる。: From here on out, we'll finish the history rewrite.
m300399.――なるほど、歴史そのものを\n書き換える手段をあちらは持っている、と。: —I see, they have a way to rewrite history itself.
m300399.――俺は、死んでもいいと思っていた。: I thought I could die without a second thought.
m300399.――王城へ、乗り込むか。\n街の住人の話じゃ、王子不在だっていうのに、\n王城に: ――Should we storm the royal castle? The townsfolk say the Prince's gone, but it seems the ruler's still inside.
m300399.……いえ、待ってください。\nこの気配……アイギス神殿が包囲されています！: …No, wait. I feel a presence… Aegis Temple is under siege!
m300399.……そう、ですね。\n不安がっていても、何も変わりません。\n王子、私たちも行動: …That's right. Worrying won't change anything. Prince, let's get moving, too.
m300399.……それでは王子、皆さん、\n此度の戦いも、お疲れ様でした。:
…Then, Prince, everyone,
thank you for this battle.
m300399.……でも、ちょっと待って。\n数年、十数年くらいなら、\n時の魔術で遡ることもで: …But wait. If it's only a few years, maybe a decade, we could go back with time magic…
m300399.……迷ってる暇はないだろ。\n異世界の救援は、あいつらに任せたんだ。\n俺たちは: …We don't have time to hesitate. The rescue from the other world is left to them. We should do what we can, on our own.
m300399.えぇ、何しろ「時間」と「歴史」そのものが、\n大きく変わってしまったようですから: Yeah, “time” and “history” themselves have been drastically altered…
m300399.えーっと、よく分かってないんですけど……。\nれきし？ が変わるって、どういうこ: Um, I don't really get it… History changing—what does that even mean?
m300399.おそらくですが、何者かの手によって、\n過去が書き換えられてしまったのかと。: My guess is someone rewrote the past.
m300399.お礼なんていらないですよ。\nだって、仲間、ですからね。:
No need to thank me.
After all, we're comrades.
m300399.きっと、眩く輝く未来に、たどり着きましょうね。: Surely we'll reach a future that shines brightly.
m300399.こちらはそれに対し、時間遡行後、\n武力で対抗するしかない、という状況ですね。: In our case, after traveling back in time, we have no choice but to meet force with force.
m300399.この世界にはお前が、オリジナルがいる。\nお前にならば、未来を任せることができる: In this world, there's an original you. If it's you, I can entrust the future to you.
m300399.この世界の運命を、皆さんに委ねます。\nどうかよろしくお願いします！: I entrust the fate of this world to all of you. Please, take good care of it!
m300399.この魔力が尽きた時、\n俺はこの世界から消滅するだろう。: When that magic runs out, I'll vanish from this world.
m300399.ごちそうも、たくさん用意しましょう。\nモンスター娘さんに、城娘さん、\n今回は:
We'll also prepare plenty of food.
To the monster girls, the castle girls—this time we were helped by a great many people.
m300399.さぁ、時空の歪みが訪れるぞ。\n次に気付いた時には、ひとつ歴史改変の進んだ未来だ: Now the distortion of time and space is arriving. When you notice it again, it'll be a future where history's been altered by one step.
m300399.さて、それじゃあ３つの時代に向かうわよ！\n英傑の塔まで、案内してちょうだい！: Alright, then let's head to the three eras! Guide us to the Hero's Tower!
m300399.するはずがない、と言いたいのだろう？\n俺とて、お前が消えるような改変は望まなか: You want to say I'd never do that, don't you? Even I didn't want a change that would erase you.
m300399.そして改変のターニングポイントは、\nダーク王子の言っていた３つの時代ね。: And the turning point of the alteration is the three eras the Dark Prince mentioned.
m300399.その過去そのものが変わってしまえば、\nその影響が、この時代に反映されてしまうん: If that past itself changes, its effects ripple into the present.
m300399.それにしても、アイギス神殿が無事で良かったですねー。\nお外はもう、見たこと無い: Still, it's a relief the Aegis Temple held up. Outside's turned into something I've never seen, and the gate's all unstable.
m300399.そんなことはさせない、とでも言いたそうだな。\n……俺の部下たちも、お前と同じ顔: You sound like you'd say, “I won't let that happen.” …Even my subordinates wore the same face as you.
m300399.だから、お前が神にでも挑む時、\nこの命の全てを燃やして、\nそこで生を終えるの: So when you decide to challenge the gods, I figured I'd burn everything I have and end my life right there—that's my fate.
m300399.と、殿さん！ ずっと頭を撫でていたんですか！？: Lord! You've been patting my head this whole time!?
m300399.ところで、皆さんお時間はありますか？\nせっかくですし、少し王国でゆっくりされて:
By the way, does anyone have a moment?
Since we're here, why not take it easy in the kingdom for a bit…?
m300399.どうしてそんなことを……。: How could something like that happen…?
m300399.はい、英傑の塔です。\nあの塔ならば、英雄王のいる千年戦争当時まで、\n良い目印: Yes, the Hero's Tower. That tower should serve as a good marker back to the Hero King's era during the war.
m300399.ひとつ、王都陥落の再演。: First, a reenactment of the capital's fall.
m300399.ふぅ……逆召喚完了です。\nみんな無事に、あっちの世界へ行ったかとー。: Phew… the reverse summoning's complete. Looks like everyone made it safely to the other side.
m300399.ふたつ、お前がまだ幼かった頃の時代。: Second, the era when you were still a child.
m300399.みっつ、千年戦争、その決戦の瞬間。: Three—the Millennium War, the moment of decisive battle.
m300399.みんな、準備はいいですか？\n意思を強く持って、それから帰る場所を忘れないように: Everyone, ready? Keep your resolve strong, and don't forget where you'll return to.
m300399.ようやく目覚めたようですね。\n皆、無事に英傑の塔へ戻ってきましたよ。:
It seems you've finally woken up.
Everyone has safely returned to the Hero's Tower.
m300399.よーし、じゃあいってらっしゃーい。\n異界の門、開放！: Alright, then—see you off. The gate to the other world is opening!
m300399.わぁっ、いいんですか！？\nあ、あのっ、王子さんの書庫をぜひ見せてほしくて！:
Wow, is that okay!?
Um, I'd really love to see the Prince's library!
m300399.今この時代に存在するあらゆるモノは、\n過去に起きた出来事の積み重ねです。: Everything that exists in this era is the sum of past events.
m300399.今は女神アイギス様の力で、\n王子と、私達一部の王国軍は守られていますが……。: Right now, thanks to the goddess Aegis's power, the Prince and a few of us in the kingdom's forces are being protected…
m300399.何かないのか？\n千年前のワインとか、すごい古い武器とか……。: Is there nothing? Like a thousand-year-old wine or some ancient weapon…
m300399.俺たちは、この世界を根本から書き換える。\nだから王子、俺を追ってこい。: We'll rewrite this world from the ground up. So, Prince, come after me.
m300399.俺たちは、ひとつだ。\n光と影、表と裏、決して切り離せぬ写し鏡の魂。\nお前が俺: We're one—light and shadow, front and back, inseparable mirrored souls. If you walk the same fate as me, what will you do?
m300399.俺の身体には、魔王ガリウスの影が残した、\n魔力の残滓が宿っている。: My body still bears the lingering magic left by the Demon King Garius.
m300399.分かってくれた、か。\n同じ俺同士だ、伝わると信じていた。\nお前の部下たちは、: So you get it, huh? We're the same now; I believed you'd understand. Your subordinates don't seem to get it, though.
m300399.千年ワイン――は銘柄だしなぁ。\n古の武器……そうだ、王子の武器はどうだ？: A thousand-year wine is a brand, huh. Ancient weapons… what about the Prince's weapon?
m300399.千年戦争は、時の目印になるものがないわ。\n王子の血筋をたどるにしても、\n英雄: The Millennium War has no temporal markers. Even tracing the Prince's bloodline is too far removed from the Hero King's era…
m300399.向こうから仕掛けてくるなら好都合。\n事件の黒幕まで、一気に辿らせてもらいましょ: If they're the ones making the first move, that works in our favor. Let's track down the mastermind behind this whole incident in one go.
m300399.城娘さんたちも、\nお城の記憶を持っているのですか？: Do the castle maidens also hold the memory of the castle?

m300399.比較的異界の門が安定しやすい場所ですが、\nそれでも、大きな衝撃があるはずです。: This spot tends to keep the otherworld gate stable, but there'll still be a huge shock. Oh, and holding hands might help.
m300399.汝の刻は……必ず正しき道へ向かう。\n歪んだ定めは、正されるべきじゃ……。: Your time will... inevitably lead you down the right path. A twisted destiny must be set right...

m300399.王子を消滅させるため、かもしれません。\n目的は不明ですが、たしかに先程、\n王: To erase the Prince, perhaps. The motive's unclear, but just now his shadow was fading…
m300399.王都陥落――つまり魔物の復活したあの日。: The fall of the capital—i.e., the day the monsters revived.

m300399.諦めたりしないようにね。\nまぁ、あなたなら、そんな事はないだろうけれど。: Don't give up, okay? …Well, I doubt you'd do that anyway.

m400378.――くっ、予を誰だと思っている！\nえぇい、離れろ！ 不敬だと思わぬか！:
――Damn, who do you think I am!
Hey, get back! Don't you think that's disrespectful!
m400378.――はい？\n兜とモンスター娘さんのコピーが暴れている、ですか？:
――Huh?
So the copies of the helmet and that monster girl are running amok?
m400378.――ま、待たれよ！\n予にもその調査、手伝わせてくれまいか！: —W-wait a moment! Let me help with the investigation too!
m400378.――王子、魔物の出現原因が分かりました。\nどうやらこの奥に発生した、\n時空の:
――Prince, we've identified the cause of the monsters' appearance.
It seems a distortion of space-time that formed deeper inside is connecting to another location.
m400378.……それって、どちらも異世界由来よね？\nまさか、アイギス神殿が異世界に繋がって: …Both of those are from another world, right? Could it be that the Aegis Temple is linked to another world?
m400378.……ま、まおーじょー、ですか？\n変わったお名前ですね……。\nではマオージョー: …M-Maōjō, is it? That's an unusual name… Then I'll call you Maōjō-san.
m400378.……アイギス神殿の近くに生じた時空の歪み、\nこのまま放置しておくわけにはいきま: …A space-time distortion that appeared near the Aegis Temple—we can't just leave it unchecked.
m400378.うむ、かたじけない。\n予の名は魔王城という。どうか、よろしく頼む。: Indeed, thank you. My name is Maōjō. I look forward to working with you.
m400378.えぇ、それにこれまでに観測したことのない、\n巨大な魔力の波動も感じられます。: Yes, and we also detect a massive magical energy pulse we've never observed before.
m400378.えぇと……歪みの向こうに、\n予の知人がいるかもしれないのだ！: Umm… beyond the distortion, there might be an acquaintance of mine!
m400378.それでは王子、調査隊の編成をお願いします！: Then, Prince, please form the investigation team!
m400378.なるほど……そういうことでしたら……。\nですが、この先は何が起きるか分かりませ: I see… If that's the case… However, we don't know what might happen ahead. Please don't stray from us, okay?
m400378.は、はい、前線からの確かな情報です。\nアイギス神殿付近に出現した魔物の群れの中:
Y-yes, that's solid intel from the front lines.
Among the horde of monsters that appeared near the Aegis Temple, there are copies of that helmet and that monster girl mixed in!
m400378.はぁ……はぁ……。\n目覚めたばかりだというのに、\nまさかこんな目にあうとは…:
Haa… haa…
I just woke up, and to think I'd end up like this…
m400378.もしそうなら一大事です。\n誰も巻き込まれていないと良いのですが……。:
If that's true, it's a huge problem.
I hope no one gets caught up in this…
m400378.ん、あぁ、いや……。\n先程までこの神殿で昼寝をしていたのだ。\nそれより、助け:
Hmm, ah, no… I was just napping in this temple a moment ago.
More importantly, let me thank you for saving me.
m400378.モンスター娘のコピーの方は……。\nああ、あの不思議な見た目をした、\nふわふわ: As for the monster-girl copy… Ah, that strange-looking, fluffy thing, uh, what was it called?
m400378.兜と言えば、城娘さんたちのいる、\n日ノ本に出没する魔物の類、でしたよね？: Speaking of the helmet, that's the kind of monster that shows up in Hinomoto where the castle girls are, right?
m400378.悪い予感が的中しましたね……。\n王子、誰かが襲われています！\n急ぎ救出に向か:
My bad feeling was right…
Prince, someone's being attacked!
Let's hurry to rescue them!
m400378.時空の歪み……異界の門とは違うのですか？: Space-time distortion… Is that different from an otherworldly gate?
m400378.王子、調査隊を編成し、\n歪みの向こう側で何が起きているのか調べるべきかと――: Prince, we should form a scouting party and investigate what's on the other side of the distortion—
m400378.（でも妖怪っぽい気配は感じないなぁ……。\n通りすがりの、ちょっと気配が怪しい女:
(But I don't sense any yokai vibe…
Maybe just a passing girl with a suspicious aura?)
m400378.（どうにも、不思議な雰囲気の方ですね。\nどこか我々のような付喪神、\nあるいは:
(There's something oddly mysterious about them.
I sense a vibe similar to our tsukumogami, or maybe the castle girls from another world.)

m400461.――とうとう、決別の時か。\n我が物顔でオリュンポスに出入りしながら、\n敵であ:
—At last, the time of parting has come.
I've been coming and going to Olympus as I please, and yet that amusing fellow openly declares himself my enemy.

—Well then, let's let you taste a bit of that power.
Prince, see how much you've honed your strength since that day.
m400461.――無謀なる破滅に突き進みながらも、\nそれを理解できぬ、夢しか見られぬ人類のあ: —while humanity rushes toward reckless ruin, unable to comprehend it, seeing only dreams.
m400461.――王子、失礼します！\n負傷兵の治療、完了しました！\n戦える者はすべて、整列:
—Prince, excuse me!
The wounded have been treated!
All combat-ready troops are assembled!
m400461.……あの怒らせたら手がつけられないロタンが、\n大人しく遅滞戦闘なんてしてるかし: …I wonder if that enraged Rotan, who's impossible to handle when angry, would actually sit still for a prolonged fight.
m400461.……いや、余を見限ったとでも言いたいのだろうな。: …No, you must think you've given up on me.
m400461.……その結論こそ間違いであると、\n突きつけてやらねばなるまいな。: …I must confront him and prove that conclusion is wrong.
m400461.……戦闘状態、というわけではないのね？: …So we're not actually in a combat state yet?

…Prince, you're blessed with fine soldiers.
That cat-eared girl instantly eased everyone's tension.
m400461.……魔王城周辺に、お宝なんてないわよ？\n天界の勢力も金銭に興味なさそうだし……:
…There's no treasure around the Demon Castle.
The Heaven forces don't seem interested in money either…
m400461.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となるため、\n敵戦力を削ることを最優先とし、\n: Since the stage clears even if your life hits zero, cutting down enemy forces is top priority—let's forge a path forward.
m400461.あなたと、王国軍の力を信じています。\nどうか、魔界と、私のロタンをよろしくお願:
I trust you and the might of the kingdom's army.
Please, see to the Demon Realm—and my Rotan.
m400461.ぐぬぬ、やっぱり\nEXPもゴールドもドロップ品もなしかぁ！: Grrr, so there's no EXP, no gold, no drops either!
m400461.そのため、可能な限り\n『多くの敵を倒すこと』を目的としたミッションとなります。: Therefore, the mission is to defeat as many enemies as possible.

m400461.それだけの戦力が相手ならば、\n大部隊による「広域戦闘」となりそうですね……。: If they're fielding that much strength, it'll turn into a large-scale, wide-area battle…
m400461.ただ、ここは魔界の中でも、\n物質界との補給路から離れた地点です。\nよって、出:
But this is a spot deep in the Demon Realm, far from any supply lines to the material world.
Thus, deployment costs won't recover over time.
m400461.ところでぇ、前回の魔王城じゃ、\nお宝をこっそりいただけなかったわけだがぁ……。:
By the way, at the last Demon Castle we couldn't sneak any treasure away…
This time, can we just take all the gold and riches?
m400461.ん、そうね……。\n小規模な戦闘は起きていたけど、\n基本的には包囲を狭めつつあ: Right… Small skirmishes have broken out, but overall they're just tightening the siege.
m400461.ルキファよ、魔王城へ向かうぞ。\n憎き三女神の力、少々形は異なるが、\nこの手に:
Lukifer, we're heading to the Demon King's castle.
The hated power of the three goddesses—though its form differs slightly—shall be reclaimed by my hand.
m400461.代わり、というわけでもありませんが、\n三女神の力の残滓は健在の様子。\n魔界の:
Not that it replaces anything, but the remnants of the Three Goddesses' power are still intact.
We should be able to avoid the demonic miasma.
m400461.変化も衰退も進歩もない、\n安寧と停滞の時代を望む余のあり方と――: My desire for an age of peace and stagnation—no change, no decline, no progress—
m400461.心配、ですね……。\nあの子が無事なら、\nきっと大乱戦になっているはずですから: That's worrisome… If that kid makes it out okay, the battle will surely have erupted into chaos.

Everyone in the stealth unit, thanks for the reconnaissance.
How's the area around the Demon King's Castle?
m400461.潜入作戦をするにも、\n包囲の密度が高すぎる感じでしたねぇ。\nこれはもう、正面:
Even if we tried an infiltration, the encirclement is just too dense.
Looks like we have no choice but to go in head-on.
m400461.王国の、王子。\n愚かな創造神の被造物め、\nせっかく成長の機会を与えてやってい:
Prince of the kingdom.
Foolish creation of the Creator—though I gave you a chance to grow…
m400461.王子、此度の戦いの目的は\n魔王城へ到達することにあります。: Prince, the objective of this battle is to reach the Demon King's Castle.
m400461.私たちワルキューレや、援軍要請のスキルを持つ方を\n部隊に編成する必要がありそう:
We'll need to field Valkyries and anyone with reinforcement-calling skills in our squad.
Prince, please assemble the forces carefully!
m400461.英雄たらんとする者が、余に挑むのだという。\nだからこそ、余も最上の力を取り戻し: So those who aspire to be heroes dare to challenge me. That's why I intended to reclaim my supreme power and await atop Olympus—
m400461.魔王城の門は突破されてるけど、\n中枢の封印は維持し続けているみたいね。\nでも:
The castle gate's been breached, but it looks like the central seal is still holding.
However, the whole surrounding area is completely under the Heaven forces' control.

m400494.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Because the deployment cost doesn't recover over time, make sure to include someone with the “Request Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400494.その手紙の内容によりますと、\nどうやら王子との再戦を望んでいるようですね……。: According to the letter, it seems he wants a rematch with you…
m400494.それでは、\nデシウスの元へと向かう前に、\nこれからの戦いの説明をさせていただ: Then, before we head to Desius, let me explain the upcoming battle.

m400494.つまり、自分達の仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を\n倒せるか: In other words, the focus is on how many foes you can take down, rather than minimizing casualties among our own.
m400494.ですので、傷つくことを恐れずに、\n一体でも多くの魔物を倒すことをお考えください: So don't fear taking damage—try to slay as many monsters as you can.
m400494.はい！\nそれでは出陣しましょう、王子。: Yes! Then let's set out, Prince.

m400494.わざわざ場所を指定するところをみるに、\nデシウスは王子打倒の為に周到な準備を\: Since he even specified the place, we can be sure Desius is making thorough preparations to bring you down.
m400494.今回の戦いは、\n一人でも多くの敵を倒すことを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』: This fight will be a “Grand Hunt Mission” aimed at defeating as many enemies as possible.
m400494.何度も王子に敗北してきたが、それでも諦めていないぞ、\nということが、かなりの字: It says that even though he's been defeated by you countless times, he hasn't given up… It's written in a lot of text with heavy strokes, but that's not really important, so I'll skip the details.
m400494.場所は、地下洞窟……。: The location is the underground caves…
m400494.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますのでご注意く: The Grand Hunt Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400494.実は先程、デシウスから王子宛に手紙が届いたのです。: Actually, a letter from Desius just arrived addressed to you.
m400494.更に、今回のミッションにおいては、\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまで: Also, for this mission, even if your life reaches zero, the mission is considered cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be recorded as your achievement.
m400494.王子……。\n何度も戦っている相手ではありますが、\nくれぐれも油断はしないでく: Prince… We've fought them many times, but don't let your guard down.

m400539.……とのことですので、\n天界に向かい、確認してもらえたらと思います。: …So, if you could head to the heavens and check it out, that would be great.
m400539.……当然、放っておくつもりはないよね、王子？: …Of course you won't just stand by and do nothing, will you, Prince?
m400539.……端折りすぎだ。\nそれだと何が起きているのか分からないだろう。:
…You're skipping a lot.
That doesn't tell us what's happening.
m400539.あぁ、そうだね。ごめんごめん。\nでもそうとしか言えない状況でさ。:
Ah, right. Sorry, sorry.
But that's the only way to put it.
m400539.おそらくは精神支配されてるんだろうね。\nパパの所で似たような状態になってる天使:
They're probably under mental control.
I've seen similar angels at Papa's place.
m400539.おーい、大変だよ王子。\n天界の天使たちがおかしくなっちゃった。:
Hey, Prince, it's serious.
The angels in the heavens have gone crazy.
m400539.このままだと天界が\nめちゃくちゃになっちゃいそうなんだよね。: If this keeps up, the heavens are going to be a total mess.
m400539.その手のことに詳しい者にも聞いてみましたが……。: I even asked those who specialize in that kind of thing….
m400539.それから、今回は敵を倒しても\nEXPやゴールドを入手できないよ。: Also, this time you won't earn any EXP or gold from defeating enemies.
m400539.それでこそだ、勇者よ。\nならば早速、戦の準備をしよう。:
That's the spirit, Hero.
Then let's get ready for battle right away.
m400539.それでは王子、大討伐ミッションの発令を。\n天使たちを助けに行きましょう。:
Then, Prince, let's issue the large-scale extermination mission.
Let's go save the angels.
m400539.どうしたのか話しかけてみても、\n虚ろな目で刃を向けてくるばかりでしたわ……。: Even when I tried asking what's wrong, they just stared with empty eyes and pointed their blades at me….
m400539.ライフが０となっても、それまでに倒した敵の数は\nカウントされるから、倒すことを: Even if your life hits zero, the number of enemies you've defeated up to that point still counts, so you can focus on taking them down.
m400539.実際に見てみないことには分かりませんわ！: We won't know until we see it for ourselves!
m400539.操られた天使たちは言わば被害者だ。\nそんな人たちから戦利品としてなにかを持って:
The controlled angels are essentially victims.
It wouldn't be right for you, Prince, to loot them.
m400539.敵戦力を一体でも多く削る……じゃなかった。\n一人でも多くの天使を正気に戻すこと: Our goal isn't to rack up enemy kills… I mean, to bring as many angels back to their senses as possible.
m400539.最近、天界の一部の天使たちが、\nまるで操られたかのような怪しい動きをしているの: Lately, some angels in the heavens have been moving in a suspicious, almost controlled manner.
m400539.此度の戦場は敵の数が多い。\nゆえに、大討伐ミッションの形式で戦うのが良いだろう:
The battlefield this time is swarming with enemies.
So a large-scale extermination mission is the way to go.
m400539.精神支配されてようがされてなかろうが、\nおかしくなってる天使の数はけっこう多く: Whether they're mind-controlled or not, there are quite a few angels acting strangely.
m400539.緊急事態ですから、万全の補給体制は望めません。\n出撃コストが回復しないので、『:
Because it's an emergency, we can't guarantee a full supply line.
Since sortie cost won't recover, you'll need someone with ‘Request Reinforcements' or to field a Valkyrie.

m500090.また、別の証言者によれば、魔物を倒したとしても\nしばらくすると再び、どこからと: Another source says that even if we defeat the monster, it will reappear out of nowhere after a short time and rampage across the battlefield again.
m500090.もし、魔神フールフールが復活したとなれば、\n向かう先は、これまでとは比べものに: If the Demon God Fool Fool does awaken, the battles ahead will be far more cataclysmic than anything we've faced before.
m500090.交戦した者の証言によれば、攻撃の大小に関わらず、\nこちらの攻撃には必ず凄絶な雷: Witnesses say that, regardless of the size of our attack, the monster always retaliates with a devastating bolt of lightning, so we must be prepared before we strike.
m500090.兵士の鍛錬やチーム編成の見直しといった\n十分な準備をした上で戦いに挑まれること: I recommend you thoroughly train your troops and reconsider your team composition before you go into battle.
m500090.前線は苛烈を極め、\n先行部隊の悉くが敗走し、\n戦場はまさに地獄と化しています: The front lines are unbearably fierce; every advance unit has been routed, and the battlefield has become a true hell.
m500090.名は……フールフール。\n魔神の名を冠するに足る凶悪さを忌まれ、\nはるか昔に封: Its name… Fool Fool. It was sealed long ago because its evil was deemed worthy of the title “Demon God.”
m500090.報告によると、敵は人と同じ四肢を有しながら雄鹿の\n頭を備え、その躯に幾千の茨の: According to the reports, the enemy has the four limbs of a human but a stag's head, and its body commands thousands of thorn-like bolts of lightning, striking all it faces with violet lightning.
m500090.王子、強大な戦闘能力をもった\n魔物の出現が報告されました。: Prince, reports have come in of a monster with immense combat power appearing.
m500090.紫電を纏いし鹿頭の人型……残虐なまでのどう猛さ……\n代々王国に伝わる文献の中に: A humanoid with a stag's head cloaked in purple lightning… its cruelty is beyond savage… ancient kingdom texts contain a description that matches it perfectly.
m500090.魔物が復活する理由に関しては、現状において、\n明確な答えは出ていません。ですが: As for why the monster keeps reviving, we have no clear answer yet. For now, our only option is to keep slaying each one that shows up.

m500328.――おぉ、あれに見えるは王国軍。\nやはり来てくれたか！:
―Oh, there they are. The Kingdom's army.

I knew you'd come!
m500328.――アンナ、こいつが危険だからって止めると思う？\n政務官として一応止めないとい: ――Anna, do you really think I'd stop you just because it's dangerous? I know I should object as your political advisor, but…
m500328.――魔界の門、復活計画ですか……。: ――The Demon Realm Gate… a resurrection plan, is it…
m500328.――魔神レラジェ、沈黙を確認しました！\nすごい……めちゃくちゃな魔力が放出され:
—Demon God Leraje has gone silent!
Incredible… An overwhelming amount of mana is being released!
m500328.……いえ、念の為ですから。\n人助け、そして魔神からのご指名、\n王子が断るはず: …No, I was just being cautious. Helping people, and being chosen by a Demon God… there was no way you would refuse, was there, Prince?
m500328.……それから、デーモン軍にはレラジェ信者もいて、\nそいつら、嬉々として毒矢の準:
…Also, there are fanatics of Leraje in the Demon army.

They were eagerly preparing poison arrows, so

we might want to bring along some units with high poison resistance?
m500328.……それはもう、熱烈に。\nぜひ戦いたいって、私の魂にびりびり伝わってきてます。: …It was rather enthusiastic. I can feel it buzzing through my soul. She really wants to fight you.
m500328.……魔神からのご指名、ですか。: …A designation from a Demon God, is it.
m500328.あ、あの……地形はしっかりと\n下見しておいてくださいね。\nレラジェさまは、全:
Ah, um… please make sure you

scout the terrain thoroughly.

Leraje-sama wants a battle fought with her full power…
m500328.あはは……レラジェさまは、\n王子さまと似ている方なのかもしれませんね。\n全力:
Ahaha… Leraje-sama

might be more like the Prince than we thought.

If she wants us to give it our all, then we shall!
m500328.あれが件の廃砦ね。\n……狙撃にはぴったりかも。:
That must be the ruined fortress.

…It looks perfect for sniping.
m500328.うむ、我がデモシェフ商会の社員も、\n何人かが魔界への帰還を望んでいるのだ。\n:
Indeed. Several of the employees at my Demoshuf Trading Company

wish to return to the Demon Realm.

Please, lend them your strength to fulfill their long-held dream.
m500328.うわぁ、困った人たちだ……。\nでも、レラジェの毒と違って、\n対処のできそうな:
Wow, what a troublesome bunch…

But unlike Leraje's poison,

if it's a type we can handle, it should be manageable, right?
m500328.えぇ、そして敵には――つまり王子たちには、\n呪いの毒を放ってくるはずよ。\n防:
Yes, and at her enemies—meaning, you and the Prince—

she'll unleash cursed poison.

There's no way to block it, so our healers are going to be swamped.
m500328.えぇっ！？\n説明してくれるって約束したじゃないですかぁ！？: Ehh?! But you promised you'd explain it to me!
m500328.えぇと……今回の作戦は、簡単にいえば、\n魔界からレラジェさまをお喚びすることで: Umm… to put it simply, this operation involves summoning Leraje from the Demon Realm to force the Demon Realm Gate open.
m500328.えっ……キホルちゃん魔界に帰っちゃうの……？: W-What? Kihor-chan, are you going back to the Demon Realm…?
m500328.おぉ……これで魔界の門を再び開くことができる。\n王子……いや、王子殿下、\n敵:
Oh… so the gate to the Demon Realm can be opened again.
Prince… no, Your Highness,
to do this much for us, your enemies…
m500328.お願いしたのは事実ですけど！ そうしたら、\n武人相手に手加減は失礼なことですよ:
I did, but! She said that

holding back against a warrior would be an insult…
m500328.この恩、決して忘れはしまい。\n王子殿下、魔界へ戻った後も、\n汝を救世主として:
We shall never forget this kindness.
Your Highness, even after we return to the Demon Realm,
we will revere you as our savior.
m500328.そゆこと。魔神の力を借りて、\n魔界と物質界の通路を作ろうってわけ。: That's right. We're going to use a Demon God's power to open a passage between the Demon Realm and the Material Realm.
m500328.それでは、私は召喚に集中しますね。\n王子殿下、後のことはおまかせします……。:
Then I'll focus on the summoning.
Your Highness, I'll leave the rest to you…
m500328.それでは王子、\n万全の準備を整えて、廃砦へ向かいましょう。\n魔神レラジェとの:
Then, Prince,

let's make sure we're fully prepared and head to the fortress.

In your battle with the Demon God Leraje—good luck!
m500328.それでは王子、我々は王国へ帰還しましょうか。\n魔神レラジェ討伐、お疲れさまでし:
Well then, Prince, shall we return to the kingdom?
Good work on subduing Demon God Leraje!
m500328.ただ、レラジェさまの顕現には、\n膨大な魔力と、目印としての私の存在、\nそして: However, for Leraje to manifest, we need an immense amount of magical power, my presence as a beacon, and… a war waged by a mighty army…
m500328.な、なによ！\nレライエだってレラジェさまに\n手加減をお願いしてたじゃない！:
W-What do you mean!

Didn't you ask Leraje-sama to hold back too?
m500328.なるほど、レラジェは戦場の狩人とも称される魔神。\nそして戦を起こす者にして、戦: I see. Leraje is known as the Hunter of the Battlefield. And one who both starts wars and heals warriors. So, we are offering a war as a catalyst.
m500328.は……初めまして……？\n元魔王軍の、レライエと申しますぅぅぅ……。:
H-Hi… nice to meet you…?
I'm Leraye, formerly of the Demon King's Army…
m500328.はぁ……はぁ……や、やりました……！\nレラジェさまの魔力が大きな流れになって…:
Haa… haa… I… I did it…!
Leraje-sama's mana is flowing in a great current…
Wh-Whoa… the passage to the Demon Realm is reopening…!
m500328.はい……そ、それで、レラジェさまは、\n戦いの相手として王子殿下を指名されまして: Yes… and, with that, Leraje has designated the Prince as her opponent in battle…
m500328.ひやぁっ！？ エレット、説明中だからぁ！？\n――こ、こほん！ それでね、\nこ:
Hyaah! Ehret, I'm in the middle of explaining!
――Ahem! So, I've decided to borrow this girl's power!
m500328.まぁ、デーモンシェフみたいに、\n物質界に馴染んじゃってる奴もいるけどさ。: Well, some, like the Demon Chef, have gotten pretty comfortable with the Material Realm, but…
m500328.まぁ王子じゃレラジェさまには敵わないだろうけどね！\nで、でも……ちょっとだけ、:
Well, the Prince is no match for Leraje-sama, though!

B-But… I guess it's okay to cheer them on a little.
m500328.よかったぁ！\n寂しくないように、あたしが一緒にいるからね！: Whew! So you're not leaving! I'll stay by your side so you don't feel lonely!
m500328.キホルさん、それは全力で\n応援してますって言ってるようなものですよ……？:
Kihor-san, saying you'll “cheer them on a little”

is basically the same as saying you'll support them with your full power… isn't it?
m500328.デーモンシェフ、\nあなたもこの計画に関わっていたのですね。:
Demon Chef,

so you were involved in this plan as well.
m500328.レライエはね、魔神レラジェさまの加護を受けてるの。\n魂が共鳴してるとか何とか…:
Leraye is under the protection of the Demon God Leraje. Apparently, their souls are resonating with each other or something…
Umm, I'll leave the detailed explanation to her!
m500328.レラジェさまも、\n良い戦いだったと言い残していきました。\nそれから、ま、また:
Leraje-sama also
said it was a good battle before she left.
And that she'd like to fight again…
m500328.今も物質界に馴染めなかったり、\n故郷が恋しかったりで、\n魔界に帰りたいって連: Right now, there are plenty of folks who can't adjust to life here, or who miss their homeland, and want to go back to the Demon Realm.
m500328.伝説に聞く魔神レラジェとの決戦……どきどきしますね！\nえぇと、確かレラジェは、:
The decisive battle with the legendary Demon God Leraje… I can't help but get excited!

Um, if I remember correctly, Leraje

fires arrows of healing at her allies… right?
m500328.再戦の際には、事前に\n教えてくれるように伝えておいてくださいね……？:
Please let her know that if she wants a rematch,
she should give us a heads-up first…?
m500328.戦場には西の廃砦を使いましょうか。\n塔の上を陣取れば、\nレラジェの長射程にも:
We should use the Western Ruined Fortress as our battlefield.

If we hold the high ground on the towers,

we might be able to counter Leraje's long-range attacks.
m500328.王子、困っている魔界の方々を\n助けるためとはいえ、\n同時にとても危険な行為だ: Prince, even if it is to help the distressed people of the Demon Realm, I believe this is an extremely dangerous undertaking—
m500328.私は帰らないわよ！\n魔界に未練なんてないし、\n……来週、エレットとお菓子作る: I'm not going back! I have no lingering attachment to the Demon Realm, and… besides, I promised Ehret I'd bake some sweets with her next week.
m500328.軍と軍の戦いを望んでるってことだったものね。\nそれなら、一切遠慮する必要はなさ:
So she wants an all-out war between armies.

In that case, there's no need to hold back at all!

m900296.――しっつれいしまーす！\n王子、納品しにきたよー！:
――Excuse me, excuse me!
Prince, I've come to deliver the goods!
m900296.――ふふっ、王子なら即決だと思ったよ。\nそれじゃあ急いで、\n今わかってるナン:
――Heh, I knew you'd decide instantly, Prince.
Then let's hurry. I'll explain what we know about Nandi.
m900296.――よし、それじゃあ神獣ナンディ討伐、開始だ！！: ――All right, then—let's begin the hunt for the divine beast Nandi!
m900296.――以上が神獣ナンディの被害報告です。\n迅速に対応したおかげで、\n被害は最小:
――That concludes the damage report on the Divine Beast Nandi.
Thanks to our swift response,
the damage was kept to a minimum.
m900296.――大丈夫、僕らには王子がいるからさ。\nおっと、最後にナンディが神獣であること:
――We'll be fine, we have the Prince with us.
Oh, and don't forget that Nandi is a Divine Beast.
m900296.――神獣ナンディ、進軍を停止しました！: The Divine Beast Nandi has halted its advance!
m900296.……あれが神獣ナンディか。\n牛って聞いてたけど想定よりデカいな。:
……So that's the Divine Beast Nandi.
I heard it was bovine, but it's bigger than I expected.
m900296.……えぇと、それでは私も？\n――っと、その前に。\n王子、此度の討伐もお疲れ様: …Well then, may I… —but first, Prince, thank you for your efforts in this hunt!
m900296.……おいしいごはん、いっぱい食べられますように。: ...May I eat lots of delicious food.
m900296.あっ……この斧、\nナンディの魔力を帯びているみたいです。\nそれに周囲の、ナン: Ah... this axe seems to be imbued with Nandi's magic power. And so is the armor that Nandi was wearing around it.
m900296.あっ、あたしも拝む！\n聖なる牛さん王子なんて、絶対ご利益あるよ！: Ah, I'm praying too! A Holy Cow Prince is absolutely guaranteed to bring good luck!
m900296.あっ、それからナンディって言ったら、\n角が楽器になってるんじゃなかったっけ？:
Oh, and speaking of Nandi,
aren't its horns musical instruments?
m900296.あっ、ま、待ってー！\n鎧の破片集めてからにしてー！: Ah, w-wait! Let's gather the armor fragments first!
m900296.あの中に踏み入った兵は、ほぼ無力化されてしまう。\n兵の配置と、ナンディの足止め:
Any troops that step into it will be rendered nearly powerless.
Be careful to monitor your unit placement and keep Nandi at bay.
m900296.あの角で増幅された咆哮が、\n魔法の一撃として戦場全域に届くんですよね。\n常に:
The roar amplified by those horns reaches the entire battlefield
as a single magical strike.
We'll have to keep a close eye on everyone's health……
m900296.あれは……斧……？\nナンディに刺さってたのかな。: Is that... an axe? It must have been stuck in Nandi.
m900296.あんな怪物が都市部まで来たら、\n復興にどれだけかかるか分かりませんね……。:
If a monster like that were to reach the city,
I can't even imagine how long the reconstruction would take……
m900296.いや、ちょっと思い出してたのさ。\n神獣ナンディはもともと、神の遣わした\n恵み: No, I was just remembering something. The legend that the Divine Beast Nandi was originally a being sent by the gods to bring blessings.
m900296.うん、ナンディの角は空洞になっていて、\n魔力を増幅して\n周囲全体に響かせる力:
Yes, Nandi's horns are hollow and
apparently have the power to amplify magic
and resonate it throughout the surrounding area.
m900296.えぇっ！？ じゃあ僕も……。\n今年も王子様にいいことありますようにっと……。: E-Excuse me?! Then I'll... May good things come to Your Highness this year as well...
m900296.これが、神獣ナンディのまとっていた鎧と、\n魔力を帯びた斧か。\nへぇ、かすかに:
So this is the armor the Divine Beast Nandi wore,
and the axe imbued with magic power.
Hmm, I can faintly feel Nandi's blessing on it.
m900296.さぁ王子、僕らもナンディの\n鎧のかけらを拾いに行こうか。\n恵みの白牛のご利益: Come, Prince. Let's go gather the fragments of Nandi's armor ourselves. The blessings of the White Ox of Fortune might just be in store for us.
m900296.さっきアマンダが言ったとおり、\nナンディは侵攻と同時に「聖なる河」という、\n:
Just as Amanda said, Nandi generates a "Sacred River,"
a source of water imbued with magic power,
as it invades.
m900296.そういうことなら鍛冶師の出番だね！\n斧は手直しすれば王子が使えそうなサイズだし: If that's the case, it's time for the blacksmiths to step in! The axe can be resized so the Prince can use it, and—
m900296.そのために僕らが来たんだろう？\nナンディの侵攻は、絶対にここで止めないとね。:
That's why we're here, isn't it?
We absolutely must stop Nandi's invasion right here.
m900296.そのとおり。\n事実、襲撃された都市の衛兵からも、\n武器を握る力が抜けてしまっ:
That's right.
In fact, we've received reports from the guards in the attacked cities
that they couldn't even keep their grip on their weapons.
m900296.それからナンディは、いわば獣を従える者だ。\n伝説が正しければ、\n周辺の獣を強:
Also, Nandi is, in a sense, a master of beasts.
If the legend is to be believed,
it was granted the divine authority to empower the beasts around it.
m900296.それを言うなら王子もだよ。\n一瞬の迷いもなく、ここに駆けつけたんだからね。: If you're going to say that, the same goes for the Prince. He rushed here without a moment's hesitation.
m900296.ふぅ、何とかなったね……。\nここで食い止められてよかったよ。: Phew, that was close... I'm glad we were able to stop it here.
m900296.ふふっ、確かに王子こそ、\nこの装備の担い手にふさわしいですね。: Hehe, you really are the one most worthy of carrying this equipment, Prince.
m900296.まぁそれは、その鎧を着る人におねだりするといいよ。\nそういうわけで王子、着てみ:
Well, you could just ask the person who's going to wear it for that.
Anyway, Prince, why don't you try it on?
m900296.むむ、どうして不思議そうな顔してるの？\n神獣を倒した王子が、\n神獣ゆかりの装:
Mm, why do you look so surprised?
If the Prince who defeated the Divine Beast
doesn't wear the equipment associated with it, then what's the point?
m900296.もうひとつの注意事項は\n魔力のこもった音色、だったわね。:
The other point of caution was
the magical resonance of its voice.
m900296.よし、王子がいるって考えたら\nちょっと勇気が出てきたよ！\n待ってろー！ 神獣: Alright! Knowing the Prince is with us gives me a boost of courage! Hold on—here comes Nandi!!
m900296.よーし！ 急いで工房に運び込もう！\n急げ急げー！: Alright! Let's hurry and get these to the workshop! Hurry, hurry!
m900296.ん……あれ？\nナンディの残骸から何か出てきたよ？: Hm... wait? Something is coming out of Nandi's remains?
m900296.ん、どうしたのラテリア？\nなんだか面白い顔してるけど。: Hm, what's wrong, Lateria? You have a funny look on your face.
m900296.アタシでも知ってるくらいだし、有名な伝説だよね。\nナンディの歩んだ後には「聖な:
I know about it too. It's a pretty famous legend.
Wherever Nandi walks, a "Sacred River" springs up,
devastating the land and crushing the enemy's will to fight.
m900296.ナンディの伝説は知ってる？\nそう、千年戦争当時に神々が生み出した、\n敵軍を蹂:
You know the legend of Nandi?
Yes, the bovine weapon created by the gods during the Millennium War,
designed to trample the enemy.
m900296.ナンディの身体が崩壊していくよ！\nやったぁ！ 神獣ナンディ、討伐成功だよー！: Nandi's body is collapsing! We did it! We've successfully subjugated the Divine Beast Nandi!
m900296.ナンディの進行速度は遅いけど、\n強力な前衛でその歩みを止める必要があると思うよ:
Nandi's advance is slow, but
I think we'll need a powerful vanguard to halt its progress.
m900296.ナンディの鎧のかけらも、\nこれを元に人間が着られる鎧が作れるかも！: We might be able to create armor for humans based on the fragments of Nandi's armor!
m900296.他の神獣と同じく「神の威光」によって、\n一定周期で兵を遠方に転移させてくるはず:
Like the other Divine Beasts, it will use the "Divine Radiance" to teleport troops from afar at regular intervals.
Make sure to deploy your best units across multiple squads, Prince.
m900296.伝説によれば「聖なる河」に飲まれた兵は、\n誰かを傷つける力をガッツリ無くしちゃ:
The legend says that soldiers who drink from the "Sacred River"
completely lose the strength to harm anyone, right?
m900296.周辺の都市群からも、すでに救援要請が来ています。\n被害の大きさを考えると、\n:
Requests for aid have already come in from the surrounding cities.
Given the scale of the damage,
we don't have a moment to spare...
m900296.恵みの白牛の加護を帯びた装備なんて、縁起がいいね。\nちょっと王子のこと拝んでお: Equipment blessed by the White Bull of Blessings... how auspicious. I'm almost tempted to bow in prayer for you, Prince.
m900296.斧と一緒に鎧もね！\nふふふ、最高の出来だって保証するよ？:
Armor to go with the axe!
Hehehe, I guarantee it's a masterpiece.
m900296.昔ナンディと戦った、\n名も知れぬ戦士の斧ってところかな？\nあんなデカブツに挑: It's probably the axe of an unknown warrior who fought Nandi long ago. Challenging a giant like that... what a brave soul♪
m900296.牛型ってだけだからね。\n中身は神サマお手製の破壊兵器だよ。:
It's just shaped like a cow.
Inside, it's a weapon of mass destruction crafted by the gods themselves.
m900296.王子、出陣前にした話は覚えてる？\nナンディの足元に見えるのが、\n戦意を喪失さ:
Prince, do you remember what we discussed before setting out?
The area around Nandi's feet is the "Holy River,"
which strips away a soldier's will to fight.
m900296.王子、急ぎ部隊を編成し、\n神獣ナンディの討伐へ向かうべきかと。:
Prince, we should form a unit immediately and
head out to subdue the Divine Beast Nandi.
m900296.王子、神獣ナンディの鎧をまとう際には、\n称号を「白牛を御す者」にしてくださいね: Prince, when you don the armor of the Divine Beast Nandi, please change your title to "One Who Wields the White Bull."
m900296.王子の即断即決が功を奏したね。\nそれにナンディゆかりの破片も手に入ったし――:
The Prince's quick decision-making paid off.
And we even managed to get our hands on fragments linked to Nandi――
m900296.皆ナンディの対策は覚えたね。\n王子、攻撃の準備はいいかい？:
Everyone, you've got the countermeasures for Nandi down.
Prince, are you ready to attack?
m900296.神獣ナンディが封印を解き、\n進軍を開始したらしいんだ。:
The Divine Beast Nandi has broken its seal and
apparently begun its advance.
m900296.聞けば聞くほど厄介じゃない……？\nうー、大丈夫かな……。:
It's getting more troublesome the more I hear...
Ugh, are we going to be okay...?
m900296.詳しいね、アマンダ。\n復活したナンディは、その伝説のとおりに、\n各地に爪痕を:
You know a lot, Amanda.
The resurrected Nandi is advancing exactly as the legend says,
leaving a trail of destruction in its wake.
m900296.音っていうより、もう魔法攻撃みたいなものだね。\nだから遠距離だからって油断せず:
It's less like sound and more like a magical attack.
So don't let your guard down just because it's at a distance.
I think the rear guard should be prepared with healing.
m900296.魔力の形を変えないように、\n人間が着られる形にするのは大変だったなー。\nこれ:
It was quite a hassle to shape it for a human to wear
without altering the form of the magic power.
I think all the blacksmiths deserve a reward for this, don't you?
m900296.魔力を帯びた武器に、神獣の鎧か……。\n何かに使えるかもしれないね。: A weapon imbued with magic power, and the armor of a Divine Beast... It might come in handy for something.

m900345.――って、聞くまでもないか。\n世界樹地下にそんなマグマ溜まりができてたら、\n:
—Wait, that's a rhetorical question.
If a magma pool like that forms under the World Tree,
the nature we worked so hard to protect would be engulfed in flames.
m900345.――王子よ、本当に助かった！\n世界樹の危機を何度も救ってくれるとは、\nうぬは:
――Prince, you truly saved us!
You have rescued the World Tree from peril so many times…
You are our greatest benefactor of all!
m900345.――王子殿、聞こえるか？\n彼方より響くこの重い足音は……。:
――Your Highness, can you hear me?
These heavy footsteps echoing from afar…….
m900345.……おそらくじゃが、\nニーズヘッグめ、マグマの内から\nこちらの様子を伺ってお:
……It's possible, though.
That Níðhöggr might be lurking
within the magma, observing our movements.
m900345.……さすがにマグマを受け止めたことはないが、\n火を防ぐのとは勝手が違いそうだな:
……I've never actually had to take a direct hit from magma, but
it's a different beast from simply blocking fire.
m900345.……そうはさせないさ。\nぼくらが力をあわせ、守り抜いた世界樹なんだからね。:
……Not on our watch.
We're the ones who banded together to protect the World Tree, after all.
m900345.……どうする王子？\nニーズヘッグはかなりの強敵だと思うけど――:
……What do you think, Prince?
I believe Níðhöggr is a formidable foe—
m900345.……ふぅ。\nようやくこの灼熱地帯から出られるね。\n王子、みんな、お疲れ様。:
……Phew.
We can finally leave this scorching wasteland.
Prince, everyone, good work.
m900345.……んっ？\nおかしいな、ニーズヘッグの魔力は消えたのに、\n鱗の焔は消えないみ: …Hm? Strange. Níðhöggr's magical energy is gone, but the flames on the scales don't seem to be fading.
m900345.……怪我はしないようにしてくださいね？: …Please be careful not to get hurt.
m900345.……想像どおりのようだ！\n王子殿、周囲に敵の気配が集まっているぞ！:
……Just as I suspected!
Your Highness, enemy presences are gathering around us!
m900345.ああ、ニーズヘッグの焔鱗から作ったのかな。\nすごい、まだ火が消えていないんだね:
Ah, I wonder if it was forged from Níðhöggr's flame scales?
Amazing, the fire is still burning!
m900345.あちちちちっ、王子っ、熱い！ これ熱いよー！: Ouch, ouch, ouch! Prince, it's hot! This is really hot!
m900345.あっ、なるほど。\nよーし、さっそく王子様であったまろー♪:
Ah, I see.
Alright, let's get the Prince warmed up right away♪
m900345.うぉぉ、王子ぃ、また助けられてしまったのぉ……。\nこの礼は何がいい！？\nどん: Woah, Prince, you saved us again… What should I do to repay you? I'll do anything you ask!
m900345.うむ、世界樹地下のマグマも冷え固まり、\nようやく延焼の危険も去ったぞ！\nこれ:
Ah, the magma beneath the World Tree has cooled and solidified,
so the danger of the fire spreading is finally over!
That's quite a relief, wouldn't you say?
m900345.うんうん。\nというわけで、ニーズヘッグの鎧を着る時は、\n称号を『竜焔を纏いし:
Mm-hm.
So, whenever you put on Níðhöggr's armor,
make sure to change your title to “Bearer of the Dragon's Flame.”
m900345.えぇ、神獣討伐もまた、\n我々の行動目的のひとつですから。:
Yes, slaying the Divine Beast is also
one of our objectives.
m900345.えぇと、王子は暖房器具では……。\nと、ともかく！ 此度の討伐、お疲れさまでした:
Um, the Prince isn't exactly a heating appliance…
A-anyway! Well done on this subjugation, everyone!
m900345.えーっと、まさか復活したとか言わないだろうね？: I mean, you're not about to say it has revived, are you?
m900345.おのれぇ、世界樹の根本で好き勝手しおって！\n王子よ、ぼっこぼこにしてやるがよい:
You insolent wretches, making yourselves at home at the roots of the World Tree!
Prince, go and beat them to a pulp!
m900345.こっちも一段落ついたところだよ！: We've just wrapped things up on our end too!
m900345.じゃあニーズヘッグを見たことのある僕から、\n気をつけておくポイントを解説してお:
Then, since I've seen Níðhöggr before,
let me explain a few things to watch out for!
m900345.そして最後に、ニーズヘッグは神獣だ。\n他の神獣と同じように、\n「神の威光」の:
And lastly, Níðhöggr is a Divine Beast.
Like the others, it possesses
the power of the "Divine Radiance."
m900345.そのまさか、の可能性が高い。\nここ数日、世界樹では地鳴りが続いていたのだが、\:
That "impossible" scenario is, in fact, highly likely.
For the past few days, tremors have continued beneath the World Tree.
When we sent an investigation team, they discovered a mysterious space.
m900345.その後、世界樹の様子はどうですか？: And how is the World Tree doing now?
m900345.それから、ニーズヘッグの攻撃方法にも注意だよ！\nあいつマグマを放ってくるからね:
Also, be careful of Níðhöggr's attack patterns!
It spits out magma…!!
m900345.それなら良いのですが……。\n――っと、つまりその鎧は、\n王子専用に鍛えられた:
Well, that's a relief…
――I see, so that armor was
forged specifically for the Prince, then?
m900345.そんな大きなドラゴンなら、\nどこからでも見えそうなものですけどねぇ。:
A dragon that big should be
visible from anywhere, don't you think?
m900345.ただ、そのニーズヘッグの姿が見えないな……。\n伝承によれば、\n巨大な体躯を持:
That said, I can't seem to spot Níðhöggr…….
Legend has it that it's a dragon
with a massive physique.
m900345.たぶん！ よぉーし、せっかくだし回収していこー。\nきっと面白いもの作れちゃうと: Probably! Alright, since we're here, let's collect them. I think I could make something really interesting with these.
m900345.つまり王子様が燃やす気にならない限りは、\n執務室も無事ってことだね♪:
So, as long as the Prince doesn't get the urge to set things ablaze,
the office should be perfectly safe♪
m900345.では王子よ、神獣ニーズヘッグの討伐、\nどうか、どうか頼むぞ……！！:
Then, Prince, the subjugation of the Divine Beast Níðhöggr is
left in your hands…… please, do your best!!
m900345.となると……。\nまずは、腕試しを仕掛けてくるんじゃないかな？:
If that's the case…….
It's probably going to start by testing our strength.
m900345.ともあれ、神獣ニーズヘッグ討伐お疲れ様でした！\n鱗を回収し終えたら、王国へ帰還: In any case, good work defeating the divine beast Níðhöggr! Once we've finished collecting the scales, let's head back to the kingdom.
m900345.どうじゃ……？\n世界樹を助けてもらった上に、\n神獣討伐まで頼むのは忍びないの:
I wonder…?
We were already saved by the World Tree, but asking you to slay a Divine Beast as well…
It feels a bit like too much to ask, doesn't it?
m900345.なるほど、周囲を溶かす程の高温となれば、\nニーズヘッグの記録と一致する……。\:
I see. If the heat is intense enough to melt the surroundings,
it matches the records of Níðhöggr….
So that's why you came to the kingdom.
m900345.なんだとはなんじゃ！\nこっちは緊急事態なんじゃぞー！:
"Just us"?!
We're dealing with a crisis here!
m900345.はぁ、それにしても、\n今後は冬場の心配がなくなるねー？:
Haa, and besides,
this means we don't have to worry about the winter anymore, right?
m900345.ほら、寒い時は王子様に\nこの鎧を着てもらえばいいからさー。\nぬくぬくー、ぽっ:
Well, when it gets cold, the Prince can just
put on this armor for us.
It'll be nice and warm, toasty and cozy!
m900345.ぼっこぼこにするのはいいけど、\n足場には十分注意してね。:
Beating them up is all well and good, but
please be careful of the footing.
m900345.まずはさっきの報告にもあったマグマだね。\nしっかりした足場はともかく、\n裂け:
First, the magma mentioned in the report.
While solid ground is fine,
be very careful with any cracked or unstable footing.
m900345.むむむ、仕方ないのう……。: Mmm, very well… I suppose I must let go.
m900345.ようやくおでましか。\n雑魚じゃ相手にならないと分かって、\n自ら僕らを溶かしに:
It's finally coming out.
It must have realized it can't deal with the grunts,
and decided to come melt us itself.
m900345.よぉし、僕も手伝うよ！\nあっ、やけどしないように気をつけて！？: Alright, I'll help out too! Oh, be careful not to burn yourself!
m900345.わぁあっ！？ 今は軍議中だぞ！？\nいったいどこの誰が――って、\nなんだ、ラタ:
Wha—? We're in the middle of a war council!
Who on earth is— Oh, it's just you two, Ratatoskr and Marylene.
m900345.んー、長年ニーズヘッグの魔力を浴び続けて、\n鱗自体が魔剣――いや、魔鱗化したの: Hmm, maybe after being bathed in Níðhöggr's magic for so many years, the scales themselves turned into magical blades… no, magical scales.
m900345.ニーズヘッグ体内の魔力が、急激に沈静化していきます。\n――やった！ ニーズヘッ:
The magical energy inside Níðhöggr is rapidly stabilizing.
――We did it! Níðhöggr has been stopped!
m900345.ニーズヘッグ由来の装備だよ？\nたぶん王子様以外には使いこなせないんじゃないかな:
It's equipment derived from Níðhöggr, after all.
I doubt anyone other than the Prince could wield it properly.
m900345.マグマの流路になっている可能性が高いから、\n見た目以上の高温地帯になっているか:
It's highly likely to be a flow path for the magma,
meaning it's far hotter than it looks.
It should drain your health quickly.
m900345.マグマの流路になっている裂け目は、\n上に立つだけで体力が削られていくからね！:
Cracks that serve as magma flow paths
will drain your health just by standing on them!
m900345.マグマはどろっどろの液状だからね……。\n攻撃を受けたら、しばらく\n高温で焼か:
Magma is a thick, viscous liquid, you see…….
If you get hit, you'll likely be
scorched by the intense heat for a while…….
m900345.ミスリアさん、キャラットさん――って、\nな、なんですかその鎧は！？:
Mithria, Carat――wait,
w-what is that armor!?
m900345.ラタトスク様、抱きつき過ぎです！\n王子殿が困っていますよ！:
Ratatoskr-sama, you're hugging him a bit too much!
The Prince is getting flustered!
m900345.世界樹の地下には巨大な空洞ができていて、\n周囲の岩場は溶け、マグマ溜まりを形成:
A massive hollow has formed underground beneath the World Tree,
and the surrounding rock has melted, creating a magma pool.
m900345.今はまだ、魔術師たちが根を守っているが、\nこの状態が続けば、\nいずれ世界樹に:
For now, the mages are holding the line at the roots,
but if this continues, the flames
will eventually spread to the World Tree itself.
m900345.仮にも神の兵器たる神獣。\nそれくらいの知恵は、当然持っているだろうね。:
It is, after all, a Divine Beast, a weapon of the gods.
It would naturally possess that kind of cunning.
m900345.兵を遠方に転移させる力でしたか。\nならば、こちらも\n大総力戦編成で挑む必要が:
The power to teleport soldiers to distant locations.
In that case, we'll need to
field a full-force formation to face it.
m900345.安心して。\n執務室に燃え移ったりはしないから。:
Don't worry.
It won't catch the office on fire.
m900345.性質としては魔剣に近いものだからね。\n持ち主が燃やそうって思わないと、\n炎が:
In terms of its nature, it's quite similar to a magic sword.
It seems the flames won't spread
unless the wearer intends to burn something.
m900345.戦場を焔に巻くもの、焔竜の王、\n神獣ニーズヘッグそのものが！:
The one who wraps the battlefield in flames, the King of Flame Dragons,
the Divine Beast Níðhöggr itself!
m900345.熱源であったニーズヘッグが討たれたなら、\nこのマグマも自然に冷えていきますね。: Now that Níðhöggr, the source of the heat, has been defeated, this magma should cool down naturally. It looks like we managed to prevent the fire from spreading to the World Tree as well.
m900345.王子、ここからが本番だ！\n神獣ニーズヘッグ、ぼくらで討ち取るぞ！:
Prince, this is where the real battle begins!
We will slay the Divine Beast Níðhöggr together!
m900345.王子殿は、神獣ニーズヘッグを知っているか？\n千年戦争において対魔王の決戦兵器と:
Your Highness, are you familiar with the Divine Beast Níðhöggr?
It is the Flame Dragon deployed as a decisive weapon against the Demon King during the Millennium War,
who fought as an ally of humanity.
m900345.王子！ どこじゃー！！\n大変じゃ！ 一大事なんじゃぁー！！:
Prince! Where are you—!
This is bad! It's a terrible emergency—!
m900345.神獣ニーズヘッグか……。\n千年戦争の最終局面において暴走し、\n世界樹の遥か地:
The Divine Beast Níðhöggr, huh….
Records state that it went berserk in the final stages of the Millennium War
and was sealed deep beneath the World Tree…
m900345.自然の高温かぁ……。\nそれなら、私たち風水使いが力になれるかも？:
Natural heat, huh….
If that's the case, maybe we Wind-Water users can help?
m900345.落ち着いてください、ラタトスク様。\n――王子殿、詳しい説明は私からしよう。:
Please calm down, Ratatoskr.
—Your Highness, I will provide the details.

m920008.……え？ 戦う？ ちょ、ちょっとそれ本気で言ってるの！？\nそれじゃわたしが困る:
…What? Fight? Wait, are you serious!?
That puts me in a bind!
I have to follow the rules!
m920008.……なんだか楽しそうですね、あの子。: …It looks like she's having fun, doesn't she?
m920008.あ、でも一つだけ教えてあげる！: Ah, but I'll tell you one thing!
m920008.うわー、本当に鬼を倒しに来たんだぁ……。\nでも、悪いけどわたしは邪魔しちゃうか:
Wow, you really came to slay the demon…
But sorry, I'll be in your way!
m920008.え？ あれが何かって？ あれは鬼よ。\nあの鬼は社の地下で眠っていたモノなの。\:
Huh? What's that? That's a demon.
It's something that was sleeping underground in the shrine.
But sorry, please don't go after it!
m920008.この辺りでは最近、見慣れない魔物が\n現れたそうです。: They say some unfamiliar monsters have been appearing around here lately.
m920008.さすが英雄の末裔って感じ！\nわたしも仲間にしてもらおうかなぁ。:
Just as I expected of a hero's descendant!
Maybe I'll let you join my party.
m920008.そりゃ王子は女神さまに選ばれた人だけど……、\nでもわたしだって巫女だし、オキテ:
Sure, you're the one chosen by the goddess…
but I'm a shrine maiden too, and I have my own duties…
m920008.そんなことよりも、あの鬼の一撃は\nふつーの人じゃ耐えられないよ！: More importantly, that demon's strike is something a normal person can't survive!
m920008.た、大変だよぉ～！\n鬼が民家に来ちゃって……。: It's terrible! The demon's come into a village…
m920008.たぶん魔物が復活しちゃったから、それに反応して\n目が覚めちゃったと思うんだけど: I think the monsters revived, which woke it up…
m920008.と……とにかくダメ！ オキテだからダメ！\nどうしてもって言うなら……、\n悪い:
So… anyway, no! The rules say no!
If you insist… sorry, but I'll get in your way!
m920008.わたしは、ここから遠い所で魔物を守る社を、\nずーっと守っている、巫女のシホ。\:
I'm Shiho, a shrine maiden who's been protecting the shrine that guards monsters far from here all this time.
You're the descendant of a hero, right?
m920008.んじゃ、これが最後の戦いだよ！\n頑張ってね～！:
Alright, this is the final battle!
Give it your all!
m920008.下手に怒らせて暴れられても困るし……。\nだから落ち着くまででいいの。\nそれま:
It'd be a problem if we anger it and it goes on a rampage…
So just calm it down for now.
If you can hide quietly until then, that'd be fine…
m920008.守れって言われてるから、守んなきゃいけないし。\n鬼の目が覚めたことなんてないか:
Since I'm told to protect it, I have to.
I don't really know about a demon waking up, but I'm told to protect it, so it's probably best to just keep it safe, right?
m920008.鬼の腕力って、そこらの魔物以上なの。\nだから正面から戦わない方がいいかもね。: A demon's strength is beyond any ordinary monster, so maybe don't fight it head-on.

m920041.お初にお目にかかります。\nあなたが女神に選ばれし王子ですね？: Nice to meet you. You must be the prince chosen by the goddess, right?
m920041.お力は十分にあるようですね。\n今回はあなたの戦略眼を見せてもらいます。: You seem to have plenty of power. This time, I'll be watching your strategic eye.
m920041.ここからは私も本気を出させていただきます。\n王子、私を倒すことができたら、\n: From now on, I'll give it my all. Prince, if you can defeat me, I'll acknowledge your strength…
m920041.ここでは魔法を扱う重戦士を出撃させます。\n苛烈な魔法攻撃にあなたたちは\n耐え: Here, I'll send out heavy infantry who wield magic. Can you endure their fierce magical assaults?
m920041.ここはその昔、沼より発生した毒によって無念の\n死を遂げた兵が眠る場所……。さま: This place was once a swamp where poisonous fumes claimed the lives of soldiers who now lie in restless death. Their wandering ghosts don't always follow the path you expect!
m920041.この灼熱の地で、重戦士たちによる鉄槌の陣を\n打ち破れるでしょうか？: In this scorching land, can you break through the iron hammer formation of the heavy infantry?
m920041.しかし、あなたはまだ底知れぬ強さを\n秘めているように思えます。\nあなたの真な: Yet I sense you still harbor an unfathomable power. Show me your true strength!
m920041.なるほど……。噂は耳にしていましたが、\n流石、強いですね……。: I see… I've heard the rumors, and as expected, you're truly strong.
m920041.全ての力を込めた必殺の一撃！\n受け切ることができますか……！: A finishing blow infused with all my power! Can you withstand it…?
m920041.早速ですが王子……。\n私が仕える主としてふさわしいか\n見極めさせていただきま: Right away, Prince… I shall determine whether I am worthy to serve you as my master.
m920041.私の鎚に砕けないものはない……。\n勝負です！！: Nothing can withstand my hammer… This is it!
m920041.私は女神様の声に導かれし聖戦士の一人。\n名をミランダと申します。: I am one of the holy warriors guided by the goddess's voice. My name is Miranda.
m920041.私も含め、防御力がより強固になった\n重戦士たちを相手に、あなたの真なる力を\n: Including myself, we'll face heavy infantry with even tougher defenses, and I'll watch you reveal your true power.
m920041.重戦士は鈍重……なんて思っていませんか？\nですが激しい訓練によってスピードを得: Do you think heavy infantry are slow and clumsy? Thanks to rigorous training, their advance is unlike any ordinary troops.

m920076.――え！？ \n魔物を追い払ってくれるというのですか？\nありがとうございます…: —What!? You'll drive the monsters away? Thank you so much…!
m920076.――って、\nちょっと貴方、何をしてるのですか！？\nまだ転送魔法陣に乗ってはダ: —Wait, what are you doing?! You can't step onto the teleport circle yet!!
m920076.――むっ！？\n今、塔の上で何か動いたな……。\nあの恰好は……どうやら暗黒騎士:
—Whoa!?
Something moved atop the tower just now...
That outfit... seems to be a Dark Knight.
m920076.――ん？\nやけに向こうが騒がしいですね……。\n……って、誰かこっちに走ってき: Hmm? It's unusually noisy over there... Wait, someone's running toward us!?
m920076.――ッ！？\n人が気にしていることを……ッ！: —!? What those people are so concerned about…!
m920076.……ありがとうございます！\nそれでは、参りましょう。\n私が、魔法都市へご案内: ...Thank you! Then, let's go. I'll guide you to the Magic City.
m920076.……いい事思いついたわ。\nあの付与魔術師を私の催眠術にかければいいのよ。\nあ: ...I've got a brilliant idea. I'll hypnotize that Enchanter. You, become mine.
m920076.……と言う訳なのです。\nゴーレムは、付与魔術師が力を与えて動きはしますが、\n:
...That's how it works.
Golems move because the Enchanter grants them power,
but anyone can command them if they overwrite the orders.
m920076.……ん？ 何だこれ……？\nお、おい！ 俺の体が急に消え――うひぃッッ！！: ...Huh? What's this...? Hey! My body just vanished—Aaaah!!
m920076.あっ！ こら！\n壊した魔法都市を修復していきなさいよ！: Hey! Fix the magical city you destroyed!
m920076.あのゴーレムまで倒してしまうとは……。\nゴーレムを倒せるなんて、信じられない…: I can't believe we actually took down that golem... Defeating a golem—it's unbelievable... What should I do? I want to study the secret of its strength...!
m920076.あの時から、久しく会っていなかったな……。\nまた再会できるとは、長生きはするも: It's been a long time since then... To think we'd meet again, I must be living a long life. But why were you being chased by goblins?
m920076.あまり仲間同士で争うのは気が進みませんが、\nこ、これも王子様のお力になる為です: I'm not keen on fighting my comrades, but… this is all for your sake, Prince… I'll give you everything I've got!
m920076.あら、誰かと思えば王子軍じゃない。\nそれに、逃げだした付与魔術師もいるわぁ。\: Oh, it's the Prince's forces, huh? And there's even a runaway Enchanter trying to come back. How foolish.
m920076.ありがとうございます、ゴブリンクイーン様。\nおいで、ゴブリン達。\n武器を出し: Thank you, Goblin Queen. Come, goblins. When you draw your weapons, I'll enchant them.
m920076.ありがとうございます、王子。\nこれで私もまた研究に戻れます！: Thank you, Prince. Now I can get back to my research!

Could that be... those cursed princes!?
