What are they talking about...?
I'll eavesdrop quietly.
m920076.あれは暗黒騎士団長のデシウス！\n生きていたのですね……。:
That's the Dark Knight Commander, Decius!
He's still alive...!
m920076.あれ？ バルバストラフさん？\nわぁ、お久しぶりです！\nお元気そうで何よりです: Oh? Barbastroff-san? Wow, long time no see! Glad to see you're doing well.
m920076.あんな面倒な術は魔導書を見なければ使えないわ。\nゴブリン軍の強化の為に、また新: You can't use that troublesome spell without looking at the grimoire. I need to devise a new method to strengthen the goblin army.
m920076.あーもう！ 魔力が武器定着しないじゃない！\n微量な魔力の調整は苦手なのよねぇ。:
Ugh! My magic won't stick to my weapons!
I'm terrible at fine-tuning tiny amounts of magic.
m920076.いいタイミングじゃない。\n王子、残念だったわねぇ。\nアナタたちはここで死ぬこ: What perfect timing. Prince, how disappointing. You'll meet your end here.
m920076.うふふ。私の魔力をもってすれば、\nメレディスの力を何倍にも上げる事が出来る。\: Heh heh. With my magic, I can amplify Meredith's power manyfold. Dawn of the new goblin army!
m920076.うるさいわねえ。\n魔法の研究は大衆の為じゃなかったのぉ？\nあまりにうるさいと: You're so noisy. Magic research wasn't meant for the masses, was it? If you keep yapping, I might have to get serious.
m920076.えっとですね、付与魔術師というのは、\n物質に魔法の力を付与する魔術師です。: Well, an enchantment mage is someone who imbues objects with magical power.
m920076.お、おい！！ メレディスが言っていた研究資料が\n見つかっちまったみたいだぞ……: Hey, hey!! It looks like Meredith's research documents have been found... This is bad, isn't it?!
m920076.おいおい、そんなのアリかよ。\nただでさえ、豚の攻撃が痛いのに、\nその上にゴブ: Hey, hey, is that even allowed? The pig attacks are already painful enough, and now the Goblin Queen's riding on top!
m920076.お主、まだここで研究をするつもりか！？\nまた魔物が攻めてこないとも限らんのじゃ: You still intend to conduct research here?! You never know when another monster might attack.
m920076.くっ……ゴブリン兵たち！ \nワタシがこの資料を読み解くまで、\nこいつらを足止: Damn… Goblin troops! Keep them at bay until I finish deciphering these documents!
m920076.ぐっ……！\n見つかってしまった！ これでは戦うしかない……。\nゴーレムに紛れ:
Guh...!
I've been discovered! Now I have no choice but to fight...
If I blend in with the golems, maybe I can manage.
m920076.ここが魔法都市か。噂には聞いていたが、\n本当に魔術の研究だけを行っていたようだ:
So this is the magical city. I'd heard rumors, but
it really seems they only study sorcery here.
I hope I can acquire new power... huh?
m920076.このままではゴブリン達が\n付与魔術の資料を見つけるのは時間の問題です。: If we don't act, the goblins will soon find those materials.
m920076.これでよし……。\n皆さん、お待たせしました。\n転送魔法陣をこれより起動させま: That'll do… Everyone, thank you for waiting. We'll now activate the teleportation circle!
m920076.ご心配には及びませン。あの様な魔術などなくとも、\nゴブリンクイーン様には私の頭: No need to worry, my lady. Even without such sorcery, Your Majesty, I have my intellect at your disposal. All you have to do is give me orders.
m920076.さあ、時は満ちました。\n王子……貴方の力を存分にお示しください。\nきっと、忘:
Now the time has come.
Prince… show us the full extent of your power.
This will be a night you won't forget.
m920076.しかし、私は研究を行った者として責任を\n取らなければなりません！\n足手まとい: But as the one who conducted this research, I must take responsibility! I may be a burden, but please let me accompany you.
m920076.して、どうするのじゃ？\nゴーレムの動かし方や、付与魔術の使い方を\n知られてし: So, what now? If they learn how to move golems or use enchantment magic, that'll be trouble.
m920076.して、どうやってこの魔法都市に入るのだ？: So, how are we going to get into this Magic City?
m920076.じゃあやることは一つだな、王子。\n正面突破すりゃあいいんだろ？: Then there's only one thing to do, Prince. Just charge straight through, right?
m920076.すごい……。\n全ての見張りを倒してしまうなんて……！\nお強いのですね、王子は: Amazing… to take down all the guards…! You're strong, Prince.
m920076.そうか……ならばもう何も言うまい。\n昔からこうと決めたらテコでも動かんからな…: I see… then I have nothing more to say. Once I've decided something, even a lever won't move… Meredith, do as you please.
m920076.そうですね。それに、転送魔法陣を起動した事で、\n都市の中から魔物に操られた\n: Indeed. Also, by activating the circle, some golems controlled by monsters might emerge from the city.
m920076.そこに、さらにゴブリンが攻めてきて、\n付与魔術の研究と使い方を教えろと脅迫され: Then the goblins attacked again, demanding that I teach them how to use enchantment magic.
m920076.それが……魔法都市にゴブリンが攻めて来て\n付与魔術を探していたみたいだから、\: Well... goblins attacked the Magic City, apparently looking for enchantments, so I pretended to guide them and slipped away when I got a chance...
m920076.それでは王子、魔法都市の魔物も追い払い\nメレディスさんの安全も確保出来ましたの: Then, Prince, having cleared the magical city of monsters and ensured Meredith's safety, let's return.
m920076.それと王子……いつか恩返しをしたいので、\n魔法の事で困った時は、すぐに私を呼ん: And Prince… I'd like to repay you someday, so if you ever run into magical trouble, just call me. I'll come to your aid anytime.
m920076.それなら尚更まずいですね。\nゴブリンクイーンは魔物の中でも魔力が強く、\n魔法: That makes it even worse. The Goblin Queen's magic is among the strongest of all monsters, and her spellcraft is unparalleled.
m920076.それに関してはお任せ下さい。\n転送魔法陣の起動を行います。: Leave that to me. I'll activate the teleportation circle.
m920076.ただ、私は知識をまとめた本がないと戦えません。\n……実は、逃げるのに必死で戦闘: The problem is, I can't fight without the book that contains all my knowledge. …In my haste to escape, I left that combat manual back in the Magic City…
m920076.つきました。\nここが、魔法都市の入口です……が、\n多数のゴブリン達が見張って: We've arrived. This is the entrance to the Magic City... but it looks like a lot of goblins are on watch.
m920076.と、言う訳じゃ王子。\nわしも久しぶりに本気を出してやるわい。\nしっかりとここ:
That's right, Prince.
It's been a while, but I'm going to give it my all.
Show us what your power can do here.
m920076.とは言っても、他にいい手はあるのかよ？: Even so, is there any better option?
m920076.なんと、転送魔法陣も起動出来るようになったか。\nお主、一体どれだけ研究をしてい: So you've even managed to fire up the teleportation circle? How much research have you done? I can't even do that.
m920076.なんとか隙をついて逃げて来たのですが、\n付与魔術の膨大な研究資料を\n魔法都市: I managed to slip away, but I left behind a massive trove of enchantment research in the city…
m920076.なんとッ！？ 魔法都市にゴブリンが……？\n一体何があったんじゃ……？: What!? Goblins in the Magic City...? What on earth happened...?
m920076.なんなんだあいつは、あんなに叫んじまって……。\n何回も俺達に戦いを挑んできて負: What the heck is he doing, screaming like that... He keeps challenging us to fights, keeps losing, yet he just won't give up.
m920076.はぁ……はぁ……。\nなんて凄まじい魔力なの……。\n抵抗する暇さえ与えてもらえ: Hah... hah... What an overwhelming magic... I didn't even get a chance to resist...
m920076.はぁ……はぁ……た、助けて下さい！\n私、ゴブリンに追われていて……。: Huff... huff... p-please help! I'm being chased by goblins...
m920076.はい、バルバストラフさん。\n昔と変わらず、私のわがままを許していただき、\n本: Yes, Barbastroff. As always, thank you for tolerating my whims.
m920076.はい。そして武器に付与する魔力においても同じです。\n武器に魔力を付与する事が難:
Yes. And it's the same with enchantments on weapons.
Enchanting a weapon is difficult, but
maintaining that magic is relatively easy.
m920076.はい。入り口は今見えている\n転送魔法陣しかありません。: Yes. The only entrance is the teleportation circle we can see right now.
m920076.ふふっ、バルバストラフさんにも後で教えてあげます。\n……あれ？ 上手く起動して: Heh, I'll teach you later, Barbastroff. …Huh? It's not activating properly. Maybe the goblins tampered with it…
m920076.ふふっ、今度は魔法都市に\n防衛機能でも追加してみせるわ。\n……それに、私はこ: Heh, this time I'll add some defensive mechanisms to the magical city. …And besides, I love this place.
m920076.ふん、私は別に賛同したわけではないのだがな。\n（バルバストラフが本気を出すとい:
Hmph, I'm not exactly on board with this.
(If Barbastroff's going all out, I can't hold back either…!)
m920076.むっ……。\n面倒なタイミングで\nゴブリンに見つかってしまったようじゃな。: Hmph… at an inconvenient time, it seems we've been spotted by goblins.
m920076.む？ お主、誰かと思えばメレディスではないか！: Hm? If it's anyone, it's Meredith!
m920076.もし、付与魔術の研究資料が魔物に奪われれば、\n武器に魔力の力を付与したり\nゴ: Should the monsters get their hands on my enchantment research, they could start empowering weapons and controlling golems at will.
m920076.もしかしたら、何か作戦があるのかもしれません。\n王子、お気を付けください。: He might have some sort of plan after all. Prince, stay on your guard.
m920076.ようやく姿を現したな、忌々しい王子軍よ！\nよくも我輩の暗黒騎士団を崩壊させてく: At last you show your face, wretched Prince's army! How dare you crush my Dark Knights!
m920076.わかりました……。\n王子、急ぎゴブリンクイーンを追いかけましょう！: Understood... Prince, let's hurry after the Goblin Queen!
m920076.わしが一番に入りたかったのにモーティマめ……。\nまあよい。わしらも後を追うとし: I wanted to go in first, you fool Mortimer... Oh well. We'll follow right after.
m920076.ん？ 何だよ、そんなに慌てて？\nもしかしてマズかったか？: Huh? Why are you in such a hurry? Did something go wrong?
m920076.アナタたち、付与魔術が研究されてた部屋は、\nまだ見つからないのかしら？\nいっ: So, you still haven't found the room where the Enchantment Magic was being studied? How long do you intend to keep me waiting?
m920076.ウフフ……この通り研究資料はいただいたわぁ。\nさっそく付与魔術の真髄を読み解か: Heh heh… I've got the research documents right here. I'll start deciphering the essence of Enchantment magic… Wait, what's this? I can't even read what's written!
m920076.ウフフ……最初からこうしておけばよかったのよ。\nメレディス、ゴブリンたちの武器: Heh... I should've done this from the start. Meredith, imbue the goblins' weapons with magic. Here, your book.
m920076.ギャギャ！ ニンゲン！\nモクヒョウ！ モドッテキタ！: Gya gya! Human! Spot the leopard! We've come back!
m920076.クイーンサマ！\nマホウガキエタ！ マホウガキエタ！: Queen! The magic's back! The magic's back!
m920076.クソッ、魔法都市のゴーレムは強いと聞いていたが、\nまったくの役立たずではないか:
Damn it, I heard the city's golems are strong, but they're
utterly useless...!
Damn, retreat!
m920076.ゴブリンたちが魔法都市の奥へ逃げていきました。\nメレディスさん、大丈夫ですか？: The goblins fled deeper into the Magic City. Meredith, are you alright?
m920076.ゴブリンクイーン様。\n騎獣戦車の準備が出来ましタ。\nゴブリンたちにモ、武器を: Goblin Queen. The Beast-Tank is ready. I've equipped the goblins with weapons.
m920076.ゴブリンクイーン！ 魔導書を返しなさい！\nそれは私が研究して、ようやくたどり着: Goblin Queen! Return the grimoire! It's the result of my research, finally achieved!
m920076.ゴブリン達、魔法都市の奥へ退却するわ。\n本だけ回収してメレディスは捨てておきな: Goblins, retreat deeper into the Magic City. Retrieve only the book and discard Meredith. Now that I understand the enchantment's principle, I don't need her.
m920076.ゴーレムか……。\nまったく、敵にまわるとこれほど\n厄介なものもないな。: Golems, huh… truly, there's nothing more troublesome when the enemy's on our side.
m920076.ゴーレムって見たことありますか？\nあれを動かしていたのは付与魔術師なのです。\: Have you ever seen a golem? It's an enchantment mage who animates those—essentially using mana as a power source.
m920076.サイラス師匠も何だかんだで本気を出すのね？\nよーし、こうなったら私も頑張らなく:
Master Cyrus finally getting serious, huh?
Alright, then I have to step up too!
I won't tolerate any half-measures!
m920076.バルバストラフさんは相変わらずの\n知的好奇心ですね。\n安心してください。そん: Barbastroff, your curiosity is as boundless as ever. Don't worry—I'll handle it, no need to rush—
m920076.メレディスさんも疲れ切っているでしょう。\n落ち着いて話を聞ける場所へ\n一旦帰: Meredith must be exhausted as well. Let's return to a safe place where we can talk calmly.
m920076.メレディスは、魔法都市で魔法の研究をしている\n付与魔術師の第一人者じゃ。\n昔: Meredith is the leading enchanter conducting magical research in the Magic City. I once helped her with a bit of research back in the day.
m920076.メレディスよ……魔法文字を汚く書く癖、\nまだ直していなかったのか……。: Meredith… you still haven't corrected that habit of scribbling magical runes all messy…
m920076.モーティマさん、少しは自重してください。\n味方を危険にさらすわけにはいきません: Mortimer, please be a bit more cautious. We can't afford to put our allies in danger.
m920076.一体何ですか？\n先程、襲って来た黒い鎧の方は……？:
What on earth is that?
The black-armored figure that just attacked...?
m920076.不幸中の幸いって奴だな。\nゴブリンクイーンが付与魔術を覚える前に、\nさっさと: Talk about a silver lining. Before the Goblin Queen can master Enchantment, we'll snatch it back!
m920076.人間の叡智の中枢であった魔法都市が機能を停止\nしている今、我ら魔術師はより鍛錬: With the magical city—the heart of human wisdom—now offline, we mages must train harder and become stronger.
m920076.付与魔術師とは何か……ですか？: What exactly is an enchantment mage?
m920076.任せて下さい、メレディスさん。\nそれでは王子、引き続き周囲を警戒しながら\n交: Leave it to me, Meredith. Then, Prince, let's keep a lookout while taking turns to rest.
m920076.何をしておるメレディス！ \n惚けてないで転送魔法陣の使い方を教えてくれ。\nわ: What are you doing, Meredith! Stop dawdling and tell me how to use the teleport circle. I want to try it myself.
m920076.先ほどのゴブリンの事ですが……、\nあ、その前にまずは、\n魔法都市の事をお伝え: About those goblins earlier… First, I should tell you about the Magic City.

That man's name is Decius. He claimed to be the leader of the Dark Knight order
and was leading them. It's odd that no other members were seen.
m920076.向かって来たゴブリンは全て倒せたようですね。\n残りは奥へと進んでいきました。: It looks like we've taken down every goblin that came our way. The rest have retreated deeper inside.
m920076.大丈夫ですか！？ 早くこちらへ。\n魔物は私達が対処します。: Are you okay!? Come quickly over here. We'll take care of the monsters.
m920076.奴は禁忌とされる魔界の力を使い、\n暗黒騎士の仲間の魂を糧として、力を得たのじゃ:
He used the forbidden demonic power,
feeding on the souls of his Dark Knight comrades to gain strength.
There are no comrades left, I suppose...
m920076.彼は自ら禁忌を犯したのですか……。\n自身や周りに凄まじい反動がある故に、\n禁:
He violated the taboo himself?
Because of the massive backlash on himself and those around him,
it's foolish to use something marked as forbidden...
m920076.悔しいってどういうことだよ……ったく。\nまあいいか。おい、王子。\nさっさと準: Frustrated? What do you mean… damn it. Fine. Hey, Prince. Get ready quickly. Let's make a flashy assault.
m920076.悔しいですが、今回ばかりはモーティマさんの\n作戦でいくしかないようですね。: It's frustrating, but it seems we have to go with Mortimer's plan this time.
m920076.愚痴をこぼす暇があったらお主も準備せい。\n……王子たちだけではちと厳しかろう。: If you've got time to complain, get ready yourself. …It'll be a bit tough for just the Prince and his crew.
m920076.我輩はもっともっと強くなる必要があるのだ！\n……そうだ、強くなければ……いけな: I have to become ever stronger! …That's right—if I'm not stronger… I must be!
m920076.我輩は転送魔法陣で逃げる！\n覚えていろよ！ 忌々しい王子！: I'll escape using a teleportation circle! Remember that, damned Prince!
m920076.敵を全部倒したみたいですね。\n王子、お疲れ様です。: Looks like we've cleared all the foes. Prince, good work.

m920076.本当ですね……。\nデシウスはあれからずっと、\n魔法都市に居たのでしょうか……: It's true… Has Decius been inside the magical city all this time…?

m920076.王子、またデシウスが現れるようになりましたね。\n今後も襲ってくる可能性がありま: Prince, Decius has started showing up again. He may keep attacking us, so let's stay on guard.
m920076.王子、ようやく来てくれたのですね。\n今宵は私達のお願いに応じてくださり、\nた:
Prince, you've finally arrived.
We can only express our gratitude for answering our request tonight.
m920076.王子、ゴブリンの武器に\n魔力が付与されているようです。\n魔法に耐性が高い兵達: Prince, the goblins' weapons seem to be enchanted. Deploy the troops with high magic resistance!
m920076.王子、ゴブリンの群れが迫ってきます！\n戦いの準備を！: Prince, a horde of goblins is closing in! Prepare for battle!
m920076.王子、ゴブリンを魔法都市から\n全て追い払ったようです。: Prince, it looks like we've driven all the goblins out of the magical city.
m920076.王子、ゴブリン達は総力戦を仕掛けて来るようです。\n慎重な采配をお願いします。: Prince, the goblins are launching an all-out assault. Please command us carefully.
m920076.王子、急ぎ戦いのご準備を。: Prince, hurry and prepare for battle.

m920076.王子、魔物を発見したという\n報告があった場所はこの付近です。: Prince, the area where the report said the monsters were sighted is around here.
m920076.王子！ 急いでモーティマさんを追いかけましょう！: Prince! Let's chase after Mortimer right away!
m920076.王子！ 隠れていないで出て来い！\n魔法都市内にいることは解っているぞ！: Prince! Stop hiding and step out! I know you're inside the magical city!
m920076.申し訳ありません、王子。\n解除するのに少し時間がかかりそうですので、\nしばら: My apologies, Prince. Deactivating it will take a bit, so could you keep watch on the surroundings for a while?
m920076.私が時間をかけて研究してきた成果が魔物達に\n悪用され、人を傷つける道具になって: The thought of my hard-won discoveries being twisted into tools that hurt people… I was prepared for that, but…
m920076.私だけが読めればいいと思って……。\nこればっかりはそう簡単に直せませんよ……。: I just thought it'd be fine as long as I could read them myself… This isn't something I can just fix that easily…
m920076.私なんかがこのような場にいてもいいのでしょうか。\n……で、でも、せっかくの機会:
Is it even okay for someone like me to be here?
…But, this is a chance, so for the Prince… I'll do my best!
m920076.私はいったいどうしたらいいのでしょう……。: I don't know what I'm supposed to do…
m920076.私はメレディス。\n魔力を源とするあらゆる学術の研究をしている\n「魔法都市」の: I'm Meredith, a mage from the “Magic City” who studies every discipline that draws on magical energy.
m920076.私は魔法都市内のわずかな生き残りと共に、\n魔物に見つからないようにと身を隠しな: I survived with a handful of survivors, hiding from the monsters while secretly continuing my research.
m920076.聞いた話だと、軍団が崩壊したのは、\n禁忌を破ってまで力を求めた結果でしょ？\n: From what I've heard, the legion fell because they broke the taboo in their quest for power. It's just a case of them getting what they deserved.
m920076.見つけました！ ゴブリンクイーン！\n私の研究成果を返しなさい！:
I've found you! Goblin Queen!
Return my research results!
m920076.解読出来ても、すぐに使えるものではないです。\nですが、ゴブリンクイーンは魔力が: Even if we manage to decipher it, we can't use it right away. But the Goblin Queen seems to have magical power, so mastering it shouldn't take long…
m920076.触媒の魔導書はいまだゴブリンクイーンの手にあります。\nそれに、ゴブリンの武器に: The catalyst grimoire is still in the Goblin Queen's hands. And the goblins' weapons still retain the magic. I have to do something quickly...
m920076.訓練終了です、王子。\n魔法の力は侮れない事。\nお分かりいただけましたかな。:
Training's over, Prince.
Magic's power is not to be taken lightly.
Do you understand?
m920076.負けてしまったわ……。\n所詮この娘を介した付与魔術なんてこんなものね。\nやっ: We've been defeated... After all, this enchantment through the girl is nothing special. I really do need to use my own magic to enchant.
m920076.頼もしいわねぇ♪ それじゃあすぐに新たな\n武器を造りなさい。それもとびきり凶悪: How reliable…♪ Then forge a brand-new weapon right away—make it truly vicious. Heh heh… I'm looking forward to it. Come on, goblins, let's go home.
m920076.魔の力を得る事で代償に肉体を失い、\n鎧だけの存在となった暗黒騎士というものだ。:
It's a Dark Knight—someone who gained demonic power at the cost of losing their body,
becoming nothing but armor.
m920076.魔力の命令はさらに強い魔力で、\n命令の上書きが出来るという訳だな……。:
The magical command is even stronger magic,
so overwriting the command is possible, I see...
m920076.魔力の精髄を極めんと欲する魔術師達が、\nこうして一堂に会するなんて……ふふ。\: To think so many mages seeking the essence of magic gather here… Heh, it makes my heart race as a seeker of mysteries.
m920076.魔法都市では、一部の禁忌とされる魔法以外は\n全てが研究対象となっているのですが: In the Magic City, everything except the forbidden arts is a subject of research, and I've been focusing on enchantment magic.
m920076.魔法都市の中にもゴブリンがいるのだろう？\n挟み撃ちされる前に、まずはこいつらを: There must be goblins inside the Magic City too? Before we get flanked, it'd be wise to take these guys out first.
m920076.魔物が復活して、魔術の研究者が多く住んでいた\n魔法都市でさえも、魔物の猛威によ: Even the Magic City, once teeming with researchers, fell apart under the onslaught of monsters.
m920076.魔術には様々な系統があり、\n魔力を具現化する術式や魔力によって幻覚を\n作り出: There are many branches of magic—spells that materialize mana, spells that create hallucinations with mana, and so on.
m920076.（武器に魔法を付与するだと？ 良い事を聞いたぞ、\n我輩の剣に魔法を付与出来るか:
(Enchanting a weapon, you say? That's good news.
I might be able to imbue my sword with magic.
I should go find that enchantment technique right away.)

m920083.60%！？\nまさか、さっきのは手を抜いてたとでも言うのですか！？: 60%!? You're saying you were holding back just now!?
m920083.――……探したぞ、ドゥーラ。\nそろそろ私達の試合が始まるぞ。: —…I've been looking for you, Doula. Our match is about to start.
m920083.――あ～、大会参加者諸君。\n本日の試合はこれにて全て終了した。: …Ladies and gentlemen of the tournament, today's matches are concluded.
m920083.――いや待て。そこにいる奴、\n隠れてないで姿を見せろ。:
――Hold on. You there,
stop hiding and show yourself.
m920083.――ここが前回のチャンピオンが作らせた、\nジャングルを模した訓練設備だ。: —Here's the training ground the last champion built, a jungle-like arena.
m920083.――その必要はないよ、人間たち。\n何故なら、君たちは此処で永遠の眠りにつくのだ: No need for that, humans. You'll be taking an eternal sleep right here.
m920083.――と、そろそろ主催者からのルール説明がある。\nしっかり聞いておくんだぞ、王子: —And the organizers will go over the rules soon. Listen carefully, Prince.
m920083.――と、伝え忘れるところだった。\n魔界に満ちる瘴気に関してだが、あれは地上界に:
—Ah, I almost forgot to mention.
Regarding the miasma that fills the Demon Realm, we understand it's only harmful to those from the surface.
m920083.――なにッ！？ 魔獣オルトロスだと！\nなるほど、次から次に魔獣を呼び出す気か！:
――What!? Ortroth?!
So you're just keep summoning beasts one after another!
m920083.――まさか人間にこれほどの奴がいるとはねえ。\n王子だったか？ あんたの名前、憶: ——Who'd have thought a human could have someone like this? You're the Prince, right? I'll remember your name. But… that's all for now.
m920083.――グッ、ふぅ……あと、もう少しだったというのに。: …Damn, so close… just a little more and I could've—
m920083.――チッ。初戦の相手が人間とはナ。\n強いヤツと戦う為ニ来たってのに、拍子抜けだ:
――Tsk. Our first opponents are humans, huh.
We came here to fight strong opponents, and this is a letdown.
m920083.――周囲の状況を確認！\n魔物の姿は見当たりません！:
――Check the surroundings!
No monsters in sight!
m920083.――馬鹿者ォ！ この程度で諦めてどうするッ！？\nまぐれとはいえ、\n我輩に勝っ: ――Fool! How can you give up just because it's this easy?! Even if it was a fluke, I can't believe the attitude of those who beat me!
m920083.――魔界武術大会ッ！？\n何ですか、それは！: —The Demon-realm Martial Arts Tournament!? What on earth is that!
m920083.――黙れ、グレーターデーモン！\nもう我輩は貴様の部下でもなんでもない！: ――Shut up, Greater Demon! I'm no longer your subordinate or anything!
m920083.…………デシウスさん、行ってしまいましたね。\n何を考えているのか分からない所も: ………Decius-san has left. I can't quite tell what he's thinking, but maybe he isn't a born villain after all….
m920083.…………行ってしまわれました。\n見たところ、ドゥーラさんのチームには、\n弓の: ………He's gone. It looks like Doula's team also has an archer among them.
m920083.……ああ、それでいい。\nそれじゃあ、正式な参加表明として\n今の言葉を受け取っ:
…Alright, that works.
Then, consider these words my official declaration of participation, Prince.
m920083.……あっ！ すまねぇっ！ \nつい、昂っちまってよ。\n……すぐ行くから待ってて: …Ah! Sorry about that! I got a little carried away. I'll be right there, just wait!
m920083.……あの旗はオークの士気を高める軍旗のようですね。\n私達で言う王子……みたいな: …That flag looks like a morale-boosting banner for the Orcs. It's probably their version of a… “Prince” symbol.
m920083.……ありがとう。王子の下でなら\n今よりずっと強くなる事ができそうだ。\n今後と: ...Thank you. Under your command, Prince, I think I can become far stronger than I am now. I look forward to working with you!
m920083.……あーっ、参加者諸君。おはよう。\n昨夜は魔界最高級の宿泊施設を\nたっぷりと:
…Ah, participants. Good morning.
Did you get to fully enjoy the finest demonic lodging last night?
m920083.……いきなり竜人種が相手か。\nヤツらは単独でも強いが、いつも試合中に\n守り神:
……Facing the draconians right off the bat, huh.
They're strong even alone, but they always have their guardian dragon crashing the match. Watch out.
m920083.……おいおい。もしかしてオレの力を甘く見てないか？\n前回は60%程度しか出して: …Hey, hey. Don't think you've got me figured out. Last time I only used about 60 % of my power… Fine, I'll show you 80 % right now!
m920083.……これより魔界武術大会\nエキシビジョンマッチを開始する。: ...We will now commence the exhibition match of the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament.
m920083.……す、すごい歓声です。\nあの方が姿を見せた途端、\n会場全体の雰囲気が変わり: ...What an amazing roar. The moment that person appeared, the whole arena's atmosphere shifted...!
m920083.……すごい、あっという間に\n場を収めてしまいました。: …Wow, that was over in the blink of an eye.
m920083.……すごい。\nまるで地上のジャングルのようですね。: ……Amazing. It's just like a real jungle on the surface.
m920083.……それじゃ早速始めようかね。\n第一回戦は人間代表、王子チームvs竜人代表、\: …Then let's get started. The first round is Human representatives, Prince's team versus Dragon-folk representatives, the Goliath team.
m920083.……そんな。\nやはりこちらの申し立てを聞く気はないようですね……。:
…I see.
As expected, they have no intention of listening to our protest…
m920083.……ともあれ、武術大会の優勝おめでとうございます！\n改めて王子の強さに感動して: …Anyway, congratulations on winning the tournament! I'm truly impressed by the Prince's strength. Then, let's return to the human world. Thank you for everything!
m920083.……どういうことでしょうか？\n彼女は仲間の姿が見えませんが。\nまさか、一人で:
…What does that mean?
She can't see any allies.
Is she saying she'll fight alone?
m920083.……どうやら今は敵意はないようです。\n王子、とりあえず話だけでも聞いてみましょ: …Seems they're not hostile right now. Prince, let's at least hear what they have to say.
m920083.……ふあぁ……つまらない試合ねぇ。\nあくびが出てしまうわ。:
…Ugh… what a boring match.
It's making me yawn.
m920083.……ふん、デシウスめ、案の定負けたか。\nほんのちょっとでも期待したワシが\nバ: Hmph, as expected, Decius lost. I was foolish to have even a sliver of hope…
m920083.……へぇ、意外にやるじゃないか。\nあまり興味はなかったが、\n少しあんた達に興: …Huh, not bad at all. I wasn't really interested, but you've sparked a bit of curiosity.
m920083.……よかった。\n捕虜の皆さんは解放されたようです。: ...That's a relief. It looks like all the prisoners have been set free.
m920083.……ん？ ゴブリンが４匹に、戦車が１匹。\nあと戦車の上にゴブリンが３……おい！:
…Hm? Four goblins, one tank.
And three goblins on top of the tank… Hey!
Aren't those goblins ignoring the unit limit?!
m920083.……ゴブリンにも色々とあるようですね。\n王子、準決勝お疲れ様でした。次はいよい: …Looks like goblins have their own dramas too. Prince, great job in the semifinals. The finals are next—let's aim for the championship!
m920083.……優勝は王子チーム。\nまったくもってつまらない結果だねぇ……それじゃ。: …The champion is the Prince's team. How… boring. Well then.
m920083.……断っても面倒そうだねぇ。\n――……ほら、甚だ不本意ではあるが\n捕虜の人間: …Refusing would be a hassle. …Fine, though I'm not thrilled about it, I've let the human captives go.
m920083.あ……す、すみません。\n嬉しくて、つい……。:
Ah… s-sorry.
I got carried away…
m920083.あぁ……両者、準備はいいかね？ \nそれでは魔界武術大会二回戦、人間代表\n王子:
Alright… are both sides ready?
Then the second round of the Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament begins: Human representatives, Prince's team vs. Lone Monster Tamer. Begin!
m920083.あぁっ！ 壊れた壁の隙間から、\n魔物がこちらに向かってきています！: Ah! Through the broken wall, monsters are coming toward us!
m920083.ああ、その時が楽しみだよ。\n必ず決勝まで勝ち進んでこい。\n最高の舞台で、アン: Ah, I'm looking forward to that. Make it to the finals, and I'll get to battle you on the grandest stage.
m920083.あちらをご覧下さい、王子！\nどうやら、次の対戦相手が出てきたようですよ。:
Look over there, Prince!
It seems our next opponent has appeared.
m920083.あと、種族間での不利を無くす為に、\n瘴気は会場に入らない様にしている……すごい: Also, to eliminate racial disadvantages, the miasma is kept out of the arena… impressive.
m920083.あの場で断ってしまうのは会場すべてを敵に回す\nようなものだからな……改めて優勝: Refusing there would've turned the whole arena against us... Congratulations again on the victory, Prince. The match with you lot was a lot of fun.
m920083.あの方の気迫、尋常ではありません。\n王子、くれぐれも油断なさらぬよう！: His spirit is beyond ordinary. Prince, please don't let your guard down!
m920083.あの旗が振られている限り、オークの方々は\n士気が高く、普段以上の力を発揮してい: As long as that banner's up, the Orcs will be fired up and stronger than usual. Prince, stay on guard!
m920083.ありがとうございます。\nドゥーラさんこそ流石の気迫でした。\n試合が長引けば、: Thank you. Doula, you were truly impressive. If the match had dragged on, who knows what might've happened.
m920083.あれぇ？ もしかして次の相手って人間？\nふふっ、私ってついてるかも。\nこれな:
???: Huh? Could the next opponent be human?
Heh, maybe I'm lucky…
This should be easy.
m920083.あれは、オーク……！？\nなぜ、ここに……？: That's an orc…!? Why is it here…?
m920083.あれはグレーターデーモンを超える究極の存在、\nゴールデンデーモン……？！\n…:
That's the ultimate being that even surpasses the Greater Demon… the Golden Demon?!
…But in this miasma-filled situation…!
m920083.あーら、面白そうじゃない。\nどうせ何やったっていいって話よ、\n人間どもをいた:
Ah, that sounds fun.
It doesn't matter what we do, let's just torment those humans.
m920083.うぅむ……これは計算外だねぇ。\nだが、まだ他にもやりようはあるか……。\n明日:
Ugh… this wasn't in the calculations.
But there are still other ways… Tomorrow during the tournament, I'll show you hell, hmm….
m920083.うるさいな、デシウス君は。\n君が少しでも戦いやすくなる様にしてあげてるんだから: Quiet, Decius. I'm doing you a favor by making the battle easier for you, so you should be grateful.
m920083.うーんこれは大変だ……しかしこの盛り上がりに\n水を差すのも野暮だよねぇ……うむ: Hmm, this is a bit of a mess… but it'd be rude to rain on this excitement. So, audience, consider this a warm-up—join in however you like.
m920083.えーっ……それじゃ早速今日の試合を始めようかね。\n魔界武術大会、準決勝のカード:
Well then, let's get today's match started.
The semifinal card for the Demon Martial Arts Tournament is…
Prince's team vs Goblin Doctor's team!
m920083.おい、あんなのアリかよ！？\n前に戦ったときとは比べものにならない威圧感だぞ！: Hey, is that even allowed!? He's got an intimidation factor unlike anything we faced before!
m920083.おい、グレーターデーモン！\n優勝者とサシの勝負って聞いてたのに、\nこれはいっ: Hey, Greater Demon! I was told this was a one-on-one with the champion, so what's going on?
m920083.おいおい、そんな目で睨まないでくれ。\nこれは今大会の主催者が決めたことなんだ。:
Hey, don't give me that look.

...Even I don't want to do something so underhanded.
m920083.おのレ……ニンゲンめ、次こそハ……。: You… you human, next time I'll—
m920083.お姉さま。餌にしてしまうなんてもったいないです。\nお仕置きでしたら殺さず生かさ: Sister, turning them into feed would be a waste. If it's punishment, why not keep them alive yet helpless? That should be more fun.
m920083.お気持ちはわかりますが、捕虜がいる以上\n軽はずみな行動は出来ません。\n抑えて:
I understand how you feel, but with prisoners still alive,
we can't act recklessly.
Please restrain yourselves…
m920083.か、勘違いをするな！\n別に貴様らの為に戦ったわけではない。\nこれは、我輩の面: D-Don't get the wrong idea! I didn't fight for your sake. This was all for my own pride!!
m920083.けっ、グレーターデーモンの野郎ぬけぬけと。\nどうせまた何か企んでやがんだろうな:
Hmph, that Greater Demon is so brazen.
He's probably scheming something again.
m920083.こうして王子に会いに来たのは、他でもない。\nアンタが魔界武術大会にエントリーさ:
I came here to meet you, Prince, and that's no coincidence.
You entered the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament,
and I brought your invitation.
m920083.ここが、魔界武術大会の会場か。\nすげぇ熱気だな……！: So this is the venue for the Demon-realm Martial Arts Tournament. The heat's intense…!
m920083.この凄まじい気迫は……！？\nま、まさかアナトリアの戦いを間近で見れるなんて！\: This incredible spirit…!? I— I can't believe I get to watch Anatolia's fight up close! Aaaah! Champ! Champ!!
m920083.この程度ではしゃぐな、みっともない。\nまだ大会は始まったばかりなんだぞ？:
Don't get all excited over this; it's pathetic.
The tournament's just getting started, you know?
m920083.この調子で二回戦目も勝ってくれよ、王子。\nそうすれば、いずれオレのチームとも戦:
Keep this up and win the second round too, Prince.
Then maybe we'll finally get to face my team.
When that happens, I'll fight you with my full power.
m920083.これで話は終わりだ。\nさあ、とっとと出発の準備をしろ、王子。\n大会は明日開催:
That's all for now.
Now, get ready to depart, Prince.
The tournament starts tomorrow. We'll head to the Demon Realm right away.
m920083.これは……王子、試合場には微量ですが\n毒が撒いてあるようです。ご注意ください。: Prince, there's a trace of poison scattered around the arena. Please be careful.
m920083.さぁ、いよいよ魔界武術大会も大詰め。\n両チーム、入場してくれたまえ。: At last, the Demon War Tournament reaches its climax. Both teams, step onto the arena.
m920083.さすがお姉さま、ステキですわ！\n……三女！ アンタが言い出したんだから\nちゃ:
As always, sister, you're wonderful!
…Third sister! Since you suggested it,
make sure you put your heart into the attack!
m920083.さすがは噂の王子とその仲間と言ったところかな。\nわざわざ出向いた甲斐があったと: As expected of the rumored Prince and his companions. It was worth making the trip after all.
m920083.そ、そんな……あたしの魔獣たちが\nみんなやられちゃうなんて……くぅ～っ！\nお: N-no… my beasts… they're all… defeated… kuuh! Remember this…!!
m920083.そ、そんな！ 王子、興奮した観客たちが\n雪崩れ込んできます……急ぎ戦いのご準備: N-no! Prince, the thrilled crowd is barreling toward us… quickly get ready for battle!
m920083.そういうな。大会優勝者と、主催者の用意した\n魔界指折りの猛者とのエキシビジョン: Don't say that. An exhibition match between the tournament winner and the strongest fighters the demon realm can field is a tradition. ...What do you think, feeling the fire yet?
m920083.そうかい？ そういって貰えるなら光栄だね。\nそれで……もしよければなんだが……: Oh, is that so? I'm honored to hear it. So... if it's okay with you... could you let me join your party?
m920083.そうですね。\nでは、明日の試合に備えて休むとしましょうか。: Right. Then let's rest up for tomorrow's match.
m920083.そうねぇ……可愛い三女の頼みだもの、\n餌はまた今度にしようかしら。それじゃあ\: Hmm… since it's a request from my cute little sister, maybe we'll skip the feed for now. Then the punishment can wait until we get home.
m920083.そう息巻くな、人間の雌よ。\n順を追って説明してやる。とりあえず場所を移そう。: Don't get all worked up, you human female. I'll explain step by step. First, let's move to another spot.
m920083.その参加者は魔界、地上界を問わない。\n強ければ誰でも参加する権利がある。: Participants can be from the Demon Realm or the surface world—anyone strong enough has the right to enter.
m920083.それでは、\n調査を終了して帰還の準備を始めましょうか。: Then, shall we finish the investigation and start preparing to return?
m920083.それでは歴代チャンピオンチーム、\n入場してくれたまえ。: Then, let the team of past champions make their entrance.
m920083.それでも、助けてくれたことには変わりありません。\n王子を救ってくれて、ありがと: Even so, it doesn't change that you saved us. Thank you for rescuing the Prince.
m920083.それに、優勝者の言葉を無下にしようものなら\n大会に泥を塗る事になるからな。アン: And if anyone dares to ignore the champion's word, they'll stain the tournament's reputation. If you win, freeing the captives will be a piece of cake.
m920083.それにしても、さすがにあれだけの\nデーモンを相手にするのは一苦労だった……。\: Still, taking on that many demons was a real grind… Honestly, I'm more exhausted than from the match itself.
m920083.ただ、自由参加だと本当に強い奴が集まるとは\n限らない。そこで、主だった種族の中:
But if it's open to anyone, we can't guarantee that the truly strong will gather.
So we specially invite the strongest from each major race to represent their kind.
m920083.だから大会会場では公平性を期すため、\n瘴気はきっちりと遮断される。\nアンタ達:
So, to keep things fair at the venue, the miasma will be fully sealed off.
You'll be able to fight in perfect condition.
m920083.だが、それ以上に王子。\nアンタたちの強さは本物だな。\n次はもう準決勝だ。: But more importantly, Prince… your team's strength is genuine. Next up is the semifinals.
m920083.だが逆に考えてみろ。これはある意味でチャンスだ。\nそう、魔界に囚われた人間たち:
But think about it the other way. It's a chance, in a sense.
Yes, a chance to free the humans imprisoned in the Demon Realm.
m920083.ちょうど予選が終わった所みたいだな。\n招待枠である王子たちは本戦からのスタート: Looks like the prelims just wrapped up. The invited Prince teams start straight in the main event, so their turn's coming soon. Stay sharp.
m920083.つべこべ言わずに戦いの準備をしろ！\nなぁに、前哨戦みたいなもんさ……行くぞ！: Stop the chatter and get ready to fight! Think of it as a warm-up… Let's go!
m920083.ですが、捕虜の皆さんを解放する為にも負けられません。\n王子、明日の為にも\n今: But we can't afford to lose, especially to free the captives. Prince, for tomorrow's sake, please get some proper rest now.
m920083.ですが今回の戦いで、大会のルールが\nこちらにとって不利なものとなる可能性が\n: This battle made me realize the tournament rules could end up working against us… I'm worried about what's ahead.
m920083.では……両者、準備はいいかね？\nそれでは、魔界武術大会三回戦、\n王子チームv: So… are both sides ready? Then let the third round of the Infernal Martial Arts Tournament begin: Prince's team versus the Dark Knight Decius team. Fight!
m920083.でも、王子とデシウス君じゃ勝敗が見えてて\nつまらないしねぇ……そうだ、観客を盛: But a match between you and the Prince is predictable and dull… how about we spice things up for the audience and sprinkle some poison this time?
m920083.というわけだ王子、次やるときは決勝だな。\nその時はオレの本気を見せてやるよ！: So, Prince, next time we meet it'll be the finals. I'll show you my true power then! See you…
m920083.とはいえ、十分な休息をとらなくては力は発揮できません。\n王子、案内係に従って宿: Still, we need proper rest if we're to fight at our best. Prince, let's follow the guide to the accommodations.
m920083.とんでもないです！ ドゥーラさんが\n仲間になってくれるのであればとても心強いで: Not at all! If Doula joins us, that'll be a huge boost. We'd be delighted to have you on board!
m920083.どぅ、ドゥーラさんのテンションがおかしな事に……。: D-do you see how Doula's getting all worked up…?
m920083.なぜなら、人間代表として選ばれた王子が\n不参加となれば、魔界にいる人間の捕虜、: Because if the human representative, the Prince, doesn't show up, all human captives in the Demon Realm will be killed.
m920083.なんのことかな？ 戦闘に参加するのは\nゴブリン戦車1とゴブリン4、\nつまり足:
What are you talking about? The combatants are
the goblin tank and four goblins,
so that's five in total. No violation at all.
m920083.はぁ……はぁ……\nな、なんとか……追い払えたようだな。: Hah… hah… I… I think we managed to drive them off.
m920083.はい、任せてくださいお姉さま！\n人間たちをびっくりさせてやります！:
Yes, leave it to me, sister!
We'll give those humans a real surprise!
m920083.はい、何だか身体が熱くなってきました！\n王子、最後の試合も頑張りましょうね！: Yes, I can feel my body heating up! Prince, let's give it our all in this final match!
m920083.はうぅ……オーク族の方は、\nやはり闘いになると\n人が変わってしまうようですね: Huh… The Orcs really change when it comes to battle…
m920083.ひ、卑怯な……！\nこれでは王子軍が――: C-cheating…! That means the Prince's side—
m920083.ふぅむ。何か手違いがあったのかもしれないねぇ……。\n今度からは気をつけるよ。今: Hmm. Maybe there was a mix-up… I'll be more careful next time. From now on… yeah.
m920083.ふっ、言われなくとも勝つさ。\nそれじゃあな。三回戦の会場で会おう。: Hah, I'll win even without you saying so. See you at the third round venue.
m920083.ふふっ、やるじゃないか、王子。\n60％の力のオレとでさえ、まともに戦える奴は、: Heh, not bad, Prince. Even at 60% power, there aren't many who can hold their own against me.
m920083.ふむ……あぁ、毎度説明してるとは思うが、\n本大会の試合中、同時に戦闘に参加でき: Hmm… I know I've explained this before, but during the main matches, only up to five participants can fight at once… Got that?
m920083.ふむ……まぁ、そんなところかな。\n後はぁ……そうだな。とにかく勝てばいい。\n: Hmm… that's about it. The rest… right. Just win. Strength is all that matters here, that's all.
m920083.ふむ……まぁ、今回魔物使いさんは一人だしね。\n特例って事で……いいんじゃないか: Hmm… well, there's only one monster tamer this time, so as a special exception… I think it's fine.
m920083.ふん……あまり下らないことはするもんじゃないよ。\nここは戦士の決闘の場なんだ。: Hmph… don't waste time on petty things. This is a warrior's arena. I don't think there'll be a second round… that's all.
m920083.ふん、ハンデみたいなものだ。\n剣の鍛錬にはこれ位でちょうどいい。: Hmph, just a handicap. It's the perfect amount of training for my sword.
m920083.ふム。準備は万全、行くがよイ！\n我がゴブリンの騎獣戦車ヨ！:
Hmm. We're fully prepared, let's go!
Behold my goblin battle tank!
m920083.ふーっ、いい汗かいたぜ！\nやっぱり強いな、王子は。: Phew, that was a good sweat! The Prince really is strong.
m920083.へぇ……気配を殺していたつもりだったが、\nまさか気づかれてしまうとはね。: Heh… I thought I'd hidden my presence, but you actually saw through it.
m920083.へっ、ナメられたもんだぜ。\nどれだけ強いか知らねぇが、\n五対一で勝てると思っ:
Heh, they're underestimating me.
I don't know how strong you think you are, but do you really think you can win five-on-one?
m920083.ほう……随分と調子にのってるね、デシウス君。\n君の力で王子を倒せると本気で思っ: Huh… you're getting pretty cocky, Decius. You really think you can defeat the Prince with your power? I could even let you fight under favorable rules.
m920083.まぁ、あくまでも優勝できたらの話だがな。: Well, that's only if you actually manage to win.
m920083.まさか、あのような不利な状況でも\n勝利を収めるとは……やるじゃないか、王子！: I never imagined you'd win even under such unfavorable odds… well done, Prince!
m920083.まさか魔界の宿泊施設を利用するとは\n夢にも思いませんでしたね。: I never imagined we'd be staying at a demonic inn.
m920083.またまた人間たちの勝利か……うぅむ、つまらないねぇ。\n人間たちがボロボロになる: Another victory for the humans… hmm, how boring. I'd love to see them get torn to shreds. …Well, I'll look forward to the next round.
m920083.まだ分からぬか？ ワシらはね、\nこの大会に王子を呼び出して殺すのが目的だったの: Still don't get it? Our goal was to summon the Prince to this tournament and kill him.
m920083.まったくですわ、お姉さま。騎獣の餌にした方が\nよっぽど有意義かもしれませんわ。: Indeed, sister. Feeding them to our riding beasts might be far more… productive.
m920083.まったく実力の底が見えないヤツだった。\nもし本気で来てたらと思うと……ゾッとす: He was a total mystery—no hint of his true power. If he'd been serious… that's chilling…
m920083.もしオレが本気を出して王子を殺しでもしたら、\n魔界武術大会の御偉方から大目玉を: If I went all out and killed you, the bigwigs of the Demon-realm Martial Arts Tournament would have my head.
m920083.やった！ 勝ちました！ \n優勝ですよ、王子っ！！: Yes! We won! We're the champions, Prince!!
m920083.ゆ、有利なルール！？ \nそれは魅力的な……いやいやいや！\n我輩は自らの力で王: Fav-or-able rules!? That sounds… tempting—no, no, no! I'll beat the Prince with my own strength.
m920083.ようやくこの時が来たな。王子、見せてやるよ。\nオレの100%中の100%……\: Finally, the moment's come. Prince, watch me. I'll unleash 100% of my 100%… no, 120% power!!
m920083.よっしゃ、二回戦目も気合い入れていくぞ、王子。\nこの調子で優勝まで一気に勝ち進:
Alright, let's bring the same fire into round two, Prince.
Let's push straight to the championship!
m920083.んーっ……次は決勝戦。まさか\n人間がここまで勝ち進むとはねぇ。\n次こそ惨めに:
Hmm… finals are next. Who would've thought humans could advance this far?
I hope they'll meet a miserable defeat next time.
m920083.ん？ おかしいね……なぜここにデシウス君がいるのだ？\n君の部屋は用意してなかっ: Hm? That's odd… why is Decius here? I don't think I prepared a room for you… Move aside quickly. You're in the way.
m920083.アナタ達、戦闘準備よ。\n魔獣オルトロス、配置につきなさい！:
You all, prepare for battle.
Ortroth, take your positions!
m920083.オレの名はドゥーラ。オーク族の剣闘士だ。: My name is Doula. I'm an orc gladiator.
m920083.オレはもっともっと強くなりたい。\nアンタ達についていけば、沢山の強者と\n戦う: I want to get stronger, stronger. If I stick with you, I'll get plenty of chances to fight powerful foes... Is that alright?
m920083.オレもアンタみたいな強者とは、何のしがらみもなく\n闘いたい。出来る限りの事であ:
I want to fight someone like you, a strong person, with no strings attached.
If I can help in any way, I'm willing to cooperate…what do you say?
m920083.グッ……オレの負けだ。完敗だよ、王子。: Gah… I've lost. Total defeat, Prince.
m920083.グレーターデーモンが捕虜を解放するのか\n不安でしたが、そういう事でしたら安心で: I was worried the Greater Demon would release the captives, but if that's the case, we can breathe easy.
m920083.デシウス……度し難い愚か者だね、君は。\nいいだろう。王子もろとも皆殺しにしてや: Decius… you're an incorrigible fool. Fine then. I'll just slaughter you and the Prince together. You'll get to taste a demon's true terror firsthand.
m920083.ドゥーラさんのチームも順調に勝ち進んでいますから、\nこのままいけば、決勝戦で\: Doula's team is advancing smoothly, so if things keep going, we might face you in the finals!
m920083.ドゥーラさんも、次の試合がんばってくださいね。: Doula, do your best in the next match.
m920083.フン……少しでも有り難く思っているのならば、\n明日の試合に全て勝ち、大会に優勝: Hmph… if you're even a little grateful, then win every match tomorrow and take the tournament crown.
m920083.ヤツは、前大会優勝者アナトリアだ。\n前大会では傷一つ負う事なく優勝してみせた\: That guy's Anatolia, the winner of the previous tournament. He took the title without a single scratch—truly overwhelming power.
m920083.主催者に対し、異議を申し立てます！\nこれでは大会ルールに違反するのではないでし:
I'd like to raise an objection to the organizers!
Isn't this a violation of the tournament rules?
m920083.主催者に都合の良いルール……。\n王子、こうなったら覚悟を決めてください！\nと: The organizers are bending the rules to suit themselves… Prince, you need to steel yourself now! All we can do is crush them with force!
m920083.人数制限以外ルール無しって事は、\nなんでもありって訳か！？ 魔界のゴロツキ共の: No rules except the participant limit means anything goes, right? Those demon thugs… you never know what they'll do.
m920083.人間の中では王子って訳だ。: Among humans, that's you, the Prince.
m920083.人間をボロボロにすると聞いてたのに……\nとんだ期待はずれねぇ。\n使えない子は: I heard you'd tear humans to shreds… What a disappointment. Guess I'll have to dispose of the useless ones.
m920083.人間代表、王子チームの勝利！\nお約束の守り神の乱入も乗り切るなんて、\nうぅ～:
Human representatives, Prince's team wins!
Even surviving the usual guardian-dragon interruption—
Hmm… not bad at all!
m920083.今回の試合、なんだかよく判らないうちに\nチームにさせられたからねぇ。\nあたし: I don't really get why I was put on a team for this match. I prefer fighting solo.
m920083.今回は素直に感謝せねばなりませんね。\n危ないところを、ありがとうございました。: We really ought to be grateful this time. Thank you for pulling us out of danger.
m920083.今宵は我々が用意した最高級の\n宿泊施設で身体を休めてくれたまえ。\nそれではま: Tonight, rest in the top-tier lodging we've prepared for you. See you tomorrow.
m920083.何はともあれ一回戦突破できて良かったです。\n王子、なんだか私も燃えてきました！:
Anyway, I'm glad we cleared the first round.
Prince, I'm feeling fired up too!
Let's keep winning!
m920083.全くですわ、お姉さま。見ているだけなんて\n退屈ですことよ。……三女！\n何か面:
Indeed, sister. Just watching is so dull.
…Third sister!
Do something entertaining!
m920083.判っちゃいたけどよ。いい加減\n腹が立ってきたぜ。もうちゃっちゃと\nアイツをぶ:
I get it now. I'm getting fed up.
We should just go ahead and crush that guy once and for all.
m920083.古くから続く伝統ある大会……。\nそれも、魔界じゃ数少ない大きな行事のひとつだ。: This tournament's a long-standing tradition… one of the few big events in the Demon Realm. Win, and you can get away with all this craziness.
m920083.名誉な事だぞ――\n――ってなんだと？ 参加を辞退する……？\n……それだけは止:
It's an honor—
—what? You want to decline participation…?
...You'd be better off not doing that.
m920083.大丈夫です！ 今のところ王子は絶好調ですから。\nこのままいけば、絶対に優勝でき: No problem! The Prince is in top form right now. If we keep this up, we'll definitely take the crown!
m920083.対戦カードは……\n今大会優勝王子チームvs\n……歴代チャンピオンチーム！: The match-up is... the champion Prince's team versus... the team of past champions!
m920083.待ちなさい！ グレーターデーモン、\n捕虜の人達を解放しなさい！: Hold it! Greater Demon, release the prisoners!
m920083.恐らくドッペルゲンガーかと。\nどれが本物か判りません、\n王子、冷静な判断をお: It's probably a doppelgänger trick. We can't tell which one's real. Prince, please make a calm judgment.
m920083.既に捕虜の皆さんは解放されているというのに、\nこれ以上戦う意味はあるのでしょう: Even though the prisoners have already been freed, is there any point in fighting any longer...?
m920083.普通に考えれば王子たちが圧倒的に有利だが……\nあの女、自由参加枠で予選からずっ:
Logically, you have the overwhelming advantage…
But that woman entered through the free-entry slot and's been winning solo all the way, so don't get cocky.
m920083.暗黒騎士デシウス、か。\nなかなかに見所のあるヤツじゃないか。\nきっとアイツは: The Dark Knight Decius, huh. He's quite the spectacle. He'll keep getting stronger, that's for sure.
m920083.本来であれば、ここで棄権すべきなのでしょうが、\n魔界にいる捕虜の人間たちを助け: Normally we'd just forfeit here, but until we rescue the human captives in the Demon Realm, we have no choice but to fight by their rules…
m920083.次は王子チームとー……おぉ、これはこれは\nデシウス君、久しぶりだね。元気にして: Next up is the Prince's team—oh my, Decius, long time no see. How have you been?
m920083.決勝はやはりドゥーラさんのようですね。\n彼女であれば卑怯な行い等はないかと思い: The finals will surely be Doula's showdown. She's the kind who plays fair, so let's fight honorably, head-on.
m920083.準決勝。勝者、王子チーム！\n試合中のヤジにも負けずよく頑張ったねぇ……。\nま:
Semifinals. Winners, Prince's team!
You held your own despite the heckling…
Well, just chalk it up as one of those things.
m920083.王子、これなら勝ち目はありそうですね！\n絶対にこの大会、優勝しましょう！！: Prince, this gives us a real chance! Let's win this tournament, no matter what!!
m920083.王子、すぐに戦いの準備をお願いします！: Prince, please prepare for battle right away!
m920083.王子、すごいです！\n難なく一回戦を突破できましたね！:
Prince, that was amazing!
We breezed through the first round!
m920083.王子、どうやらこのままいくと決勝では、\n本気のドゥーラさんと戦う事になりそうで: Prince, if we keep going like this, we'll end up facing the real Doula in the finals.
m920083.王子、何が起きるか判りません。\nくれぐれも気をつけて下さい！:
Prince, we don't know what might happen.
Please be extra careful!
m920083.王子、先ほどのデーモンの口振りから察するに、\nまだまだ大会には何か罠が潜んでる: Prince, judging from that demon's words earlier, there may still be traps hidden in the tournament….
m920083.王子、報告にあったような凶悪な魔物は\nどうやらこの場所にはいなかったようですね: Prince, it seems the vicious monster mentioned in the report isn't here after all.
m920083.生憎だが、王子たちを殺させるわけにはいかない！\n我輩に勝った者が準決勝を不戦敗: Unfortunately, I can't let the princes be killed! If those who beat me get a walk-over in the semifinals, that would tarnish my reputation!
m920083.瘴気のせいで居心地がいいとは言えませんが……\n雨風が凌げるだけ、良しと思うべき: The miasma makes it far from comfortable, but at least it shields us from rain and wind… we should be grateful for that.
m920083.盛り上がってくれてよかったよ。あぁそれと観客の諸君、\n先の試合で客席との壁が壊: Glad you're all pumped up. Oh, and audience members, the wall between the arena and the seats broke in the last match, so don't get too close in your excitement... huh?
m920083.覇気は未だ衰えず、か。\nうちのチームも負けてられないな。: Your aura still hasn't faded, huh? Our team can't afford to lose either.
m920083.言葉は不要だ……。\n今は只、その武を以て己を語れッ！！\nさあ剣を取るんだ、王: Words aren't needed… Now, let your sword speak for you! Come on, draw your blade, Prince! Face me!
m920083.試合中は凄まじい気迫なれど、\nまだまだ余裕がありそうな感じでしたね。: He was fierce during the match, but he still seemed to have plenty of room left.
m920083.貴方は……グレーターデーモン！？\nそれに他にも多くのデーモンたちが……！\nそ: You… Greater Demon!? And all these other demons…! This… what does this mean?!
m920083.面白い事ですか？ そうですねぇ……\n……そうだ！ 人間が近づいて来た時に\n魔:
Something entertaining? Hmm…
…I've got it! When the humans get close,
we could attack them with magic, how about that?
m920083.魔界の宿泊施設……ですか。\n何だか少し怖いですね。: A demonic lodging…? That's a little unsettling.
m920083.魔界の瘴気の影響を受けないデシウスが\n加勢してくれるなら、活路が開けるかもしれ: If Decius, who isn't affected by the demonic miasma, lends us his aid, we might have a chance! Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920083.魔界武術大会というのは、\nこの世で一番強いヤツを決める大会のことさ。\n: The Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament is a competition to decide the strongest being in this world.
m920083.（あれ？ でも待って下さい。さっきので80％\nという事は、ほぼ全力というわけで: (Wait… but earlier he said 80 %, which is practically his full strength…)

m920119.――くっ、何故私が心配されているんだ。\nともかく、カミラの身柄は預かった。\n:
――Ugh, why am I being worried about?
Anyway, I've taken Camilla into custody.
Elite of the kingdom, prove your strength and take her back!!
m920119.――ようやくここまで来たようね。: ――At last, we've finally made it here.
m920119.――オレが相手をするゼ。\n魔王軍にはぶっ飛ばしテやりてェ奴がいる。\nだからモ:
—I'll be the opponent. 
There's a guy in the Demon King's army I want to blast. 
So we've got to train even more.
m920119.――リュリュ、あちらへ行かなくていいの？\nここにいても寒いだけでしょう。:
—Ryuryu, don't you need to go over there? 
Staying here just makes you colder.
m920119.――人からお礼を言われるの、悪くない気分ね。\nさて、王子達も来たみたいだし、\:
—Being thanked by someone feels good.
Now that the Prince and his party have arrived,
we should show them what we're capable of.
m920119.――何だか敵役の方々、\nくつろいでいる気がしますわ。: —Somehow the enemy side seems… quite relaxed.
m920119.――何だか皆の視線が\n生暖かい気がするが、まぁいい。\nともかく我が軍勢に恐れ:
――It feels like everyone's gaze is
warm on me, but fine.

m920119.（はい？ ……ふむ、なるほど。\nそれなら普段とは違う訓練が出来ますし、\n気晴: (Huh? …I see. If we do something different from usual, it could be a nice change of pace…)
m920119.（んっふっふ。今回の趣向の為、\n特別にクリスマストレントも準備したのじゃ。\n:
(Heh heh. For this event,
I've specially prepared a Christmas trent.
I won't go down easily.)
m920119.（クリスマスパーティのお誘いに来たのですが……。\n皆さん、このままでは魔王軍と: (I came for the Christmas party… but at this rate we'll all break our bodies from over-training before we even clash with the Demon Lord's forces…)
m920119.（訓練の成果を見るために、\n奇襲をかけてほしいとお願いしただけなのですが……）:
(I only asked for a surprise attack
so I could see the results of the training…)
m920119.（随分と気合が入っているようね。\nふふ、こちらも雪だるまの準備は完璧よ）:
(You seem really fired up.
Hehe, our snow-man preparations are perfect too.)

m920150.――あっ、行っちゃった。\n僕はもう少しだけ、満月を眺めてから帰ろうかな。:
――Ah, they're already gone.
I think I'll stay a little longer
and enjoy the full moon before heading back.
m920150.――さ、砂漠に、カボチャの木が……。: ――So, a pumpkin tree in the desert…
m920150.――そこまで！\n本日の模擬戦は終了です！:
――That's enough!
Today's sparring match is over!
m920150.――って、なんだ王子たちか。\nもしかしてわたしの働きっぷりを見にきたのか？:
――Oh, it's the Prince and the others.
Did you come to see how hard I'm working?
m920150.――ふふふ、これでエルフどもに\nようやく引導を渡すことができる。:
――Heh heh heh. With this,
I can finally deliver the elves
to their doom.
m920150.――やれやれ。\n召喚術に詳しくないヤツが、\nおだてられて良い気になってるみた:
――Tsk.
Someone who doesn't know much about summoning
seems to be feeling pretty good
about being flattered, doesn't he, Prince?
m920150.――カボ……我が眠りを覚ますのは……何者カボ。: ――Kabo…… Who dares…… wake me from my slumber, Kabo.
m920150.――カボ。ダークエルフ様に従いますカボ。: ――Kaboo. We obey the Dark Elf, Kaboo.
m920150.――カボカボカボ。\nデーモンシェフ、よく働いてくれたカボ。:
--Pum-pum-pum.
Demon Chef, you worked well, Pum.
m920150.――カボチャの木、ですよね。\nリヴル様ちゃん、このお店の\nオーナーさんってど:
――the pumpkin tree, isn't it?
Livre-sama-chan, what kind of person is the owner of this shop?
m920150.――クックック、貴様ら、\nハロウィンの準備は万端か？\nよもやカボチャの準備を:
――Kukuku, you guys,
are you all ready for Halloween?
You wouldn't have forgotten to stock up on pumpkins, would you?
m920150.――ハロウィンパーティに、魔物が紛れてるだって？: ――So there are monsters mixed in at the Halloween party?
m920150.――パンプキンキングたるボク自身を生贄に捧げ、\nカボチャの神、パンプキンデウス:
――I shall offer my own self, the Pumpkin King, as a sacrifice,
and summon the Pumpkin God, Pumpkin Deus, Kaboo!!
m920150.――凶鳥に異変が起きた、だと？: You're saying something has happened to the Omen Bird?
m920150.――王子！ ここにいたのか！\n大変だ、妖精郷にカボチャの魔物が……！:
Prince! You're here!
It's urgent, the Pumpkin Monsters are in the Fairy Village!
m920150.――聞いて驚け王子！\nこのリヴル様が、あるばいとを成し遂げたぞ！:
――Listen to this, Prince!
This Livre has accomplished her part-time job!
m920150.――聞け！ 王国市民よ！\nこれより王国軍による、\nハロウィン模擬戦パーティを:
――Listen up! Citizens of the kingdom!
The Royal Army will now be hosting
a Halloween mock-battle party!
m920150.――遠吠えが聞こえる。\nエデン、連中がすぐ近くまで来てるみたいだよ。:
――I can hear them howling.
Eden, it looks like they're right on top of us.
m920150.……いや、まだ一箇所、\n栽培実験に使った場所が残っている。\nそこには最も大規:
...No, there is one place left where I was conducting cultivation experiments.
That's where my largest pumpkin tree farm is located.
m920150.……うん。\nでもきっと、きっとそんな日は来ないよ。\n僕は夜に生きる存在に詳し:
……Yeah.
But surely, surely that day will never come.
I know a lot about creatures of the night, you see. I can tell.
m920150.……うん。そうだよね。\n人を襲う魔物は退治しなくちゃ。:
……Yeah. That's right.
We have to hunt down monsters that attack people.
m920150.……か、解説してくれた、みたいですね？: ……I, I think he just gave us a briefing?
m920150.……そっか。\nじゃあ、もう少しだけここにいよう。:
……I see.
Then let's stay here a little longer.
m920150.……もしかして、よわよわ王子が知らないところで\n勢力を伸ばすつもりだったのかな:
...Could it be that the weakling Prince was planning to expand his influence
without anyone noticing?
m920150.……ん？ あれ？\nエデンは皆と行かなくていいの？\n待ってる人がいるんじゃない:
……Hm? Wait.
Doesn't Eden need to go with them?
Isn't there someone waiting for him?
m920150.……エデン？ あっ……ご、ごめん、\nエデンのことを言ったわけじゃないんだ。:
……Eden? Ah… s-sorry,
I wasn't talking about you.
m920150.……カボ……我が……敗れるとはカボ……。: ……Kabo…… To think…… I would be defeated, Kabo…….
m920150.……ラテリアちゃん。うん、ありがとね！\nよぉし、早く王子の本隊を呼びにいこ！:
……Lateria-chan. Yeah, thank you!
Alright, let's hurry and go call the Prince's main force!
m920150.……王子、どうやら今回も、\n彼らが騒動の原因のようです。\n事情を問い詰める必:
……Prince, it seems they are the cause of this disturbance as well.
We need to press them for an explanation.
m920150.あぁっ！ そうだった！\nハロウィンの準備、\n全部任せてきちゃったんだった！:
Oh! Right!
I left all the Halloween preparations
up to everyone else!
m920150.あぁ！ デーモンシェフ見つけたよ！\nこらー！ カボチャの魔物なんて売っちゃだめ:
Ah! I found the Demon Chef!
Hey! You can't sell Pumpkin Monsters like that!
m920150.あくまで噂だがな……。\n王国軍の者に化けて、\nパーティに侵入したらしい、と。:
It's just a rumor, but…….
They're said to have disguised themselves as members of the Royal Army
and infiltrated the party.
m920150.あっ、あれはただのサボテンじゃないです！\nサボテンの魔物ですよー！！:
Ah, that's not just a cactus!
It's a Cactus Monster!!
m920150.あっ、こら待て！ どこへ行く！\nリヴル様にイタズラされろー！！:
Ah, wait! Where do you think you're going?
Let Livre get her trick on you!!
--- scene: Pumpkin Busters! (battle, start) ---
m920150.あっ、そうそう！\nおしゃれで素敵なデーモンシェフって名乗ってたな。:
Oh, yes, that's it!
They introduced themselves as the stylish and wonderful Demon Chef.
m920150.あっ、オーナーだったか……。\nびっくりしちゃったぞ。:
Oh, it's the owner…….
You scared me.
m920150.あっ、カボチャの魔物たちが消えていきます……。\n後を追うのは難しそうですね……:
Ah, the Pumpkin Monsters are disappearing…….
It looks like it'll be hard to track them down…….
m920150.あっ、待ってリヴル様ちゃん！！\n不用意に近づくと危ないですよ！！:
Ah, wait, Livre-sama-chan!!
It's dangerous to get too close carelessly!!
m920150.あやつは他のカボチャから力を吸い上げているらしい。\n貴君、まずは周囲のカボチャ:
Apparently, he's draining the power from the other pumpkins.
Your Highness, the best course of action would be to
take out the surrounding Pumpkin Monsters first.
--- scene: Pumpkin Busters! (battle, end) ---
m920150.あるばいとにハロウィンの準備に大忙しなんだ。\n王子！ 王子も急がないと\nハロ:
I've been swamped with Halloween prep for my part-time job.
Prince! You need to hurry up,
or you'll miss the party!
m920150.い、いたずら！？\nそんな事したら怒られちゃうだろ！？:
T-Trick or treat?!
If they actually played a prank, they'd get in trouble, wouldn't they?!
m920150.いいかデーモンシェフ、\n物質界のカボチャは動かないんだよ！！\nむしろ街の皆は:
Listen, Demon Chef,
pumpkins in the material world don't move!!
The townspeople were actually scared of them!
m920150.いや待てアリサ、ハロウィンって確か\n季節の節目のお祭りで、\n死者が帰ってくる:
Hold on, Alissa. I thought Halloween was
a seasonal festival where the dead return, wasn't it……?
m920150.うぅん、なんでもなーい♪\n一緒にパンプキンパイ食べよ♪:
Nuh-uh, I'm good~♪
Let's eat the pumpkin pie together~♪
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m920150.うぅん、平気平気！\n私はヴァンパイアだけど、人を襲ったりしないよ？:
N-no, it's okay!
I'm a vampire, but I don't attack people?
m920150.うぅん、私ももうちょっとだけ。\n倒しちゃった狼さんたちの代わりに、\n満月を眺:
No, I want to stay a bit longer too.
In place of the wolves we put down,
I thought I'd enjoy the full moon.
m920150.うっ……何だよ、悪いかよ。\nどうせわたしは友だちが――って、\nわたしをリヴル:
Ugh…… What's it to you? It's not like I'm being weird.
I mean, I don't have any friends―― wait,
why are you calling me "Livre-sama-chan"?
m920150.うむ、そのとおりだ。\nだがここは王国、打つ手はある。:
Indeed, that is the case.
But this is the kingdom, and we have a plan.
m920150.えぇ、ハロウィンの祝祭です！\nもうそろそろ準備をしないとなーって、\n軍の女の:
Yes, it's the Halloween festival!
I was just talking with the other girls in the army about
how we need to start getting ready soon.
m920150.えぇ。力が増幅しすぎちゃったみたい。\nほら、ハロウィンには死者が帰ってくるでし:
Yes. Its power seems to have amplified too much.
You know, on Halloween, the dead are said to return, right?
m920150.えぇぇ、でも皆で仮装してるから、\n確認しようがないと思うなぁ。:
Ehh? But everyone's in costume,
so I don't see how we can check.
m920150.えぇっと……コック帽をかぶってて、\n目付きが鋭くて……。:
Well… they wore a chef's hat,
and had a sharp gaze…
m920150.えぇっ！？ お祭りの夜まで戦いたくないよぉ。\nそれに王子の許可はとったの？:
Wha-!? I don't want to fight on a festival night.
And did you even get the Prince's permission?
m920150.えっ、えっと、リヴル様ちゃん！？\n手を引かなくても走れますからー！:
E-eh, Livre-chan!?
I can run just fine without you pulling my hand!
m920150.お、おい！ 気になるじゃないか！\n――はぁ、仕方ない。\nこうなったらすぐに模:
Hey, wait! I'm curious!
――Sigh, fine.
Then I'll just end this sparring match quickly!
m920150.おいソーマ、顔に出てるぞ。\nわたしだって皆とハロウィンがしたいんだからな！:
Hey, Soma, it's written all over your face.
I want to celebrate Halloween with everyone too, you know!
m920150.おぉ、我が信徒たるカボチャの魔物よ……。\nうぬらの願いに応えようカボ……。:
Oh, my faithful Pumpkin Monsters…….
I shall answer your prayers, Kabo…….
m920150.おぉ、気が利くではないか！\nさっそく皆を呼んでくるとしよう。:
Oh, how thoughtful of you!
I'll go call everyone over right away.
m920150.おかげでボクらが取り憑くカボチャが、\nいーっぱい量産できたカボ！: Thanks to you, we were able to mass-produce a ton of pumpkins for us to possess, Pum!
m920150.おっと……ところで王子、\nいまお菓子を持ってたりするか？:
Oh, right…… By the way, Prince,
do you have any candy with you?
m920150.おっと『満月』が出ている間は特に気をつけてね。\n連中がさらに凶暴になるはずだか:
Oh, be extra careful while the "full moon" is out.
They're bound to become even more violent.
m920150.お祭りの準備にも、復興支援にもぴったり。\nさすがはリヴル様ちゃん、\n素敵なお:
It's perfect for both festival preparations and recovery support.
As expected of Livre-sama-chan,
you've chosen a wonderful place to work!
m920150.くっ……だが、カボチャの魔物はまだまだいるぞ！\nおいパンプキンキング！\n王国:
Tsk…… But we still have plenty of Pumpkin Monsters left!
Hey, Pumpkin King!
Crush the Kingdom's army
with sheer numbers!
m920150.ぐぬぬぬぬ……！\nまた商売失敗ということなのか……！？:
Grrrrr...!
Does this mean my business has failed again...?!
m920150.ぐわぁぁぁぁッ！？\nやめっ、やめろぉぉぉぉっ！！:
Gwaaaaah!?
S-Stop! Stop it, you idiot!!
m920150.こ、こら！ 頬を引っ張るな！！\nデーモンシェフだ！ 仮装ではない！！:
H-hold on! Stop pulling my cheeks!!
It's the Demon Chef! Not a costume!!
m920150.こっちはハロウィンを守るっていう、\n重要な使命があるんだぞ？\nカボチャごとき:
We have an important mission:
protecting Halloween.
There's no way we'd lose
to something as trivial as pumpkins.
m920150.このままじゃハロウィンどころじゃない。\nお祭りが台無しになっちゃうじゃないか！:
At this rate, it won't be Halloween at all.
The festival will be ruined!
m920150.この前魔導書を買ったせいで、\nお財布の中身もすっからかんで……ん、何？:
I blew my entire savings on that grimoire the other day,
so my wallet is completely empty…… Huh? What's that?
m920150.これでカボチャの魔物は全部倒したな。\nでも、どう見たってこの原因は――:
That takes care of all the pumpkin monsters.
But even so, the cause of this is clearly――
m920150.これでハロウィンの夜に、\nちびたちにお菓子を配ってやれるな。:
Now we can hand out treats to the little ones
on Halloween night.
m920150.こんな市街地に魔物が現れるなんて……。\n王子、急ぎカボチャの魔物を討伐しましょ:
A monster appearing in the middle of the city...
Prince, we must defeat the Pumpkin Monster at once!
m920150.ご、ごめんなさいー！\nリヴル様ちゃん、ハロウィンの祝祭のことは、\nこの模擬戦:
S-Sorry!
Livre-sama-chan, I'll tell you all about the Halloween festival
once this sparring match is over!
m920150.さぁ、残すは王国軍だけカボ。\n愉快なカボチャのパーティで、\n王国軍をパンプキ:
Now, only the Kingdom's army remains, Kabo.
In a fun pumpkin party,
I'll turn the Kingdom's army into pumpkin pie, Kabo☆
--- scene: Pumpkin Busters! ---
m920150.さぁ力をあわせて戦えカボチャの魔物！\nボクらのために働けダークエルフ！\n「パ:
Now, fight together, Pumpkin Monsters!
Work for us, Dark Elf!
Buy us time to summon “Pumpkin Deus,” Kabo!!
m920150.さぁ王子、早く洞窟を出ましょ。\n帰ったら楽しいハロウィンの祝祭が待ってるわ♪:
Come on, Prince, let's get out of this cave.
A fun Halloween festival is waiting for us when we get home♪
--- scene: Moonlit Beast Hunt (battle, start) ---
m920150.さすが王子だ！\nもちろんリヴル様にかかれば、\nどんな仕事だって楽勝だからなぁ:
Just as I'd expect from a Prince!
If Livre-sama is doing it,
any job will be a piece of cake, heh♪
m920150.さらに！\nパンプキンデウス様は戦場のほぼ全域に、\n強力な攻撃をすることができ:
What's more!
Pumpkin Deus can unleash powerful attacks
across nearly the entire battlefield, Kabo!
m920150.しかし、ようやくこの森で\nカボチャの木の量産に成功したというのに……。:
But I finally succeeded in mass-producing
pumpkin trees in this forest...
m920150.そ、それでソーマ、アリサ、\nハロウィンの祝祭ってどんな祭りなんだ？:
S-So, Soma, Alissa,
what exactly is the Halloween festival like?
m920150.そういうわけだから王子、指揮をお願いね。\nさぁ、アンデッドたちがこっちに来るわ:
That's the situation, Prince. Please take command.
Come on, the Undead are heading our way!
m920150.そうか、まだ職業についてない連中が、\n街の店を手伝ってお金をもらうっていうアレ:
I see, so people without a profession help out at the shops in town
in exchange for money, right?
m920150.そうしよう。\n雲が晴れて月灯りも強くなってきたしね。:
Let's do that.
The clouds are clearing and the moonlight is getting stronger.
m920150.そうでした！\n討伐も終わりましたし、\n急いで街の皆を手伝いにいかないと！:
I forgot!
Now that the hunt is over,
we have to hurry and help everyone in the village!
m920150.そうですよね！\nよぉし、急いでデーモンシェフの後を追いましょう！:
That's right!
Alright, let's hurry and catch up to the Demon Chef!
m920150.そこで我がデモシェフ商会が仕入れた、\nどこでもすぐにカボチャが取れる、\nオシ:
This is where our Demo Chef Trading Company comes in!
We've imported these stylish, wonderful pumpkin trees
that bear pumpkins anywhere, instantly!!
m920150.そっか、お菓子をプレゼントするお祭りかぁ……。\nお菓子……お菓子は好きだけど、:
I see, so it's a festival where you give out sweets...
I do love sweets, but...
I'm a proper grown-up now, so...
m920150.そっか、リヴル様ちゃんの\n初めてのハロウィンなら、\n今年はめいっぱい気合をい:
Oh, right. Since it's Livre-sama-chan's
first Halloween, we really need to go all out this year♪
m920150.その上オバケカボチャをいっぱい食べてくれたから、\nデーモンシェフの部下も\n既: On top of that, they ate a whole bunch of ghost pumpkins, so Demon Chef's underlings have already become our minions, Pum~♪
m920150.それからみんな仮装してるだけだからね！\n見た目は魔物そっくりだけど、\n本物ほ:
And remember, everyone is just in costume!
They look exactly like monsters,
but they're not as strong as the real thing, so don't overdo it!
--- scene: Livre and the Costume Contest (battle, end) ---
m920150.それから最後に、\n魔物に滅ぼされた村の人たちのために、\nお墓参りをしてあげて:
And finally,
we would like you to visit the graves
of the villagers who were destroyed by the monsters.
m920150.それから角が生えてて、牙があって、\n背中に羽が生えてるデーモンだったぞ？: And they had horns, fangs, and wings on their back. A demon, that is!
m920150.それだけなら見過ごしても良かったんだけどね。\n彼らにも彼らの習性というものがあ:
If it were just that, we could have let it slide.
But they have their own instincts to follow.
m920150.それでは、近くの村のお墓参りに行きましょうか。: Then, let's head to the village nearby to pay our respects at the graves.
m920150.それでは我々は新商品開発に戻るぞ！\nさらばだ、王国の者たちよ！！:
Well then, we're heading back to developing our new products!
Farewell, people of the kingdom!!
m920150.それどころか……くっくっく……。\nあのパンプキンキングすら、\n我らダークエル:
More than that…… heh heh heh……
Even that Pumpkin King
bows to us Dark Elves!
m920150.それより、カボチャの木はこれで全部なのか？: Besides, is that all the pumpkin trees?
m920150.だからこそ、まずはボクらの神さまを召喚して、\n万全の状態を整えてから\nビフロ:
That's why, first, we'll summon our god,
get everything in perfect order,
and then welcome Lord Bifrons, Kabo☆
m920150.だからわたしをリヴル様ちゃんと――あれ？\nリヴルちゃんなら良いんじゃないか……:
I told you to call me Livre-sama, not――Wait?
Livre-chan is fine, I guess……?
m920150.だからリヴル様ちゃんと呼ぶな――って、\nんん、あのカボチャ、いま動かなかったか:
I told you not to call me Livre-sama-chan――
Huh? Did that pumpkin just move?
m920150.でも、この先の村に向かうようなら、\n討伐するしかないだろうね。:
Still, if they're heading toward the village ahead,
we'll have no choice but to take them down.
m920150.ところがデーモンシェフにカボチャの木を\n仕入れられて、ざこざこ王子にバレてしま:
But then the Demon Chef bought up all the pumpkin trees,
and the clumsy Prince found out about it...
m920150.とはいえ、このまま放置してたら結果は同じだ。\n楽しいハロウィンのために、\nデ:
Still, if we'd just left it alone, the result would have been the same.
For the sake of a fun Halloween,
we have to stop the Demon Chef's business!
m920150.どうしたじゃない！\nハロウィンに備えていっぱいお菓子を用意したいのに、\nお菓:
What do you mean, "what's wrong"?
I want to stock up on all sorts of sweets for Halloween,
but I don't have a single coin to buy them……!!
m920150.どうしたメメント？\nパンプキンパイ、食べないのか？:
What's wrong, Memento?
Aren't you going to eat some pumpkin pie?
m920150.な、なにを！？\n我が召喚術は完璧だぞ！\n見よ、パンプキンキングすら我が命に従:
W-What are you talking about!?
My summoning arts are perfect!
Look, even the Pumpkin King
obeys my commands!
m920150.な、何！？\nよく動く活きの良いカボチャだぞ！\n台無しどころか喜ばれるのではな:
W-What?!
They're lively, active pumpkins!
Instead of ruining things, shouldn't people be delighted?!
m920150.なっ……カボチャの木から\nカボチャの魔物が出てきたぞ……！？:
W-What...?
A Pumpkin Monster has emerged from the pumpkin tree...!?
m920150.なっ……ダークエルフの精鋭と、\nカボチャの魔物が蹴散らされた、だと……！？:
Wha…… The Dark Elf's elite
and the Pumpkin Monsters
were routed……!?
m920150.なっ……何だこの魔力。\n王子、気をつけろ、パンプキンキングを中心に、\nこれま:
Wha…… What is this magic?
Prince, be careful!
An unprecedented surge of power is swirling around the Pumpkin King!
m920150.なっ……我社の従業員を……！？\nおのれっ、おのれカボチャの魔物めー！！:
You... you turned my company's employees...!?
You wretched Pumpkin Monster!!
m920150.なに……！？\nま、まさか従っているフリをしていただけなのか！？:
Wha……!?
D-Did you just pretend to be loyal all this time!?
m920150.なるほどね。\nつまり私たちの専門分野ばかりってこと。:
I see.
So it's all within our area of expertise.
m920150.はい、雑談はそこまでです。\n模擬戦の最中だということを忘れないでくださいね？:
Yes, let's stop the small talk.
Please don't forget we're in the middle of a sparring match.
m920150.ふぅ、これで暴れているワーウルフは討伐できたかな。: Phew, I hope we've taken care of all the rampaging werewolves.
m920150.ふっふっふ、ちょっと楽しそうだぞ。\nハロウィンがこんなに楽しみなのは初めてだ！:
Heh heh heh, that actually sounds kind of fun.
This is the first time I've ever been this excited about Halloween!
Soma, Alissa, just you wait and see!
--- scene: Happy Pumpkin Day (battle, start) ---
m920150.ふふっ、それでは急いで王国に戻りましょうか。\n此度の遠征、お疲れさまでした！:
Heh, then let's head back to the kingdom right away.
Well done on this expedition!
--- scene: Livre and the Costume Contest (battle, start) ---
m920150.ふふふ、ところがハロウィンの夜には、\n大人は喜んで子どもたちに\nお菓子を配っ:
Hehe, but on Halloween night,
the grown-ups are happy to hand out
treats to the children.
m920150.ふふふ、わたしのお菓子は後であげるけど、\nまずは王子にイタズラからだな！:
Hehehe, I'll give you my candy later,
but first, it's time for a little trick!
m920150.ふふふ、今回は随分と\n物質界の商売を学ばせてもらった。\nこれで次こそは、大ヒ:
Heh heh. This time, I learned quite a bit about doing business in the Material Plane.
With this, I'm sure I can produce a real hit next time.
m920150.ふふふ、効果を説明してやるカボ。\nパンプキンデウス様はその特殊能力により、\n:
Hehehe, let me explain the effects, Kabo.
Pumpkin Deus can use his special ability
to gather the power of other pumpkins and make it his own, Kabo!
m920150.へぇ……持ってないのか。\nふぅん。それなら――:
Heh…… You don't, do you.
I see. Well then――
m920150.まぁいいさ！\nそうと決まれば、\nリヴル様の実力をみせてやろうじゃないか！:
Well, whatever!
Since it's decided,
Livre-sama will show you her true strength!
m920150.まさか砂漠でカボチャが育つなんて、\nちょっと想像もしてなかったですね……。: I never imagined pumpkins could grow in the desert…
m920150.また……また事業失敗か……。\n活きの良さばかりを求めてはいけないのだな……。:
Another... another business failure...
I shouldn't have focused so much on making them lively...
m920150.むっ、元従業員のエスネアではないか。\nそれにアルバイトのリヴルまで。\nいった:
Hmph, isn't that Ethnea, my former employee?
And Livre, the part-timer, too.
What is the meaning of this?
m920150.もうひとつは、零れてしまった凶鳥の力、\n形をとってしまった分身を討伐すること。:
The second is to defeat the manifestations of the Omen Bird's power
that have taken physical form after leaking out.
m920150.もしかしてそれ、デーモンシェフじゃない？: Could that be the Demon Chef?
m920150.もし私が人の心を失ってしまったら、\nちゃんと退治してくれるって、\n約束してく:
Besides, some people promised
they'd hunt me down properly
if I ever lost my sense of humanity♪
m920150.もー、早めに終わらせてね？\nまだまだお菓子もらい足りないんだから！:
Hey, wrap it up quickly, okay?
I still haven't collected enough candy!
m920150.やれやれ……。\nわたしも物好きだと思ってたけど、\n王子はそれ以上の物好きだよ:
Sigh…….
I thought I was the reckless one,
but the Prince is even more so.
m920150.やれやれ。\n先日のお詫びと礼に、パンプキンパイを焼いてきたのだ。\n王国軍の皆:
Well, well.
As an apology and thanks for the other day, I baked some pumpkin pie.
I was thinking of bringing it to the Royal Army.
m920150.よぉし、さっそくアルバイト探しに出発だ！\nみんなと仲良くなってやろう作戦第四弾:
Alright, let's set off to find that part-time job right away!
Operation: Befriending Everyone, Phase Four, commence!
m920150.わぁ！？ 誰だ！？\n誰の変装だー！？:
Whoa!? Who's there!?
Who's in that costume――!?
m920150.わかったよー！\nさぁ、村を守るためにがんばろー！:
Got it!
Come on, let's do our best to protect the village!
--- scene: Moonlit Beast Hunt (battle, end) ---
m920150.わんわんわおーん。\nこんなにも月光が綺麗だから、\nワーウルフたちも興奮しちゃ:
Woof woof wooo.
The moonlight is so beautiful,
maybe that's why the werewolves are so excited?
m920150.んっ？ な、何だあのサボテン！？\n動いてるように見えるぞ！！:
Hm? W-What is that cactus!?
It looks like it's moving!!
m920150.アリサやソーマがイタズラしに来たら、\n美味しいお菓子をあげなきゃいけないのか…:
If Alissa and Soma came to my door playing pranks,
would I have to give them some really good treats...?
m920150.オーナーいわく、これで食糧難を解決できるって、\nすごい嬉しそうに語ってたなぁ。:
The owner said this could solve the food shortage.
He was talking about it with such a bright face.
m920150.カボ……召喚直後でまだ酔っていたに違いないカボ……。\n王国軍は卑怯カボ！！:
Kabo…… He must have still been drunk on the summoning…….
The Royal Army is so sneaky, Kabo!!
m920150.カボ……完璧な作戦だったはずカボ……。\n王国以外で……大繁殖するはずが……ぱた:
Pum... this was supposed to be a perfect plan, Pum...
Outside the kingdom... it was supposed to spread wildly... *clatter*.
m920150.カボカボー？ 誰になめた口を利いているのカボ？\nお願いしますパンプキンキング様:
Kabokabo? Who do you think you're talking to, Kabo?
Please, Your Majesty the Pumpkin King, Kabo☆
m920150.カボチャの木のふりをして、\nリヴル様を騙そうなんて詰めの甘いカボチャだ！:
Trying to deceive Livre-sama by pretending to be a pumpkin tree?
What a sloppy move for a pumpkin!
m920150.カボチャの王として当然のマナーカボ。\nさぁ、偉大なるパンプキンデウス様の降臨カ:
It's just proper etiquette for the King of Pumpkins, Kabo.
Now then, the descent of the great Pumpkin Deus, Kabo!
m920150.カボチャの神……と名乗っているようだが、\nどうにも神性は感じられないな……。\:
He calls himself the God of Pumpkins……
but I don't detect a shred of divinity about him…….
He seems more like a false idol than a true god or demi-god.
m920150.カボー！ やったカボ！\nパンプキンデウス様の降臨カボー！！:
Kaboo! We did it, Kabo!
Pumpkin Deus has descended, Kaboo!!
m920150.カボ！ カボ！\nパンプキンデウス様をお招きするカボー！！:
Kabo! Kabo!
Let's invite Lord Pumpkin Deus, Kabo!!
m920150.ギクゥッ！？\nきょ、今日のところは引き分けにしてやるカボー！！:
Gikku!?
F-fine, I'll call today a draw, Kaboo!!
m920150.クヒュヒュヒュー！！\nまだ気付かないカボ？\nこの世界に迫る、カボチャのあの音:
Kuhikuhikuh!!
Still not noticing, Kabo?
The sound of pumpkins approaching this world!!
m920150.デーモンシェフの仕入れたカボチャの木に、\nカボチャの魔物が大量に取り憑いてたん:
The pumpkin trees the Demon Chef bought
were infested with tons of Pumpkin Monsters.
m920150.ハロウィンの準備を皆に任せて、\nこうして獣狩りに出ていた甲斐があったってものだ:
Leaving the Halloween preparations to everyone
and coming out on this beast hunt was well worth it.
m920150.ハロウィンをめちゃくちゃにしようとするヤツらは、\nまとめて王子とリヴル様で薙ぎ: We'll sweep away anyone who tries to ruin Halloween, you and I, Prince!
m920150.パンプキンキングひとりで何ができるって言うんだ？\nおとなしくパンプキンパイにな:
What can you possibly do alone, Pumpkin King?
If you just sit down and become pumpkin pie,
we won't have to――
m920150.ボクらはいつも、ちょっと急ぎ足だったカボ。\nビフロンス様の復活のためにと、\n:
We've always been a bit rushed, Kabo.
In our haste to revive Lord Bifrons,
we neglected our preliminary preparations, Kabo.
m920150.リヴル様ちゃん、\nもしかして王国のハロウィンは初めてですか？:
Livre-sama-chan,
are you perhaps experiencing the kingdom's Halloween for the first time?
m920150.リヴル様ちゃんが、\nアルバイトを始めたって聞いたので\n様子を見にきたんですよ:
We heard that Livre-sama-chan
started a part-time job,
so we came to check on you.
m920150.以前にも解説してくれましたし、\n良い方なんでしょうか……？:
He's done that before, too.
Is that supposed to be a good thing……?
m920150.何を落ち込んでるんだソーマ！\n事件の黒幕は倒したんだ、\nいそいで王国に戻るぞ:
What's with the gloom, Soma!
We've taken down the mastermind behind this whole mess.
Let's hurry back to the kingdom!
m920150.凶鳥からの依頼はみっつ。\nひとつはハロウィンに乗じて現れた、\nアンデッドたち:
The Omen Bird has three requests.
The first is to pacify the Undead that appeared on the occasion of Halloween.
m920150.凶鳥さんも大変ですねぇ……。\nそれで、私たちは何をすれば良いんですか？:
Poor Omen Bird...
So, what do we need to do?
m920150.凶鳥はあの辺り一帯の守護者だから、\n戻ってきた人たちの\n魂に影響されちゃった:
Since the Omen Bird is the guardian of that entire region,
it seems to have been affected by the souls
of those who came back.
m920150.卑怯も何もないだろ！\nそっちだってカボチャの木のフリをして\nハロウィンをめち:
Sneaky?! Don't push it!
You disguised yourselves as pumpkin trees
and wrecked Halloween!
m920150.地方によって色々と内容が違うのですが、\nたいていの場合は――:
It varies from region to region, but
in most cases――
m920150.妖精郷にカボチャの魔物が実る木があると聞き、\n一気にこの辺りを\n占領した甲斐:
I heard there was a tree in the Fairyland
that bore Pumpkin Monsters,
so it was well worth seizing
this entire area in one go……
m920150.妖精郷のフィールドが持つ魔力に、\nダークエルフから集めた魔界の魔力が揃った時―:
When the mana of the Fairy Land's field
combines with the mana of the Demon World gathered by the Dark Elf――
m920150.子どもたちがオバケの仮装をして、\n大人にこう言うんです。\nお菓子をくれなきゃ:
The kids dress up as ghosts and go door to door,
singing, "Trick or treat, treat or no treat~♪"
m920150.当たり前カボー☆\nクヒュヒュヒュ！\nダークエルフの魔力、いただいていくカボー:
Naturally, Kabo☆
Kuhikuhikuh!
Allow me to harvest your Dark Elf magic, Kabo!
m920150.怖がるならともかく、\nどうしてそんなに楽しそうなんだ？:
I'd understand if you were scared of it,
but why do you look so excited?
m920150.我らの召喚主はダークエルフ様たちカボ。\nどんなご命令でも聞きますカボ。:
Our summoners are the Dark Elves, Kaboo.
We will obey any command, Kaboo.
m920150.我らの配下には、\nこの大量のカボチャの魔物がいるのだからな！:
After all, we have
this massive horde of Pumpkin Monsters
at our disposal!
m920150.我らをバカにしたこと、後悔させてやるぞ！\n行け、カボチャの魔物！\nそしてパン:
I'll make you regret
underestimating us!
Go, Pumpkin Monsters!
And you, Pumpkin King!!
m920150.手早く討伐を終わらせて、\nお墓も綺麗にしてあげましょうね。:
Let's finish the culling quickly
and tidy up the graves, shall we?
m920150.打つ手……？\nいったい何をするつもり――:
A plan……?
What exactly do you intend to do――
m920150.最近発見されたばかりの新種らしいぞ？\nどこにでも植えられて、\nすぐにカボチャ:
Apparently, it's a newly discovered species.
It can be planted anywhere and
bears pumpkins right away.
m920150.木になるカボチャなんて珍しいですね。\n新種なのでしょうか？:
Pumpkins that grow on trees are quite rare, aren't they?
Is this a new variety?
m920150.気を落とすなよ、デーモンシェフ。\nこのリヴル様ですら、何度も失敗してきたんだ。:
Don't be so down, Demon Chef.
Even I, Livre, have failed many times.
You still have plenty of chances to try again.
m920150.気付かないままであれば、\nカボチャの魔物が信仰する、\nビフロンスが復活してし:
If we hadn't noticed,
Bifrons, the deity worshipped by the Pumpkin Monsters,
might have been revived.
m920150.無論だ。市民の安全が第一である以上、\nたとえ噂が嘘であっても\n確認を怠ること:
Of course. The safety of the citizens comes first.
Even if the rumor is false,
we cannot afford to neglect verification.
m920150.王国では大人や子供に限らず、\nお菓子をプレゼントしあったりしていますけどね。:
In the Kingdom, it's not just children, either.
People of all ages exchange sweets as gifts.
m920150.王子、さすがのリヴル様も\n何が出てくるか予想もつかない。\n慎重に指揮をするん:
Prince, even I can't predict what's going to come out of that.
You'd better command with extreme caution! Got it?
m920150.王子、わたしも戦うからな！\n楽しいハロウィンを邪魔するやつは、\nリヴル様の領:
Prince, I'm fighting too!
Anyone who tries to ruin a fun Halloween
is going to have their life force drained away in Livre-sama's domain!
m920150.王子、カボチャの魔物に、\nデーモンシェフの部下までこっちに来てるぞ。: Prince, the Pumpkin Monster has even turned Demon Chef's subordinates against us.
m920150.王子、カボチャもサボテンも\nまとめて料理するぞ！\nハロウィンの祝祭を守るんだ:
Prince, I'm going to cook the pumpkins and the cacti all together!
I have to protect the Halloween festival!
m920150.王子、トリックオアトリートだ！\nどうした、ほら、お菓子を出してみろ！:
Prince, trick or treat!
Well? Come on, hand over the candy!
m920150.王子、楽しいハロウィンのために、\nついでに妖精郷のために、\nこいつらをぶっ飛:
Prince, for the sake of a fun Halloween,
and incidentally for the Fairyland,
let's blow these guys away!
m920150.王子にも美味しいお菓子を用意してやるからな。\nついでにイタズラされる覚悟も決め:
I'll make sure to prepare some delicious sweets for you too, Prince.
Oh, and get ready to be pranked!
m920150.皆で楽しくイタズラしたり、\nお菓子をあげたりするお祭りを、\nカボチャの魔物に:
I won't let pumpkin monsters ruin a festival
where everyone can play pranks together
and share sweets!
m920150.砂漠でもすぐに育つカボチャを仕入れたと、\n民から聞いて、私もびっくりしたんです:
I heard from the locals that they had stocked up on pumpkins that grow quickly even in the desert, and I was quite surprised.
I had no idea the tree was possessed by a monster.
m920150.確かに、魔王との決戦で\n農地が汚染された地域もありますからね。:
That's true. The final battle with the Demon King
contaminated several agricultural areas.
m920150.街道を外れていたワーウルフも仕留めたわ。\n村にも被害は出ていないそうよ。:
We also put down the werewolves that had strayed from the road.
It seems there was no damage to the village.
m920150.近くから攻撃するとトゲを飛ばしてくるんです。\n王子様、攻撃する時はお気をつけて:
If you attack it up close, it'll shoot its thorns.
Prince, please be careful when you strike!
m920150.飴を買おうにもケーキの材料を買おうにも、\nお菓子にはお金が必要だったんだ……。:
Whether it's candy or cake ingredients,
sweets just don't grow on trees……
m920150.魔物は紛れてなかったみたいだな。\nまったく、人騒がせな噂をたてやがって。:
It seems there were no monsters mixed in after all.
What a fuss over nothing.
m920150.鳥の雛と召喚術を混同してないか？\nパンプキンキングが\nそんな簡単に従うはずな:
Aren't you confusing summoning arts
with taming a bird's hatchling?
There's no way the Pumpkin King
would submit so easily―― no, never mind.
m920150.（あのリヴル様ちゃんが、\nハロウィンのためにこんなに一生懸命に！）:
(That Livre-sama-chan is working so hard
just for Halloween!)
m920150.（あれ……？ もしかして、\n街に侵入した魔物ってデーモンシェフのことじゃ……？: (Wait...? Could it be that the monsters that invaded the town were actually the Demon Chef...?)
m920150.（えぇ、えぇ！\nカボチャの魔物が憑いていたのは想定外ですが、\n動き回るのは、:
(Yes, yes!
It was unexpected for the pumpkin monsters to be possessing them,
but the fact that they're moving about is proof of their freshness!)
m920150.（こんなに素敵な仲間ができたよって、\n魔物に殺された両親に報告しなくちゃ）:
(I need to tell my parents, who were killed by monsters,
that I've made such wonderful friends.)
m920150.（さぁ副デーモンシェフよ、\n次は砂漠の国に、恵みのカボチャを売りに行くぞ！）:
(Now then, Deputy Demon Chef,
next we'll head to the desert nation to sell our bountiful pumpkins!)
m920150.（はっ！ どこまでもお供します！）: (Yes sir! I will follow you anywhere!)
m920150.（ふふふ、実に活きの良いカボチャが手に入ったな！）: (Hehehe, I've gotten my hands on some wonderfully lively pumpkins!)
m920150.（ヒューナ、この近くということは、\nお前の故郷の村だろう。\n無理はしていない:
(Hyuna, if it's this close,
it must be the village where you grew up.
Are you sure you can handle this?)
m920150.（ヴィンセント、あなたがそれを言う？\n大丈夫よ、私には王子と皆がついてるから）:
(Vincent, you're the one asking?
It's fine. I have the Prince and everyone else with me.)
m920150.（物質界での商売のやり方を、\n少しずつ学んできた甲斐があったというものだ）:
(All the effort I put into learning how to do business in the material world
has truly paid off.)
m920150.（食料品は鮮度が大切、活きが良いものが喜ばれる！\nそしてどこでもすぐに育つ食物:
(Freshness is key for food; lively goods are the ones people love!
And food that grows quickly anywhere is a precious commodity!)

m920167.――いや待て。\n吾輩が神の楔で生み出されたのは確かじゃ。\nしかし、その権能は:
――No, wait.
It is true that I was created by the Divine Wedge.
However, my authority is limited solely to maintaining the World Tree.
m920167.――おっと、申し遅れた。\n私はマリレーヌ。\n代々ラタトスク様の騎士をしている:
――Ah, forgive me for not introducing myself.
I am Marylene.
I have served as Ratatouille's knight for generations.
m920167.――ここにッ！\nご無事ですか、ラタトスク様！:
――I'm right here!
Are you safe, Ratatoskr?
m920167.――しかし、その上で、\n世界樹奪還作戦はまだ生きている、と？:
――But even so,
the World Tree Recovery Operation is still viable?
m920167.――ぜぇ……はぁ……。\nどうにか、魔物化の速度は落とせたようじゃな……。:
――Pant…… pant……
It seems I've managed to slow the rate of bestialization……
m920167.――そうか、貴殿らは世界樹の魔物化を\n止めるために来てくれたのか。: ――I see, you have come to stop the demonization of the World Tree.
