m920167.（……おのれ、ラタトスクの騎士、王国軍、王子ィ……！）: (……Damn it, Ratatoskr's knight, the royal army, the Prince……!)
m920167.（世界樹に打ち込まれし神の楔よ……。\nさらなる力を……全てを蝕む毒を我が身に…:
(The divine wedge driven into the World Tree……
More power…… I'll fill my body with a poison that devours everything……!!)

m920192.……いや、実はそう簡単な話ではなくてね。\n君たち、魔界カカオの妖精を見なかった:
……No, actually, it's not quite that simple.
Have any of you seen the spirit of the demonic cacao?
m920192.……どうやらそうみたいだね。\nボクの何が駄目だったのかなぁ、\n参考までに聞か:
……It seems so, doesn't it?
What did I do wrong?
Could you tell me, just for my reference?
m920192.……グルメジャングルは、\nグルメジャングルは避けたのにぃ！: ……We avoided the Gourmet Jungle, we really did!
m920192.……フォラスさんの考えは理解しました。\nですが、私はあえてこう主張しましょう。:
……I understand your reasoning, Foras.
But I will say this:
m920192.……少し、遅かったようですね。: ……It seems we are a little too late.
m920192.……恋は、他人に強制されるものではありません。: ……Love isn't something that can be forced on someone else.
m920192.……望み、と言いましたね。\nこれがただの悪戯ではないのであれば、\nフォラスさ:
……You said "wish."
If this isn't just a prank,
Foras, what is your true goal?
m920192.……皆さん、きっかけが欲しかったんだと思います。: ……I think everyone was just looking for a reason.
m920192.……踏み出す一歩は自分の意思で、か。\nボクは悲恋がこの世の何より嫌いだけど。:
……The first step must be taken of my own will, is that it?
I hate tragic romances more than anything in this world, though.
m920192.……魔界カカオの妖精には、不特定多数に対して、\nとある感情を強制的に暴走させる:
……The demonic cacao spirit has the ability to forcibly
drive a specific emotion into a frenzy in an unspecified number of people.
m920192.……？ なんで止める必要があるっすか？: ……? Why would we need to stop them?
m920192.──あなたのそれは、お節介です！\nそんなの、誰も、頼んでいません！:
—What you're doing is meddling!
No one asked for your help!
m920192.──おぬしらも、わらわから王子を奪う気か？: ──Are you all trying to snatch the Prince from me as well?
m920192.──これはとても拙いねぇ、\n魔界カカオの妖精の痕跡だよ。:
──This is very troublesome.
These are the traces of the demonic cacao spirit.
m920192.──さぁ、王子様！ 皆さん！\n準備のほどは宜しいですか！:
—Now then, Your Highness! Everyone!
Are you all ready?
m920192.──はっ！？ 我々は一体何を……！？\n今年こそはキュートなガールからチョコを貰:
──Hah!? What on earth are we……!?
We were aiming to be cool and popular this year
so we could get chocolate from a cute girl, weren't we……?
m920192.──まあ聞け、吾輩に良い考えがある。:
—Hush, I have a rather good idea.
--- scene: Foras's Chocolate (battle, start) ---
m920192.──ようやく追い付きましたよ、妖精さん。: —I've finally caught up to you, fairy.
m920192.──グルメジャングルはやめましょう。: ──Let's skip the Gourmet Jungle this year.
m920192.──ッ、みなさんちょうど良いところに！\n彼女たちを抑えるのを手伝ってください！:
──Ah, you're just in time!
Please help me hold these women back!
m920192.──バレンタインは、壊すより守った方がモテる！: —Valentine's Day is better protected than destroyed!
m920192.──吾輩、おうち帰っても良いか？: —Is it okay if I just go home?
m920192.──誰か早くあやつを止めよーッ！\n世界樹ー！ もっと根性を見せぬかー！\nだか:
—Someone stop that thing, now!
World Tree! Show some backbone!
That's why you're turning into a monster!
m920192.──駄目ですね、周囲一帯が通行止めになっています。\nどうにも世界樹への道が全て:
—It's no use. The entire area is closed off.
It seems all the roads to the World Tree have been blocked.
m920192.あの冬に水着を着た青い髪の方は……？: What about the blue-haired one who wore a swimsuit in the winter……?
m920192.あはは……大変でしたね。: Ahaha…… it must have been quite a struggle.
m920192.あはは！ なんだいその顔！\nチョコレートを頬張り過ぎて、\nラタトスクみたいに:
Aha! What's with that face?
You've stuffed so much chocolate in your cheeks,
you look just like Ratatoskr!
m920192.あらゆるカカオを操る力と、\n他者の思考に干渉する力を持つ、\nひどく厄介ないた:
They possess the power to control all cacao,
as well as the ability to interfere with others' thoughts.
They are extremely troublesome tricksters.
m920192.いいとも、己の傲慢さは自覚しているつもりさ。\nボクの本気で、キミたちの相手をし:
Go right ahead. I'm well aware of my own arrogance.
I'll give you my all in this fight.
m920192.いつかろ過され消えることになろうとも、\n世界樹の飛ばす花粉に乗って各地を巡り、:
Even if I'm eventually filtered out and erased,
if I can ride the World Tree's pollen to every corner of the world
and change things for just a few days, my wish will come true.
m920192.いつかチョコをくれる相手に出会うまで、\n何人にもバレンタインをやらせはせんぞォ:
Until I meet the one who gives me chocolate,
I won't let anyone else celebrate Valentine's Day!
m920192.いやぁ、さすがに代理とはいえ一応国主だしねぇ、\n繁忙期に仕事を投げ出すほど私も:
Well, I am the head of state, even if only in proxy, so
I'm not irresponsible enough to just drop everything during a busy season.
m920192.うぉおおおお！ 有休こそ我がエル・ドラドー！: Woahhhh! Paid leave is my El Dorado!
m920192.うふふ……これはおかしな話ですわね？: Mmm…… isn't this an amusing situation?
m920192.うむ、フォラスもよく働いておるわ。\n賑わっておるようで喜ばしいのぉ。:
Mm, Foras has certainly worked hard.
I'm glad to see such a lively atmosphere.
m920192.え、えっと……三時にはおやつの時間を……。: Um, well…… snacks at three o'clock……
m920192.くぅ……っ！ たとえ我が身が倒れようとも、\n有給休暇を求める意志が途絶えること:
Grr……! Even if my body falls,
my will to demand paid leave shall never cease……!
m920192.ぐ、グレーターデーモン殿は悪くないのです！\n彼は私の頼みで魔界カカオを仕入れて: P-Please don't blame the Greater Demon! He only brought the demonic cacao because I asked him to. The failure in management is entirely our farm's responsibility!
m920192.こういうイベントで、盤面さえ整えてしまえば、\n普段は臆病な自分への言い訳にもな:
With an event like this setting the stage,
it's easier to make excuses for our usual timidity.
m920192.こっ、このままでは平穏なバレンタインが──: T-This is no way to have a peaceful Valentine's Day—
m920192.このプレゼント会はカジュアルな催しだ。\nまずは試しに、本番の予行演習にしたって:
This gift exchange is a casual affair.
Think of it as a dress rehearsal for the real thing.
Let's freely exchange chocolates with the ones we want to give them to.
m920192.これが魔界カカオの妖精の権能さ。\n他にも操られたカカオがいるだろう。:
That is the power of the demonic cacao spirit.
There are likely other cacao plants under its control as well.
m920192.こんなことしてる場合ではない。\nうぬら、早く世界樹に向かうぞ！:
There's no time for this.
Everyone, let's head to the World Tree!
m920192.さぁてと、待っていておくれよ。\n美しくも危うい、恋する乙女たち。:
???: Now then, I'll be right back.
Oh, you beautiful and dangerous maidens in love.
m920192.さあさあ、恋する少年少女たち！\nフォラス印のチョコレートはどうだい？\n想い人:
Now then, now then, you lovestruck boys and girls!
How about some Foras-brand chocolate?
It's guaranteed to delight the one you love!
m920192.さすがに致死量ギリギリじゃない？: But that's dangerously close to a lethal dose, isn't it?
m920192.すると次の瞬間にはアレっすね。\n世界に鬼刃姫様記念日を制定すべく、\n今日から:
And the very next moment, it was like this.
They say they're starting their activities today
to establish Oni Blade Princess Memorial Day in the world.
m920192.そういうのは二人きりのときに手作りを……と、\nそうお悩みのキミたちも遠慮するこ:
For those of you worried that you should only give
homemade chocolates in private…
Don't be shy!
There's no limit to how many times you can express your feelings.
m920192.そうでなければ、たとえ恋が叶ったとしても、\nきっと胸には、小さな棘が刺さったま:
Otherwise, even if your love is returned,
there will always be a small thorn
lodged in your heart.
m920192.その、指揮系統の関係で……。: It's just…… due to the chain of command……
m920192.その通り！ しかも今回はあくまでもカカオの実！\n鬼刃姫様に『めっ』される心配も:
Exactly! And this time, it's strictly cocoa beans!
No risk of the Oni Blade Princess saying "no" to us!
m920192.そもそもわらわに命令できる者がおらんかったわ。: Besides, there was no one who could command me in the first place.
m920192.それはできない相談だなぁ。\n悪いけどこれからキミの世界樹には、\nボクのお手伝:
That's not going to happen.
I'm sorry, but I'm going to need your help with your World Tree from now on.
m920192.それはもちろん、恋する乙女たちの応援さ。: Well, of course. It's cheering on the maidens in love.
m920192.ちなみに、鬼刃姫様はチョコの用意で遠出中っす。\nアレの先に行きたいなら自分で倒:
By the way, the Oni Blade Princess is out of town preparing chocolate.
If you want to get past that, you'll have to fight your way through.
m920192.ちなみに汚染率は現在５０％だよ。: By the way, the contamination rate is currently at 50%.
m920192.ちょっとよくわからないですね。: I'm not quite sure what's going on.
m920192.っ、少し待ってください。\n前方に誰かが倒れています。\nあれは……アヅミ、さん:
W-wait a moment.
Someone is lying down ahead.
Is that…… Azumi-san?
m920192.ですが、クオリティにこだわるあまり、\n王子に迷惑をかけてしまっては本末転倒。: But if we get too picky about quality and end up causing the Prince trouble, that would be missing the point entirely.
m920192.ですので今年は冒険することなく、\n懇意にしている近場のカカオ農園さんで、\n材: So, I was planning to avoid any adventures this year and source the ingredients from a nearby cacao farm we're on good terms with, but──
m920192.と、ととと、とにかく王子を救出しまーす！: A-anyway, let's just rescue the Prince!
m920192.とはいえ、これだけではないのであろう？\n思考への干渉、具体的にどういうことじゃ:
Still, that's not all, is it?
Interfering with thoughts…… what does that mean specifically?
m920192.ど、泥棒猫……旦那様が、危な……。: T-that thieving cat…… the master is in danger……
m920192.どうか、悔いのない選択を。: Please make a choice you won't regret.
m920192.どうしてこうなるんですかぁッ！？: Why does this always happen to me?!
m920192.なにはともあれ、そういうわけだ。\n妖精の悪戯も、度が過ぎれば大事故に繋がる。\:
In any case, that's the situation.
Even a fairy's mischief can turn into a major disaster if it goes too far.
Leave this to us and go ahead, girls.
m920192.なるほど……そういうことだったのですね。\nそれならツキコさんが何か知っているは:
I see…… so that's what's happening.
If that's the case, Tsukiko must know something──
m920192.なるほどのぉ……見えてきた。\n吾輩、実に嫌な予感がするぞい。:
I see…… the picture is coming into focus.
I have a very bad feeling about this.
m920192.なんじゃこやつら、まだ立つのか！？: What are you all doing? Are you still standing there!?
m920192.なんじゃ急に。: What's with the sudden change of topic?
m920192.なんで、こんなのばっかりぃ……！？: Why is it always this kind of thing…!?
m920192.なんとなく事情は察せますけど、\nまたどうしてこんな大惨事に……。:
I can guess what's going on, but
why does it always end up in such a mess…?
m920192.なんの板チョコ流星剣！: What's this? Board Chocolate Meteor Sword!
m920192.はい撤収ー、さあ仕事仕事。: Alright, let's fall back. Now, back to work, work.
m920192.はっ、早く王子のところへ戻らないと！: Hah! We need to get back to the Prince, now!
m920192.はんッ、あまり甘く見るでないわい！\nそう簡単に吾輩の世界樹が堕ちるわけ──:
Hmph! Don't be so smug!
There's no way my World Tree would fall so easily—
m920192.ひ、ひとつくださーい……！: C-Can I have just one, please…!
m920192.ふぅむ、よく分からぬが、\n要はその妖精を捕まえれば良いのじゃろう？:
Hmph. I don't fully understand,
but the point is, we just need to catch that spirit, yes?
m920192.ふぅー、危ない危ない。\nまったく物質界は野蛮だね。:
???: Phew, that was close.
The Material Realm is truly barbaric.
m920192.ふむ……あれも妖精の仕業だろうね。\n労働への憎悪は、裏を返せば休暇への思慕。\:
Hmm…… That must be the work of the fairies, too.
Hatred of labor is, in a sense, a longing for leisure.
It is quite possible to interfere with their minds, if one knows how.
m920192.ふん、魔界の木っ端妖精風情に、\n世界樹の支配権を奪えるものか。:
Hmph. A lowly fairy from the Demon World?
You think you can steal control of the World Tree?
m920192.ほぉ、中々に潔いではないか。\nこれだけの騒動を起こしたのじゃ、\n覚悟はできて:
Hoo, quite the graceful surrender, isn't it?
After causing such a commotion,
I assume you're prepared for the consequences?
m920192.ほれ、そなたも声を出さぬか。: Come now, why don't you raise your voice as well?
m920192.まぁ、フォラス印のチョコレートは甘さ控え目で、\n一個も小さくて適量なら健康にも:
Well, Foras-brand chocolate is low in sugar,
and since each piece is small, a reasonable amount is actually good for your health……
m920192.また貴方はそんな危険な植物を……。: You and your dangerous plants again……
m920192.まだまだまだまだァ！: Not yet, not yet, not yet!
m920192.まっ、まあ暴走は止められたわけですし……。: W-Well, at least we managed to stop the rampage……
m920192.まったく、とんだ休日出勤よのぉ。腰が痛いわい。: Honestly, what a way to spend a day off. My back is killing me.
m920192.まったく、最後まで面白いねぇ王国は。\nそれじゃ、ボクはそろそろ魔界に帰るよ。:
Honestly, your kingdom is entertaining right to the very end.
Well, I should head back to the Demon World now.
m920192.まったく誰じゃ、こんな緊急事態に。\nちょっくら吾輩が行ってとっちめて──:
Who on earth would do such a thing in an emergency like this?
I'll just go over there and deal with them—
m920192.みんな邪魔……王子さまは、ツキコと一緒にいるの。: Everyone is in the way…… Prince is with Tsukiko.
m920192.やぁ、待っていたよ王国軍の乙女たち。\n挨拶が遅れたね、ボクは魔界カカオの妖精。:
Hey there, I've been waiting for the maidens of the Royal Army.
Sorry for the late introduction. I'm the Demon Cocoa Fairy.
Feel free to call me “Foras-kun.”
m920192.やれやれ……魔界カカオの暴走とはね、\nあれだけ管理には気を付けろと言ったのに。: Oh my…… the demonic cacao is out of control again. I told them to be careful with management, and yet.
m920192.ら、ラタトスクさん！ あまり重い罰は──: R-Ratatoskr! Please, don't impose too harsh a penalty—
m920192.アヅミさん！ どうしたんですかアヅミさん！: Azumi-san! What happened to you, Azumi-san!
m920192.エクスさん、かくかくしかじかなのですが、\n魔界カカオの妖精さんを見掛けませんで:
Aix, this is a long story, but
have you seen the spirit of the demonic cacao?
m920192.エクスさん？ ここでいったいなにが──: Aix? What is going on here──
m920192.グレーターデーモンさん！？ どうしてここに！？: Greater Demon? What are you doing here?
m920192.シロガネさんは、アレを止めなくて大丈夫なのですか？: Shirogane, are you sure it's okay not to stop them?
m920192.ストの次はデモですか……。: After the strike, now a demonstration…?
m920192.ダントツの人気でしたからねぇ。\nチョコレートが百を超えた辺りからは、\n数える:
He was overwhelmingly popular, you see.
We stopped counting once the chocolates passed a hundred……
m920192.チョコレートのプレゼント会、\nカカオ農園のご厚意でタダとはいえ、\n結構な人数:
Thanks to the cocoa farm's generosity,
even though it's free,
quite a crowd has gathered…
m920192.ハハハハ、またいつか会おう、恋する乙女たち。\nあと少しの勇気が欲しいときはボク:
Hahaha. Until we meet again, you lovelorn maidens.
If you ever need a little more courage, just call me.
m920192.バレンタインとは、胸に秘めたる想いを伝える日。\nでもね、そんな勇気を持てない子:
Valentine's Day is the day to share the feelings hidden in your heart.
But there are plenty of girls who lack the courage to do so.
m920192.バレンタインは日頃の感謝を伝える日。\n王子には最高のチョコレートを贈りたい、\: Valentine's Day is about expressing gratitude for the everyday. I can only imagine how much you want to give the Prince the finest chocolate.
m920192.バレンタイン限定で、無料でのご提供中でーす！\n試食も可能ですからお気軽にお申し:
Valentine's special, and it's free of charge!
Feel free to ask for a sample tasting!
m920192.フォラスさんの本当の能力は、\nみんなの怯える心にそっと寄り添って、\n想いを告:
Foras's true talent is gently standing by
the hearts that are afraid,
and sharing the courage to confess.
m920192.フフフフ……ようやくこのときが、\n王国に借りを返す日が来たようだな。:
Heh heh heh… At last, the moment has come.
The day we settle our debt with the kingdom.
m920192.ボクがこの世で一番大っ嫌いな光景だ。\nそんな悲劇を、ボクが喜劇で塗り替える。:
It's the sight I hate most in this world.
I'm going to turn those tragedies into comedies.
m920192.ボクには大切な使命があるんだ、\nこんな場所で蛮族の相手なんかしてられないよ。:
???: I have an important mission to fulfill.
I can't afford to waste my time dealing with savages like you.
m920192.ローリエさん、ご協力感謝しますわ。\n急に色んな方が王子様を連れ去ろうとして、\:
Laurier, thank you for your help.
Suddenly, so many people tried to take the Prince away,
and it was simply too much for us to handle alone……
m920192.ワシも魔界では手酷くやられたものだよ。\n彼らを野放しにするのはあまりにも危険だ:
Even I was treated quite harshly by them in the Demon Realm.
Leaving them unchecked is far too dangerous.
m920192.世界樹といえばラタトス……\nあれ、ラタトスクさんはどこに？:
The World Tree…… Ratatos……
Wait, where is Ratatoskr?
m920192.世界樹の代表、帝国の守護獣、東の国のお姫様。\nさすがに私たち一兵士では逆らえま:
The representative of the World Tree, the Empire's guardian beast, and the Eastern Country's princess.
We mere soldiers certainly can't go against them……
m920192.世界樹の危機には吾輩がおらねば始まらんじゃろ。: If the World Tree is in crisis, it cannot begin without us, I suppose.
m920192.中には想いが実らず、恋に破れる乙女もいるだろうさ。\nだけどその痛みは、やがて乗:
I know some maidens will face unrequited love or heartbreak.
But that kind of pain is something you can eventually get over.
m920192.今すぐにでも追いかけて捕獲しなければ、\nバレンタインが大惨事になってしまうねぇ:
We must chase it down and capture it immediately,
or Valentine's Day is going to turn into a disaster.
m920192.今年のバレンタインの祝祭に向けて、\n鬼刃姫様に贈る品を吟味していた先輩方。\n:
Some of the seniors were carefully selecting gifts
for the Oni Blade Princess for this year's Valentine's Festival.
Then, suddenly, a mist of sweet scent enveloped them.
m920192.今日の三時のおやつにはチョコレートを所望するぞ。: I demand chocolate for the three o'clock snack today.
m920192.今日は鬼刃姫様記念日！: Today is Oni Blade Princess Memorial Day!
m920192.伝えなかったという後悔が癒えることは一生ない。: The regret of never saying how you feel never fades.
m920192.先ほどまで一緒にいたはずですが……\nはぐれたのかもしれません、探してきます。: We were just together a moment ago, though…… She must have gotten separated. I'll go look for her.
m920192.名前の通り魔界に原生するカカオのことさ。\n非常に高品質だが、少々気性が荒っぽく: As the name suggests, it's cacao that grows natively in the Demon Realm. It's extremely high quality, but it has a bit of a temper. If you don't handle it right, it goes berserk in no time.
m920192.吾輩知っておる、だいたいこいつが元凶じゃな？: I know the drill. You're the one behind this, aren't you?
m920192.呼び名なんぞどうでもよい。\n何を企んでおるのか知らんが、\n吾輩の世界樹から離:
I don't care what you call yourself.
I don't know what you're plotting, but
stay away from my World Tree.
m920192.奇怪な奴らめ！ 何者だッ！？: What manner of creatures are you!?
m920192.妖精さんが逃げた方角は把握しています。\n今すぐ追えばきっと間に合うはずで──:
I know which direction the spirit fled.
If we pursue it right now, we should be able to catch up──
m920192.妖精さんは世界樹に向かったみたいだよ。: The spirit seems to have headed toward the World Tree.
m920192.完敗だ、煮るなり焼くなりお好きにどうぞ。: I'm completely defeated. Do with me as you please.
m920192.対女性特攻の精神干渉、恋心の暴走。\n本日の王城内人員の男女比を鑑みるに、\nお:
A mental interference targeting women, causing their love to run wild.
Given the ratio of men to women in the castle today,
if we do nothing, the odds of this going badly are extremely high──
m920192.帝国軍上層部は抜き打ち視察を廃止せよー！\n自分たちの部下が信用できないのですか:
The Imperial High Command should abolish surprise inspections!
Can't you trust your own subordinates?!
m920192.帰って寝よーっと。: I'm just gonna go home and sleep.
m920192.怒りました、私はすごく怒りましたから。\n力づくでもあなたを止めさせてもらいます:
I'm angry. I'm really, really angry.
I'll stop you by force if I have to.
m920192.思いのほかしっかり鬼刃衆だこの人！？: That person is surprisingly loyal to the Oni Blade Squad!
m920192.恋心さ。とりわけ、女性にはよく効く。: Love. It works particularly well on women.
m920192.想いを伝えるという選択をするのは、自分です。: The choice to share your feelings must be yours.
m920192.我らお仕事したくない同盟。\n労働を憎み、自由を愛する者なり。\n今こそ、悪しき:
We are the Anti-Work Alliance.
We hate labor and love freedom.
Now is the time to shatter this wicked state.
m920192.振り絞られた勇気の尊さを、忘れていたみたいだね。:
I guess I'd forgotten the value
of courage wrung out of oneself.
m920192.明日も鬼刃姫様アニバーサリー！: Tomorrow is Oni Blade Princess Anniversary too!
m920192.時間がありません、迅速に排除しましょう。: We don't have time to waste. Let's eliminate them quickly.
m920192.権力の一極集中による過剰労働反対！\n東の国のサムライはちゃんと机に向かえー！\:
Down with the overwork caused by the centralization of power!
You samurai in the Eastern Kingdom, get back to your desks!
Stop just swinging your swords and shirking your responsibilities!
m920192.残念ながらご自宅はアレの向こう側ですね。: Unfortunately, your home is on the other side of that.
m920192.毎年バレンタインはトラブル続き。\nその対処に追われて落ち着く暇もなく、\n王子: Every Valentine's Day is nothing but trouble. We're so busy dealing with it that we never get a moment to breathe, and even just handing the Prince some chocolate is a struggle.
m920192.毎日が鬼刃姫様感謝デー！\n本日もいらっしゃいませー！:
Every day is Oni Blade Princess Gratitude Day!
Welcome in today as well!
m920192.永久機関の完成というわけですなァ！？\nつまり我らが姫様も永遠ということに！？:
So, we're completing a perpetual motion machine, huh!?
Which means our Princess will be eternal too, right!?
m920192.渡せなかったチョコレート、\n机の引き出しに仕舞われたラブレター、\n両想いのは:
Chocolate that never gets delivered,
love letters stuffed away in a desk drawer,
couples who miss each other despite loving one another.
m920192.王子さま……今年も私の罪を受け取ってくださいますか？: My Prince… Will you accept my sins again this year?
m920192.王子にチョコレートを贈りたい者は列に並べい、\n今日は無礼講、存分に想いをぶつけ:
Anyone who wishes to give chocolate to the Prince,
line up! Today, all rules are suspended—
let your feelings run wild!
m920192.王子はいったい何人分食べたんでしょうか……。: I wonder how many people's worth the Prince has eaten……
m920192.皆の者ォ、魔界カカオの準備は良いな！？\n魔界カカオを煎じて飲めば力が与えられる:
Everyone! Are you ready with the Demon Realm Cocoa!?
Brewing and drinking Demon Realm Cocoa grants you power!
With that power, if you protect the cocoa trees, you'll become even stronger!
m920192.確かに、ボクにそれだけの力は無いよ。\nだけど一滴の泥水がワインを台無しにするよ:
You're right, I don't have the power to do that.
But just as a single drop of mud can ruin a glass of wine,
I can introduce an impurity like myself into the World Tree.
m920192.私の王子様がいつ、\n貴方のものになったのかしら？\nねぇ、誘拐犯の女狐さん？:
When did my Prince become
your property, I wonder?
Well, well, you kidnapper fox?
m920192.精神干渉下にある女性は、\n魔界カカオの影響を強く受ける。\n今回も伐採は早めに:
Women under mental interference
are strongly affected by the demonic cacao.
We should prune them early this time too.
m920192.絶妙にモテなさそうな名前じゃな。: That's quite a name that suggests the opposite of popularity.
m920192.苦悩の末に、相談することはあっても。\n誰かの後押しを必要とするのだとしても。:
Even if you consult others after much suffering,
even if you need someone to push you along…
m920192.薬も過ぎれば毒となるように、その逆も然り。:
As the saying goes, too much medicine becomes poison,
and the reverse is also true.
m920192.行かせるな！ 鬼刃流忍法・カカオ手裏剣！: Don't you dare leave! Oni Blade Ninja Art: Cocoa Shuriken!
m920192.行くぞ鬼刃衆！ 総員カカオをきめよ！ \n全ては鬼刃姫様のために──ごくりごくり:
Let's go, Oni Blade Squad! Everyone, lock in on the cocoa!
All for the Oni Blade Princess—gulp gulp.
m920192.衛生兵ー！ あっ、吾輩か。: Medics! Ah, I suppose it's me.
m920192.話は後にしよう、今は農園の防衛が先決でね。\n君たちもカカオ退治を手伝ってくれな: We can talk later. Right now, we need to defend the farm. Could you help us deal with the cacao?
m920192.貴様らにだけは言われたくないわ！\n我らはチョコレートナイツ、悟りを開き、\n生:
You of all people have no right to ask!
We are the Chocolate Knights, enlightened and reborn
guardians of Valentine's Day!
m920192.赤い髪に、カカオのような褐色肌。\nもし見かけていた場合事態は深刻だ。:
Red hair, and skin the color of cacao.
If you've spotted one, the situation is grave.
m920192.足止めか、随分と手際が良いらしいのぉ。: A delaying tactic. They certainly move with impressive efficiency.
m920192.踏み出す一歩は、\n自分の意思でないといけないんです。:
That first step forward
must come from your own will.
m920192.開花した魔界カカオから、\n稀に誕生する妖精のことさ。:
It's a spirit that is rarely born
from a blooming demonic cacao plant.
m920192.鬼刃衆は馬鹿っすけど姫様への忠誠心は本物っす。\n今はそれが暴走してる状態なんで:
The Oni Blade Squad might be a bunch of idiots, but their loyalty to the Princess is genuine.
Right now, though, it's gone completely out of control. They're basically zombies.
m920192.魔界カカオの木は成長するほどに、\n周囲のカカオたちに力を与えてしまう。\n実が: The more the demonic cacao trees grow, the more power they grant to the surrounding cacao. I recommend taking them down before they bear fruit.
m920192.（あれが昨年のバレンタインの際に、\nチョコレート騎士団を創ったと噂の……）:
(So they're the ones rumored to have founded the Chocolate Knights
last Valentine's Day…)
m920192.（二人の間にいったいどんな交渉が……！？）: (What kind of negotiation just went on between those two……!?)

m940008.――ああ、私たちの帝国は、\n過去の帝国よりも強く、素晴らしい国になったのだ、と:
――Ah, our Empire has become

a stronger, more magnificent nation than the Empire of the past.
m940008.――あっ、ちょうちょ発見！\n冥界にもちょうちょっているんだねー。:
――Oh! I found a butterfly!
So there are butterflies in the Underworld, too.
m940008.――いいや、これ以上は進ませない。\n神聖なる庭園を、アダマスの信徒が穢すことは:
――No. You will not go any further.
I will not allow Adamas's followers to defile the Sacred Garden.
m940008.――いや、何かがおかしい。\n儀式が……止まっていない……？:
――No, something is wrong.
The ritual…… it hasn't stopped……?
m940008.――おっと、時間切れだ。\n悪いねスイゼ、そろそろ主役交代みたいだ。:
――Oh, time's up.
Sorry, Suize. Looks like it's time for the lead to change.
m940008.――かつて我らは、定命の苦しみを終わらせるべく、\n世界すべての命を、\n生まれ:
――Once, we sought to end the suffering of those with limited lifespans
by swallowing all life in the world
before it was ever born, into the Underworld.
m940008.――そこに、「初代」なんて権威の塊が現れたら？: ――And then, a walking embodiment of authority like the "First" appears?
m940008.――そも、此度の目覚めは想定外のものでした。: ――To begin with, this awakening was entirely unforeseen.
m940008.――そんなもの、知ったことか。: —such a thing is none of our concern.
m940008.――だから、私たちの出番なのです。: ――That is why it is our turn to act.
m940008.――っ。\n痛ったたたた……ここは……？:
――Gh.
Ow, ow, ow…… where am I?
m940008.――ねっ、ねぇ！\nとりあえず決闘しよみたいな流れになってない！？:
――Hey, hey!

Isn't this turning into a "let's just have a duel" situation?!
m940008.――初代白の皇帝、および初代白の帝国騎士団長、\nヴィラヘルム様と、ヘイズル様で:
――The First White Emperor, and the First Commander of the White Imperial Knights,
Lord Wilahelm and Lady Hazel…!
--- scene: Eighth Formation: The Underworld's Gardener (battle, start) ---
m940008.――存外、早かったな。\nスイゼが裏切ったか。:
――You're here sooner than expected.
Did Suis betray us?
m940008.――届かないと分かっていて、なぜ？\nあなたなりの忠義心なのかしら。:
――Knowing you cannot reach them, why do you persist?
Is this your form of loyalty?
m940008.――教えてくれ、スイゼ。\n俺たちは、貴様のいう真実を知らない。\nただ、帝国の:
――Tell us, Suize.
We do not know the truth you speak of.
We have come only for the safety of the Empire's people and the Material World.
m940008.――断じて、許容はできない。\n亜神ハイドース、伴侶共々、俺がここで斬り捨てる。:
――I absolutely cannot allow it.
Demigod Hydos, I will cut you down here, companion and all.
m940008.――現皇帝、初代騎士団長に勝利す！\nあるいは……ぼっこぼこのギッタギタにされて:
――Something like, "The current Emperor has defeated the First Knight Commander!"
Or... "He got absolutely trashed and had to hand over the throne."
Whichever one it ends up being.
m940008.――生命の、生への執着を甘く見すぎです。: ――You underestimate the attachment to life, to living.
m940008.――白の帝国こそが最強であると、\n貴様の血で証明しよう。:
――Let your blood prove that the White Empire
is the strongest.
m940008.――聞け、白の帝国が誇る戦士たち。\n帝国が強くあるのは、理不尽に打ち勝つためだ:
――Hear me, warriors who are the pride of the White Empire.
The Empire is strong because it overcomes the unreasonable.
Because it refuses to give up on life.
m940008.――軍議中失礼します！\n伝令ですっ！ 冥界の入口付近にて、戦闘を確認！:
—Forgive me for interrupting the war council!
I have a report! Combat has been spotted near the entrance to the Underworld!
m940008.…………。\nレオナ、兵から志願者を募れ。\n帝国臣民のために、命を懸けられるも:
…………
Leona, recruit volunteers from the ranks.
Take only those who are willing to stake their lives
for the sake of the Empire's people.
m940008.…………不思議なものだ。\n生者にそう呼ばれることを、\n嬉しく思う心が我が身に:
…………How strange.
To think that part of me still feels joy
at being called that by the living.
m940008.…………冥界の亜神だと言っても、\nヘカティエ、お前は我が主とは大違いだ。:
…………Even if you are a Demigod of the Underworld,
Hecatie, you are nothing like my master.
m940008.…………分からない。\nどうするべきだったのか、これから、どうすべきなのか。:
…………I don't know.
What I should have done. What I should do from here on.
m940008.…………理解してなお、止められぬこともある。: …………Even if I understand, there are things I cannot stop.
m940008.…………生きて帰る勝算は？:
…………
What are the chances of us coming back alive?
m940008.……あなたが方を付けてくれたら楽だったのですが。: ...It would have been easier if you had just tagged along.
m940008.……あなたたちは、その場所へ行く方法と、\n入る手段を持っているということね？:
……So you possess both the means to reach that place
and the ability to enter it?
m940008.……いえ、誰も信じられなくなった、のかしら。: ……No, perhaps you've simply lost the ability to trust anyone.
m940008.……しかし、我が妻、ペルセフォネは、\n滅びゆく我に魔力のすべてを注ぎ、\nその:
……But my wife, Persephone,
poured all her magic into me as I was perishing,
and in doing so, she was sealed away by Adamas.
m940008.……そして、白の帝国という、\n私たちの国に喧嘩を売ったのも大いなる失敗だった。:
……And picking a fight with the White Empire,
our home, was a grave mistake.
m940008.……だが、悲しみを拭わんとする\nハイドースの思想と、\n貴様のような臣下がいた:
……But I will remember the ideology of Hydos,
who seeks to wipe away sorrow,
and the fact that he had a subject like you.
m940008.……ふぅ。\n後輩が強くて嬉しいよ、本当に。:
...Phew.
It really is wonderful to see how strong my juniors have become.
m940008.……ほう。\nまだこの身を善なる神であったと言えるのか。:
……Hmph.
You still claim this body was once a benevolent god?
m940008.……ん、えっ、何だって？\n説明する時間が惜しいけど決闘はするって？:
……Huh? What do you mean?
You're in a hurry to skip the explanation, but you're still going to duel?
m940008.……スイゼ、と言ったか。\nその忠義には、敬意を表そう。:
……Suize, was it?
I will grant your loyalty its due respect.
m940008.……スイゼ。\nハイドース様の――庭師だ。:
……Suize.
I am the Gardener of Master Hydos.
m940008.……ヴァイスの名を、継いでおります。\n私が当代の族長です。:
……I bear the name of Weiss.
I am the current clan leader.
m940008.……亜神ペルセフォネ、消滅。\n魔力の痕跡も……感じられない。:
……The Demigod Persephone has vanished.
I can't sense any trace of magic power.
m940008.……儀式の詳細までは、知らない。: ……I do not know the details of the ritual.
m940008.……勝っても負けても、大損害だな。: ……Whether we win or lose, the cost will be enormous.
m940008.……参謀本部、戦術研究科長のザミエルだ。\n端的に言えば、問題点のひとつは突入に:
……This is Zamiel, Head of the Tactical Research Division, General Staff.
To put it briefly, the first problem is the risk of failing to breach the area,
and the second is the length of the march.
m940008.……反皇帝派のクーデター、\n疲弊し国を恨んでいる民による反乱、\n国家内不和に:
……An anti-Emperor coup,

a rebellion by the exhausted people who hate the country,

foreign political interference exploiting domestic discord…
m940008.……呼ばれてなくてもすぐ駆けつけそう。: ……I'd probably rush over even without being called.
m940008.……多少の違いはありましたが、\n伝承に謳われるとおりの、美しい方々でした。\n:
……There were minor differences, but
they were beautiful, just as the legends describe.
Moreover, they were certainly in possession of the Relic replicas…….
m940008.……失礼を承知で確認させてもらおう。: ……Forgive my bluntness, but I must verify.
m940008.……恥をかかせてしまったな。: ……I suppose I have made a fool of myself.
m940008.……物悲しい雰囲気を一瞬で破壊したな。: ……You just shattered that melancholic mood in an instant.
m940008.……王国に、助力を頼みたい。: ……I would like to request the Kingdom's assistance.
m940008.……王子、王国の秘匿情報網を公開することになりますが。: ……Prince, this means disclosing the Kingdom's confidential intelligence network.
m940008.……私が話し相手くらいはしてあげるわよ？: ……I suppose I could keep them company, at least?
m940008.……背中を刺すために来たわけじゃない。\nただ、今の主を止めることが、\n私の使:
……I did not come to stab you in the back.
I simply came to understand that stopping
my current master is my duty.
m940008.……臣下の言葉なんて、\nもうハイドース様には届かないさ。:
……The words of a subject
will never reach Lord Hydos anymore.
m940008.……見届けるつもりなら、後を追ってこい。\n俺たちは先へ進む。:
……If you intend to see it through, follow us.
We are moving forward.
--- scene: Eighth Formation, Demigod Persephone ---
m940008.……貴様にも、理解できよう？\n大切なものを失った世界に、\n如何なる価値がある:
……Can you understand that?
What value does a world have
that has lost what is precious to it?
m940008.……身に余る光栄です、ヴィラヘルム様。: ……It is an honor beyond my worth, Wilahelm-sama.
m940008.ああ、これは魔物の返り血。\nそれより、現皇帝はここに来てる？:
Ah, that's just monster blood splatter.
More importantly, has the current Emperor arrived?
m940008.ああ、貴族連中が黙ってな――あっ、いや、悪いルーテ。: Ah, the nobles won't stay silent――Oh, I'm sorry, Rute.
m940008.あいつはまた、違うことを言うだろうが、\n白の帝国はより強くあるべきだろう。\n:
He will likely say something different next time,
but the White Empire must be even stronger.
We will shatter everything that stands in our way.
m940008.あえて教えるつもりもない。\nここはあの方が愛した庭園。\n庭師として、その蹂躙:
I have no intention of explaining myself.
This garden was dear to her.
As her gardener, I cannot allow it to be trampled.
m940008.あなた、ヴァイスの子孫でしょう？: You are a descendant of Weiss, aren't you?
m940008.あなたの、ペルセフォネ様への愛が揺らぎ、\n奥方の自我が砕け始めた結果が、庭園の:
If the ruin of the garden was the result of your love for Lady Persephone wavering,
of the self of the Inner Chamber beginning to shatter.
Then, indeed, eternity is far too long for a living being……
m940008.あなたの先祖が、私と共に戦ってくれました。\nありがとう。今も帝国の民でいてくれ:
Your ancestors fought alongside me.
Thank you. So you are still among the people of the Empire.
m940008.あなたの焦りは、きっと、誰にも知られていない。\n定命の者にとって、想像も及ばな:
Your anxiety is something no one else will ever know.
It must be a suffering beyond the imagination of those with a finite lifespan.
m940008.あなた方は、アダマス様の命によりここにいると？: So you are here by Goddess Adamas's command?
m940008.あの方は、自身の愛した庭園の底に、\n今も縛り付けられたままだ。:
She remains bound at the bottom
of the garden she loved.
m940008.ある種の墓所……封印の地の通称。\n女神アダマス様が、かつて施した絶対の結界です:
It is a sort of burial ground... a common name for a sealed land.
It is the absolute barrier that the Goddess Adamas once laid down.
m940008.あーあ、また人たらししてる……。\n可愛い現皇帝の臣下に手を出すのは良くないよ。:
Oh, you're charming people again…
It's not good to hit on the subjects of our cute current Emperor.
m940008.い、いえ……敵は冥界軍ですが……。: N-no… the enemy is the Underworld army, but…
m940008.いいえ、こんなところで\n足止めを食らったことが、です。:
??? : No, it's the fact that we're being held up
in a place like this.
m940008.いいえ、私たちの時代は遥か過去のもの。\nこの時代の糧となれるなら安いものです。:
No, our era is long past.
It is a small price to pay if we can serve as a lesson for this age.
m940008.いえ、お気になさらず。\nですがその懸念はもっともです。:
Please, don't worry about it.
But your concern is well-founded.
m940008.いえ、このまま駆け抜けてください！\n冥界の兵と相対しているのはふたりだけ。\n:
No, keep running through!
Only the two of them are facing the Underworld soldiers.
I can see monsters, too… We need to get to them as soon as possible!
m940008.いつか死を迎える日が来たら、\nこの地に来ることになるんだな……。:
When the day comes that I meet my death,
I suppose I'll end up in a place like this……
m940008.いや、大丈夫だ、皆知っている。\nこの大戦、王国には助けられ続けているからな。:
No, it's fine. We all know.
The Kingdom has been helping us throughout this great war.
m940008.いらない世話だが、その想いは、\nまぎれもなく愛ある神そのものだ。: An unnecessary kindness, but that feeling is truly the essence of a god who loves.
m940008.うぉぉぉッ！\n陛下！ 白の皇帝陛下万歳！！:
Woahhh!
Your Majesty! Long live the White Emperor!
m940008.うおー！ どいたどいたー！\nそこの民間人さん大丈夫ですかー！！:
Whoa! Out of the way, out of the way—!
Are you okay, civilian?!
m940008.うるさい……お前に何がわかる……。\nハイドース様の悲しみを、嘆きを、どうして…:
Silence…… What would you know…….
Hydos's sorrow, her grief, how could you…….
m940008.えぇ。\nそれを私たちに望むのなら。:
Yes.
If that is what you wish of us.
m940008.えぇ。では、作戦の詳細について――: Indeed. Then, regarding the details of the plan—

—Well, now is not the time for a detailed discussion.

The ritual that will surely be carried out one day.

??? : I suppose we're in the same boat.

In such a state, for some reason, the First Emperor and

But you

m940008.だが、貴様の感傷に付き合ってやるつもりはない。\n恨み言ならば、後で聞いてやる。:

For now, step aside.

He followed us.

m940008.二度と生命の生まれることのない、\n新たな苦しみのない世界を作ろうとしたのだ。:

Sub-Deity Hecatie, and Grim of the Kingdom, we rely on your assistance, but—

m940008.冥界軍、そしてハイドースとの戦いを、\n初代皇帝陛下に委ねるべきだという言説は、:
There will surely be voices arguing that the war against the Netherworld Army and Haidos
should be entrusted to the First Emperor.
The current Emperor has certainly secured victories, but――
m940008.冥界軍、反乱軍を相手取った大戦で、\n民も少なからず疲弊し、混乱している。:
The people have been worn down and thrown into chaos

by the great war against the Underworld and the rebel armies.
m940008.冥界軍もすぐに駆けつけるだろうしね。\nそれじゃあ、初代の信任まで受けた現皇帝、:
The Underworld army will be here in no time, too.
So, the current Emperor, who has earned the trust of the First Generation,
I leave the commanding to you.
m940008.冷たくて、人の心が分からなくて、\nそれなのに、自分勝手に励ましてくる。:
Cold, unable to understand human hearts,
and yet, offering comfort on your own accord.
m940008.初代白の皇帝、ヴィラヘルム殿。\nそしてそちらは、\n初代騎士団長ヘイズル殿とお:
The First White Emperor, Wilahelm.
And you, I presume, are the First Knight Commander, Hazel.
Is that correct?
m940008.初代白の皇帝、ヴィラヘルム！\n今代の皇帝に異議を唱える！:
Wilahelm, the First White Emperor!
I hereby challenge the current Emperor!
m940008.判断は、好きにしろ。\nついてくるつもりなら、後を追ってこい。:
Make your own judgment.
If you intend to follow, then keep up.
m940008.前皇帝陛下が任せたのだから大丈夫だろう、\nいざとなれば帝国貴族が、帝国法に則っ:
It was the late Emperor's choice, so it should be fine.

If things go wrong, the Imperial nobles will seize the throne

according to Imperial law and sort things out, that was the thinking.
m940008.命令ってわけじゃないかな……。\nこれは契約、言葉を選ばないなら強制だよ。:
It's not exactly a command……
It's a contract. To put it bluntly, it's binding.
m940008.哀れな。\nもう、自分と、亡き妻のことしか見えていないのね。:
How pitiful.
You can only see yourself and your late wife.
m940008.嘘などひとつたりとも言うものか！: I would never utter a single lie!
m940008.国を率いる者とは、大切なもののために、\n誰から恨まれようと、どんな因縁を背負お: To lead a nation is to keep walking, no matter who hates you or what burdens you bear, for the sake of what is precious.
m940008.大丈夫大丈夫、これくらいどうってことないよ。: We're fine, we're fine. This is nothing to worry about.
m940008.女神アダマスの肉体か魂、いずれかが失われた時、\n自動的に私たちは新たな肉体を得:
We had a contract stating that should either the body or soul of Goddess Adamas be lost,
we would automatically gain new bodies
and take on the protection of the Empire.
m940008.奴を見逃せば、あの状態であっても\n物質界にどんな被害があるかわからない。:
If we let her go, we can't predict what kind of damage she might cause to the material world,
even in that condition.
m940008.嫌だよ、そんなに構ってくる先達とか気持ち悪いでしょ。: No way. Seniors who get that involved are creepy.
m940008.帝国に残ってはいただけないのですか……？: Is it truly impossible for you to stay in the Empire……?
m940008.帝国の情報部だけでは、限界がある。\n王国には独自の情報網があるだろう？:
The Empire's intelligence division has its limits.
The Kingdom must have its own network, wouldn't you agree?
m940008.帝国の窮地には、必ず駆けつけます。\n先輩なんていうものは、\n困った時に呼びつ:
I will always rush to the Empire's aid in times of crisis.
A senior is someone
you call upon when you're in trouble and put to work.
m940008.帝国は、どうなるのだろうか……。\n実力を第一とする現体制だが、\n初代がご帰還:
What will become of the Empire…….
The current system values strength above all, but
if the First Emperor has returned…….
m940008.帝国全軍が揃った場所で、\nこの計画を実行する必要があったのです。:
We needed to carry out this plan
with the entire Imperial army assembled.
m940008.帝国法に則り、その首、ここにもらい受けよう！！:
In accordance with Imperial law,
I claim your head!!
m940008.帝国臣民にとって、現白の皇帝の権威は\n前皇帝陛下によって信任されたという事実が:
For the Imperial subjects, the authority of the current White Emperor

rests heavily on the fact that he was endorsed by the late Emperor.
m940008.帝国臣民の命を奪って実行された儀式だ。\nそんなものを、完遂させるわけにはいかな:
A ritual carried out at the cost of the Empire's citizens' lives.
We cannot allow it to be brought to fruition.
m940008.帝国貴族の末裔たちに、\n私と同じ血の流れる可愛い王女、それから――:
Among the descendants of the imperial nobility,
there was a lovely princess with the same bloodline as mine, and then—
m940008.帝国転覆コース、よりどりみどりじゃん！: It's a buffet of ways to topple the Empire!
m940008.帰るぞ、俺たちの国へ。: Let's go home, to our country.
m940008.庭園が少しずつ朽ちていくことに、\nどれだけ手を入れても、静かに、\n冷たくなっ:
How you suffered as the garden slowly decayed,
how no matter how much effort you put in, it quietly,
coldly, withered away.
m940008.庭園自体にはだれでも入れるんだけどね。\nその下に巡らされた、封印の結界だけは、:
Anyone can enter the Garden itself, though.
It is only the sealing barrier that encircles the area beneath it
that can be touched by a very select few.
m940008.庭師を前線投入とは、\n冥界軍の人材不足も極まれり、かな？:
Deploying the Gardener to the front lines…
One can only imagine how short the Underworld army is on personnel.
m940008.彼がそれを見事退ければ、\nそれも首都のど真ん中で、民の目の前で成したなら、\n:
If he successfully repels that challenge,

and does so right in the heart of the capital, before the people's eyes,

the people of the Empire will surely think this:
m940008.待っていたぞ、簒奪者。\nその手を届かせてみせろ、この戦いこそ、\n歴史上最も苛:
I have been waiting for you, usurper.
Reach out and claim it. Let this battle be
the most brutal in history.
m940008.後見人を付けられる側に拒否権はないと思いなさい。: Consider that the one being assigned a guardian has no right to refuse.
m940008.御冗談を。\nお茶のお誘いでしたら喜んで。:
Please.
I would be delighted if that was an invitation for tea, though.
m940008.心配なら、私が後見人になるけれど？: If you're worried, I can be your guardian?
m940008.懐かしい、顔……？\n帝国に、あなたたちの顔見知りなんていたかしら？:
Familiar faces?
Did you know anyone in the Empire?
m940008.我が、蘇らそうとしたからか……？\nもう一度会いたいなどと思わなければ良かったの:
Was it because I tried to resurrect her…?

Was it my fault for wanting to see her again…?
m940008.我が妻に、二度も喪失の苦しみを……。: You have made my wife suffer the pain of loss… twice.
m940008.我が宿願は、今日、ここに成就する。: My lifelong wish is fulfilled here, today.
m940008.戦後には、ぜひとも帝国の魔術師たちに\n講義のひとつでもしてほしいところだ。:
After the war, I'd really like one of your mages
to give a lecture to our Empire's mages.
m940008.戦闘……？\nこちらの前線基地に、冥界軍が？:
Combat…?
The Underworld army is attacking our forward base?
m940008.敵と遭遇したことが？\nそれとも、後輩の敵を取っちゃったことが？:
??? : That we've encountered an enemy?
Or that we've taken on a junior's opponent?
m940008.本人ではないけれど、\nやっぱり、同じ血を引いていると、\n顔つきや髪色が似るも:
Not the people themselves, exactly.
But it's true that those who share the same blood
tend to have similar features and hair color.
m940008.本当なら、ずっと眠っているつもりだったしね。\n今の世代がやると決めたことを、\:
We had intended to remain asleep for a long time.
It's not our style to butt in and meddle
with what the current generation has decided to do.
m940008.本来のあなたは、慈悲深く、\n物質界の命を愛し、\nゆえに苦悩する善神だったので:
You were originally a benevolent god,
compassionate, who loved the lives of the material world,
and thus suffered.
m940008.来たか……。\nハイドースの庭師ちゃん、だったかな？:
You're here…
You're the gardener from Hydos, right?
m940008.正気を保っていないのが唯一の救いかな。\nあの状態なら、神としての権能も振るえな:
The fact that she's not in her right mind is the only saving grace.
In that state, she shouldn't be able to exercise any divine authority.
m940008.正直、私はもっと眠っていたかった。\nまさかアダマス様が肉体を失った理由が、\n:
Honestly, I would have preferred to keep sleeping.
I never imagined that the reason Goddess Adamas lost her body
wasn't because she was killed, but because of her own choice.
m940008.正真正銘、武力だけにとどまらない、\n実力で国を治めているのが、今の陛下なんだ。:
The current Emperor is truly governing the country

with genuine strength, not just brute force.
m940008.歩み続けるということは、\n相反する意志を砕き、進むということだ。:
To keep walking is to shatter opposing wills
and press forward.
m940008.死した魂は、何を考えているのでしょう。\n退屈ではないのかしら？:
What do the souls of the dead think about?
Don't they get bored?
m940008.殺した……？\n何を言っているのか分からないが、\nこの先に進まねば世界が危うい:
Killing?
I don't know what you're talking about,
but if we don't go through, the world is in danger. We must pass.
m940008.民の目の前で決闘をしてみせたとはいえ、\nここに残っていたら、\n不要な蜂起の旗:
Even if you did duel in front of the populace,
staying here would only make you a likely target
for an unnecessary uprising.
m940008.泣き言は後にしましょう。\n不完全な状態とはいえ、敵は世界を滅ぼしうる亜神です！:
Let's save the complaints for later.
Even in this incomplete state, the enemy is a Demigod capable of destroying the world!
m940008.消えることもできず、\n眠ることもできない、永遠の牢獄……。:
Unable to pass away,
unable to rest, an eternal prison…….
m940008.準備が整ったら、\nアダマス様の転送魔術を起動する。\n準備とか、お別れとか、色:
Once preparations are complete,
we will activate Goddess Adamas's teleportation magic.
Take care to finish all the preparations,
and see off those who wish to bid farewell.
m940008.片道切符だけどね。\nアダマス様の身に何かがあったとき、\n私たちが捨て身で対処:
It's a one-way ticket, though.
Our contract stipulates that if anything happens to Goddess Adamas,
we must throw ourselves into the fray to handle it.
m940008.物資の消耗で済めば儲けものだ。\nそのためには、何としてでも成功させるしかない。:
If all we lose is supplies, that would be a bargain.
Which is why we have no choice but to make this succeed.
Otherwise—
m940008.物質界の半数の命をここに捧げよう。\nそして、我が妻の復活の暁には、\n残る半数:
Let us offer half the lives of the material world here.
And when my wife is resurrected,
we shall destroy the remaining half with our compassion!
m940008.王族の貴様に何が分かる！: What would you, a royal, understand!
m940008.現在、ハイドースが進めているという儀式、\nその詳細は不明なままだが、\nこの地:
The details of the ritual Hydos is currently performing
remain unknown,
but it is said that an enormous amount of magical power is gathering at that location.
m940008.現在の地位を維持できているのは、\n異論がある者に対して、\nいつでも皇帝の首を:
The reason he has been able to maintain his position is

thanks to the Imperial law that explicitly states

anyone who disagrees may come and take the Emperor's head at any time.
m940008.現帝国軍に、私たちの名前はありませんから。\n申し遅れました、ヴィラヘルムです。:
Our names are not on the current Imperial army's rolls.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Wilahelm.
Please make our acquaintance, for the short time we have left before we die.
m940008.現状、あの場所に到れるのは、\nアダマス様本人と、契約者である私たちだけ。:
As things stand, the only ones who can reach that place
are Goddess Adamas herself and we, her contracted parties.
m940008.生まれた者は嘆き、悲しみ、死に怯え、\n生命の終わりには後悔だけを抱えて冥界へ至:
Those born into this world lament, grieve, and fear death,
reaching the underworld carrying only regret at life's end.
m940008.疑念あれど貴様を信じた忠臣を、\nよりにもよって裏切り者扱いか。:
To treat a loyal subject,
whom you trusted despite your suspicions,
as a traitor of all things.
m940008.白の、皇帝……ッ、アダマスの信徒がぁぁぁぁッ！！: The White Emperor……!! A follower of Adamas!!!
m940008.白の帝国は、常に強くあり続けている。\n過去の先達に、それを証明してみせよう。:
The White Empire has always remained strong.
Let us prove that to our predecessors.
m940008.白の帝国を治めるは強き力によるもの。\nその実力をもって、\n奪えるものなら奪っ:
The White Empire is ruled by the strong.
If you believe you have the strength,
then take it.
m940008.皇帝とは、誰かの願いの器ではない。\nようやく理解できたぞ、王子。:
An emperor is not a vessel for someone else's wishes.
I finally understand, Prince.
m940008.知れたこと。\n失われし我が伴侶の復活に他ならぬ。:
It's obvious.
Nothing other than the resurrection of my lost companion.
m940008.確約はできない、とだけ。\n私たちも、アダマス様の戦いをこの目でみたわけじゃない:
I can only say that I cannot guarantee it.
We have not seen Goddess Adamas's battle with our own eyes,
so we do not know what the enemy truly is.
m940008.神もまた、生命のひとつである、か。\n貴様の想い、理解できないことはないが――:
So even a god is just one form of life, is it?
I'm not without understanding of your feelings, but――
m940008.私が言うべきことではないけれど、\nただ盲信するだけが忠義ではないと思うわ。:
It may not be my place to say this,
but I don't think blind faith is the only form of loyalty.
m940008.私たちが借り受けたアダマス様の力で、\n帝国主力全軍を『庭園』へ導きます。:
With the power of Goddess Adamas that we have borrowed,
we will guide the Empire's main force to the "Garden."
m940008.私たちはこれから、白の皇帝に決闘を挑む。\n帝位を賭けた、正式な決闘だ。:
We are about to challenge the White Emperor to a duel.
A formal duel for the Imperial throne.
m940008.私の負け。\n君こそ、白の皇帝にふさわしいと認めよう。:
I concede.
I acknowledge that you are the one truly worthy of the title of White Emperor.
m940008.私は、あの御方をお救いするために――:
I am here to save that person—
--- scene: Eighth Formation: The Underworld's Gardener (battle, battle) ---
m940008.私は、今の帝国を信じています。\n私たちが繋いだものを、民が子や孫に受け継いだ、:
I believe in the Empire as it stands today.
I believe in the legacy we built, the one the people have passed down to their children and grandchildren.
m940008.私はただ、その背中を見ていることしかできなかった。: I could only stand there and watch your back.
m940008.私はヘイズル。\n残念ながら「今の帝国軍」じゃない。:
I am Hazel.
Unfortunately, I am not of the "current Imperial army."
m940008.総員抜剣ー！！\n最近何か、みんな暗い顔してて嫌なんですよー！\nここらで大戦果:
Draw your swords, everyone!!
Lately, everyone's been looking so gloomy, and I hate it!
Let's make a big splash here and show them what we're made of!!
m940008.聞こう。\nアダマスの神器を担う者として。:
Speak.
As the one who bears Adamas's divine artifact.
m940008.血の繋がりなど、国家にはどうでもいいことです。\n民の安寧を守っているかどうか、:
Blood ties are irrelevant to a nation.
Whether the people live in peace and safety—
that is the sole purpose of an Emperor's existence.
m940008.裏切り者のヘカティエ！\n穢らわしきアダマスの信徒ども！\n我が主に代わり、貴様:
You traitor, Hecatie!
You filthy followers of Adamas!
In my master's name, I will reap your souls!!
--- scene: Eighth Formation: The Garden's Keeper (battle, end) ---
m940008.誰もが、それぞれの人生を戦っている。\n生とは戦争そのものだ。\n生きるというこ:
Everyone is fighting their own battle in life.
Life itself is a war.
To live is to resist something.
m940008.身体が崩壊しつつあるというのに、\nそう、私たちと戦うつもりのようね……。\n夫:
Her body is on the verge of collapse,
and yet, she seems intent on fighting us…….
Perhaps to ensure her husband's safe escape.
m940008.違う……儀式は失敗した……。\nこれは、不完全な形に終わった魔術が、\n膨大な魔:
No…… the ritual failed…….
This is a spell that ended in an incomplete form,
unstable under the strain of immense magical power, and running wild…….
m940008.闘技場の有名人、アグナを見て逃げ出したんじゃない？\nって、それどころじゃないん:
Maybe she saw the famous Agna of the Colosseum and panicked?!
Wait, that's not the point right now!
Hey, you folks over there! Are you okay?!
m940008.集まっている魔力量から見ても、\n儀式の完成まで、さほど長い時間は残されていない:
Based on the volume of magic gathering there,
I don't think much time remains before the ritual is complete.
m940008.面倒な貴族と、迷える臣民を一気に理解させるには、\n今の帝国法に則って戦う方が手:
To make the troublesome nobles and the confused subjects understand at once,
fighting according to the current Imperial laws is the quickest way, don't you think?
m940008.飢えに苦しむ者、戦禍に翻弄される者、\n故郷を失った者、愛する者を奪われた者、\:
Those who suffer from hunger, those torn apart by war,
those who have lost their homes, those who have lost the ones they love—
their pain can only be relieved by death!
m940008.魔力の性質的に、おそらく何かを創造、\nあるいは形成していると思われます。:
Judging by the nature of the magic,
it is likely that something is being created,
or perhaps formed.
m940008.黙れ、裏切り者。\n……でも、その言葉には、感謝しておく。:
Be silent, traitor.
……But I will thank you for those words.
m940008.（――『もちろん、\n使うために持っていったのですよ』でしたか）:
(—“Of course,
I took them because I intended to use them.”)
m940008.（……意図してやっていることは、\n皆には内緒にしておいてくださいね？）: (…Please keep it a secret that I do it on purpose, okay?)
m940008.（いい勝負はできると思いますよ。\nですが、殺し合いをしたい相手ではありませんね:
(I believe I could put up a good fight.
But he is not someone I wish to fight to the death.
Neither of us would come out of it unscathed.)
m940008.（えっ、確認しなくても本物だって分かるんです？）: (Eh? You can tell it's the real thing just by looking?)
m940008.（その折、アダマス様は神器の写しである大剣と大鎌を\nヴィラヘルム様に贈られたと:
(On that occasion, Adamas gifted Wilahelm
the Greatsword and Great Scythe, which were replicas of the Relics, but—)
m940008.（それら、葬送の贈り物はこつ然と姿を消しました。\nアダマス様が残されたお言葉は:
(Those funeral gifts vanished without a trace.
The words Adamas left behind were…)
m940008.（へ、陛下が、頭を、さげて、えぇぇっ！？）: (H-His Majesty is, bowing, his, head, eeeh!?!)
m940008.（アンジェリーネ様も時々やってるじゃないですか。\nこれ、血筋だったんですねぇ）:
(Lady Angeline does that sometimes too, doesn't she?
So it's in the blood, I suppose.)
m940008.（ディアナ様、騎士団長としてどうです？\n初代に勝てると思いますか？）:
(Diana-sama, how do you feel about the Knight Commander position?
Do you think you could defeat the First?)
m940008.（ヴィラヘルム様は、\n崩御の際に、ふたつの神器を次代皇帝に継承しました）:
(When Wilahelm passed away,
he bequeathed two Divine Relics to the next Emperor.)
m940008.（国宝を模倣する馬鹿はいないし、\nそも、あの莫大な魔力量を再現できる職人はほぼ:
(No fool would counterfeit national treasures,
and besides, there are almost no craftsmen capable of replicating that immense magical power.
It's certain. That is the Emperor and the Knight Commander, in person.)
m940008.（少なくとも、今も帝国軍に残っている軍人で、\n拒否する者の方が少ないだろうな。:
(At least, among the soldiers still remaining in the Imperial Army,
there are likely far fewer who would refuse. Overwhelmingly so.)
m940008.（戦後の話をした瞬間、\n兵士の皆さん、ちょっと笑っていましたね。\nそれだけ、:
(The moment I mentioned post-war matters,
the soldiers all smiled a little.
It seems this war has been weighing heavily on their minds…)
m940008.（本当に、人たらしですわね……。\n兵の緊張をほぐすために、道化を演じるなんて）:
(He really is a charmer…
Putting on a clown's act just to ease the soldiers' tension.)
m940008.（歴史解釈に余地はあれど、それはつまり、\n初代皇帝はいつか帰ってくる、\n神器:
(While there is room for interpretation in history, that means
the First Emperor will return someday,
with the Relic replicas as proof….)
m940008.（盲信するだけが、忠義じゃない、か――）: (Blind faith is not the only form of loyalty, is it――)
m940008.（陛下は確認したけれど……。\nこれは、兵に対し周知するためでしょうね。\nあれ:
(His Majesty has confirmed it, but….
This is likely to inform the troops.
That figure is unmistakably the real deal… the First Emperor himself.)
